meta.plot: After moving to Ironwood, siblings Caitlyn and Zac Torres are drawn into a thrilling car culture where street racing reigns and high school status is all about your ride. Haunted by their father's dark past, they join forces with loner Curtis and outcast Marcel to rebuild his legendary car.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: New kids Caitlyn and Zac Torres navigate the hierarchy of Ironwood High School, and try to avoid the dark cloud of their notorious father. Logan struggles to make ends meet. Caitlyn meets Curtis, a loner caught in a tug of war between his father, the Sheriff, and his brother, a local criminal. Zac befriends the "unpopular" Marcel, while making an enemy of street racing champ, Harris Bowers.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Glow
1.plot: Sparks fly at the annual Ironwood Firefly Festival. Caitlyn decides to take a leap of faith. Zac jumps the gun on his mission to race Harris Bowers. Marcel unveils his signature logo. Curtis is pulled into the seedy world of his brother, Ray. And Uncle Logan is presented with an opportunity.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Assessment
1.plot: Urged by Logan to repair his friendship with Marcel, Zac suggests they go to an unreasonably dangerous Go-Kart track. Curtis invites Caitlyn to a family BBQ, where a surprising guest joins them. Harris prepares for an upcoming street takeover. Sam discovers how much Ironwood has changed, while Logan reminds her that the best parts of Ironwood will always be there.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Disassemble
1.plot: Zac and Curtis skip school together and watch some high octane drag racing at an abandoned air strip, run by Curtis' brother, Ray. Kiara invites Caitlyn to lunch, which turns into a group outing. A video of Harris Bowers' street takeover is mocked online, leading to an exhilarating street race. Zac asks Logan to train him, just like he taught his brother, Zac's dad, years ago.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Value
1.plot: Car auction in Ironwood. A nostalgic Sam considers bidding on her old car. Marcel convinces his dad, Wade, to make his famous chili. Logan takes Caitlyn's advice and starts a car restoration side gig. Zac has a secret street race. And realizing everyone else has a spot, Caitlyn finds hers.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Reassemble
1.plot: Marcel gets bad news about his dad, so the crew takes him to White Knuckle Run, an ATV dirt motocross event in nearby West Newton. Logan and Sam take a road trip to see Marcel's mom. Sheriff Hugo Young enlists Ray's help finding some local criminals. Harris challenges Zac.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Red, Green, Blue
1.plot: With only three weeks until Zac's race with Harris, the crew works overtime to finish the UNB10 car. Zac's confidence grows with Ray's guidance. Caitlyn and Curtis discover a possible clue to Christian Maddox's whereabouts. Logan discovers who Zac's been training with. Harris faces a new challenge on his mom's birthday memorial. Curtis takes Brooke for a ride on his bike.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Wiring
1.plot: Homecoming. Marcel and Brooke's post-apocalyptic themed dance is a big hit. Zac hopes to meet up with Alicia. Hitting an electrical snag with the car, Caitlyn and Curtis wonder if they should skip the dance. Sam and Darren Bowers co-chaperone, looking out for “commotion.” Kiara is fed up with Noah. And one of the bank robbers from 17 years ago gets out of prison.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Ignition
1.plot: It's time to turn the key on the UNB10 car, but will it start? Zac gets a big race at the speedway, but with an unexpected opponent. Ryan asks Harris to meet someone. Brooke and Curtis grow closer. Logan and Hugo are out of options. Marcel and Brooke become “friendly” rivals.

1.title: EN - Motorheads [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Redbird
1.plot: UNB10 is ready for the big race, but is Zac? Caitlyn visits Buzz at the junkyard, wondering what's next for her. Marcel takes a leap of faith. Brooke prepares for her winter break. Curtis confronts his father. Logan attempts to get out of Ezra's plan. Kiara stands up to her mom. And Harris, feeling lost and alone, reaches out to Alicia.

meta.plot: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan's home in Scotland to Charley's in England. They'll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Gears, Fears, and Tears
1.plot: As departure day approaches, Ewan resurrects his old California police bike while Charley brings a 1970s rust heap back from the dead.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Route Canal
1.plot: Fresh off the ferry, the guys travel through the Netherlands and Germany to visit Charley's mom's hometown before heading to the Danish islands.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Survive the Ride
1.plot: In a scary setback, Ewan's bike gives way from underneath him. A local Swedish biker club comes to the rescue. Then it's off to meet a mermaid.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Fjord Focus
1.plot: Ewan and Charley wind their way through Norway's scenic roads and fjords, gobsmacked by Viking churches and ancient rock formations.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Ice, Snow, and Bears
1.plot: The guys temporarily ditch their bikes to fly to Svalbard, an archipelago in the Arctic where the effects of climate change are glaringly real.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Lost in Lapland
1.plot: Ewan and Charley meet a man with a fascinating connection to the Lapland forest in Finland and encounter two crazy motorsport events.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Deep in the Forest
1.plot: Traveling to the Finnish lakes, Ewan and Charley camp on a breathtakingly beautiful island and give the lost art of logrolling a spin.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - It's Baltic Outside
1.plot: After sputtering the last 3,000 miles, Ewan's bike finally gives out. Estonian mechanics step in, and the guys resume exploring the Baltic landscape.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Pinball and Pierogies
1.plot: Nostalgia and hope define this leg as the guys retrace their Long Way Round route from over 20 years ago and visit a Ukrainian refugee center.

1.title: EN - Long Way Home [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Home Straight
1.plot: Paragliding, Swiss Golf, and a brush with an eccentric artist round out an Alpine exploration before making the long ride home.

meta.plot: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapuna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Goodbye Cruel World
1.plot: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Life in the Fast Lane
1.plot: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Long Way from Home
1.plot: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Don't Stop the Dance
1.plot: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Pretty Vacant
1.plot: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

1.title: EN - Lazarus [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Heaven Is a Place on Earth
1.plot: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

meta.plot: Haunted by a shadowy past, the wife of a rising star in Amsterdam's mayoral office finds herself drawn into the city’s underworld of sex and drugs.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E01 - The Cage Door Opens
1.plot: Struggling to raise a rebellious daughter and be a good wife to her ambitious husband, Xandra reconnects with a friend — and rediscovers a talent.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E02 - The Smallest of Sins
1.plot: A disappearance puts Xandra in a tough spot, but Bliss shows that she has a talent for the business. Michiel tries to take control of the narrative.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E03 - One Spin Too Many
1.plot: Lulu bonds with Syl, and Xandra gets pulled deeper into Ralph’s enterprise. Michiel makes a shocking discovery while sinister forces close in.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E04 - Play The Game
1.plot: A frantic Xandra turns to Ralph as the police cleanup hits a wall. After a fight with her mother, Lulu runs to Syl. Michiel goes mole-hunting.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E05 - The Deal
1.plot: The secrets and lies lead to a fiery face-off. Xandra tries to use her leverage with Ralph, but he asks for everything in return. Syl tutors Lulu.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E06 - To Love Or To Leave
1.plot: On a work trip, Xandra opens up to Lulu, yet even in dreamy Croatia, old habits die hard. Anne and Janna reveal fragile hopes and grand designs.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E07 - A Hit Is a Hit
1.plot: Furious to find Michiel meeting with Syl, Xandra spirals out of control. Lulu’s flirtation heats up, while an innocent gets caught in the crossfire.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E08 - Unmasked
1.plot: Michiel learns that he should be careful what he wishes for. Syl comes calling, Lulu reconnects, and Xandra teams up with Marieke for an elite fete.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E09 - The Bait
1.plot: Syl shares her favorite pastime with Lulu, and the mob war shakes Xandra. Ralph coolly strikes back, and the door to a gilded cage slams shut.

1.title: FR - Women of the Night - S01E10 - The Garden of Live Flowers
1.plot: Tables turn as Yassin uses Michiel to get Syl, Xandra taps Naomi to find Lulu, and Bibi embraces danger. The final showdown will change everything.

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After a car accident in 2006, Sam Tyler was up in 1973. Sam's 21st Century attitudes make him a fish out of water in this world of clunky technology and old fashioned policing. And nothing seems more alien than his new boss, DCI Gene Hunt, who believes in gut instinct and, all too often, sheer brute force. Then Sam discovers a connection between a murder in 1973 and the kidnapper in 2006. Could solving this case be the key to getting home?

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Sam decides he has to embrace this world - for now. But then he discovers Gene is planning to plant evidence to secure the conviction of Kim Trent, an elusive criminal. Shocked by Gene's attitude to crime-solving, Sam releases Trent. But when a young woman gets caught in the crossfire as a result of Trent being freed, Sam is forced to question his methods. Can he and Gene put aside their differences and find the evidence to nail Trent?

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When Sam responds to a fatal stabbing at Crester's Textiles he's shocked to discover that it's the converted mill where he lives in 2006. Sam sets up a forensic investigation but Gene already has a hunch about the murderer. Sam believes he has to stop Gene from sending an innocent man down for life. But does he have more to learn about this world than he thinks?

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Gene believes that local gangster Stephen Warren and the police can co-exist and that the streets are safer as a result. But Sam knows that in the future, dodgy deals like this will irrevocably change the relationship between the public and the police. Whilst Gene lays a ghost to rest, Sam sets to work on convincing his new partner, but is distracted when he meets his mother as a young woman.

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Sam and Gene go undercover in a local pub to solve the murder of a local Manchester United fan. As Gene looks like he's set to drink the pub dry, Sam worries about their chances of finding the killer before Saturday's big match. With the press using the murder to fuel the flames of hate between rival fans, Sam is under pressure to solve the murder before the tensions destroy the community.

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: When his mother's voice bleeds through from 2006 and he hears her say goodbye to him, Sam is desperate - he's alive and determined to make himself heard. But then the call comes in that a man has taken people hostage at the Manchester Gazette and is intent on killing them at 2pm - the same time Sam's machine will be switched off. Could stopping the hostage-taker be a way of staying alive?

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Sam demands a transparent investigation into the death-in-custody of small-time drug dealer Billy Kemble. He believes that if the police don't police themselves, the public will never trust them. When the explosive evidence of what happened to Billy falls into his hands, Sam has a huge decision to make. This evidence could tear the team apart. It's an opportunity to destroy his world and the people in it, but also perhaps an opportunity to get home.

1.title: FR - Life on Mars - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Sam is finally accepting of this world - until he comes face to face with his 29 year-old dad, Vic. Vic Tyler is a small time gambler who unwittingly finds himself at the centre of a murder enquiry. As Sam moves to protect his father, he embarks upon an emotional journey, piecing together a childhood memory and uncovering an uncomfortable truth that will change him forever.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Tyler has visions of someone disrupting his life support system in 2006, and encounters who he thinks is the same assailant in 1973, running a gambling syndicate and protection racket. Recognising the man as a killer he failed to stop in the future, Tyler is prepared to go to any lengths to make sure his life is not threatened and the man doesn't kill his original victim.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: On an assignment to return a career safe breaker from prison for further questioning, Tyler, Ray and Chris are attacked by robbers and the man who they were taken in for questioning is broken out. Is a local gangster to blame, or is there more going on than meets the eye... specifically, was the crime actually arranged by Gene's old mentor? Meanwhile, Sam tries to break in the first black detective in the department, a man who will later become Sam's mentor when he first joins the police force.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: The team receive a bomb warning, claiming the IRA has planted a car bomb in Manchester. Being from 2006, Sam realises the bomb warning reported doesn't fit with his understanding of IRA methods. However, when Sam's modern know-how fails and nearly kills Ray, the rest of the department shun his line of investigation to focus on an Irish socialist group. At the same time, Sam's visions of the future suggest that he may have suffered brain damage, affecting his higher reasoning, from having been in a coma for so long.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: The body of a young woman is found in wasteland. The investigation takes the team to suburbia, where a local car dealer is throwing private parties, employing make-up girls from a local company to “help out” when the wife-swapping begins. Posing as married couple Tony and Cherie Blair, Sam and Annie infiltrate one of the parties, only to discover that it isn't as simple as they think.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: The team investigates the abduction of a young woman and her daughter, who are being held prisoner by somebody who wishes the team to release a prisoner arrested on a murder charge a year ago. At the same time, Sam faces a life or death situation in 2006 when he thinks he has accidentally been given an overdose. As the deadline draws closer, Sam collapses into a deeper coma, leaving his colleagues to tackle the mystery on their own (Albeit using some of his earlier suggestions).

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: As heroin hits the streets of Manchester for the first time, CID and DCI Hunt want culprits for the smuggling, the dealing and ensuing violence, which becomes difficult when Annie is kidnapped by the smugglers. As Sam tries to get to the source of the influx of this deadly drug, he finds himself intractably drawn to a beautiful young woman who was witness to a heroin-related shooting... and who, he later realises, is the mother of his girlfriend in the future. At the same time, Sam's 'visions' reveal that his girlfriend has decided to stop visiting him in hospital, as she can't keep waiting for him to wake up.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: A water-tight court case fails to put away a local gangster. Unable to cope with a guilty man walking free, DCI Hunt turns to alcohol but soon finds himself in a spot of bother. When it appears as though Hunt may have killed someone, it's up to Sam, torn between Gene and his replacement, a DCI who actually uses Sam's modern police techniques and vocabulary, to help him out.

2.title: FR - Life on Mars - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: Sam learns that an operation is to be conducted on him in 2006 to try and revive him from his coma. However, he believes that to return to the twenty-first century, he has to betray his colleagues in 1973 - but can he regard them as real or imagined?

meta.plot: Sam Tyler se réveille en 1973 après un accident de voiture survenu en 2006 juste après l'enlèvement de sa petite amie. Policier, il va se mettre au service de la police de Manchester et Salford où il va devoir faire face à différents chocs entre sa manière de travailler et celle de l'époque. La série ajoute à cela un côté surréaliste puisque Sam Tyler parle la nuit à une fille à travers sa télévision. La série entretient aussi un mystère sur ce qui est arrivé à Tyler : a-t-il réellement voyagé dans le temps ? Est-il dans le comas en 2006 et ceci n'est que le fruit de son imagination ? Ou encore, vit-il en 1973 et est-il mentalement instable avec en plus des visions du futur ? Des questions auxquelles les réponses seront apportées au fur et à mesure.

1.title: FR - David Nolande - S01E01 - Waste of Time and Effort
FR - David Nolande - S01E02 - The Prey of the Flames
FR - David Nolande - S01E03 - The Clock of Destiny
FR - David Nolande - S01E04 - Crescendo
FR - David Nolande - S01E05 - Malicious Dogs

meta.plot: David Nolande est un jeune cadre dans une agence de pub. Il est marié à Corinne. Un soir, David fête avec ses collègues le succès d'une campagne publicitaire. Sur le chemin du retour, David téléphone à Corinne pour la prévenir de son arrivée. Il conduit vite et parle avec son épouse lorsqu'un chien soir surgit devant ses phares. Coup de volant, embardée, la voiture lui échappe et va percuter la petite caravane d'une cartomancienne, et la tue sur le coup.

1.title: FR - The Super Models - S01E01 - The Look
1.plot: In 1983, four teenagers—Naomi, Cindy, Linda, and Christy—each step in front of a camera for the first time, igniting a seismic chain of events.

1.title: FR - The Super Models - S01E02 - The Fame
1.plot: Naomi, Cindy, Linda, and Christy work with fashion titans and walk high-profile runways, leading to a music video that changes everything.

1.title: FR - The Super Models - S01E03 - The Power
1.plot: Taking the world by storm, the women become the faces of '90s culture until shifting perceptions and a controversial remark shake things up.

1.title: FR - The Super Models - S01E04 - The Legacy
1.plot: As the women face life changes and find new roles as entrepreneurs, humanitarians, and mothers, they find the power in growing older.

meta.plot: Dans les années 80, Naomi Campbell, Cindy Crawford, Linda Evangelista et Christy Turlington deviennent des icônes de la mode et transcendent leur industrie en s'unissant. Voici comment elles ont affirmé leur pouvoir et façonné l'avenir.

1.title: FR - The Fake Sheikh - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Maverick reporter Mazher Mahmood tries to make a name for himself in the cutthroat world of tabloid journalism. He poses as a hitman and exposes a respected doctor who wants his mistress dead. But what Mahmood really wants is a huge scoop. He devises an audacious undercover operation, posing as a jet-setting Arab sheikh with a playboy lifestyle to expose the misdemeanours of two football tycoons.

1.title: FR - The Fake Sheikh - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The Fake Sheikh becomes a global star after a string of jaw-dropping scoops, including exposing a plot to kidnap David Beckham’s family and a sting on England manager Sven-Göran Eriksson. But as Mahmood’s star rises, questions grow over his methods and relations become strained with some of the people closest to him.

1.title: FR - The Fake Sheikh - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Mazher Mahmood is seemingly unstoppable, despite his doubters. Then shockingly the News of the World closes amid national scandal. But Mahmood is a survivor. He joins a new paper and sets up an undercover sting on British pop star, Tulisa, aimed at exposing her as a Class A drug dealer. But there’s a twist in the tale as the fake sheikh finds himself in the headlines and on trial.

meta.plot: C'est l'histoire captivante du journaliste de tabloïd Mazher Mahmood – le roi de l'arnaque. Se faisant passer pour un riche cheik arabe, il piège des mannequins, des membres de la famille royale, et des vedettes lors de mises en scène élaborées. Il a été journaliste vedette anglais durant près de 30 ans. Mais la chute sera rude pour lui. Mahmood va faire lui-même la une et les rôles sont inversés.

meta.plot: Chloe évolue dans les cercles de l'élite new-yorkaise aux côtés de son mari avocat, Adam, et de son fils Ethan. Lorsqu'Adam est brutalement assassiné, l'enquête secoue la famille et met au jour des secrets enfouis depuis longtemps.

Pour Alice, élève modèle de 17 ans, l’arrivée dans le quartier pour mineurs de la prison de Dante est un choc. Afin de retrouver au plus vite sa mère malade, elle accepte un pacte dangereux : infiltrer un groupe de jeunes détenus planifiant une évasion. Son objectif ? Les trahir pour obtenir sa liberté. Mais plus elle apprend à les connaître, plus elle s’attache à eux. Alice va devoir faire un choix : trahir ses nouveaux amis ou s’enfuir avec eux.

1.plot: As the team pulls together and tries to help Matt get used to his new role as quarterback after Jason's injury, Lyla offers her support to Tim.Jason learns about the extent of his injury, and Tami gets a job as the school guidance counselor.

1.plot: As the Panthers prepare for a match against the Tigers, who are their biggest rival, Jason's new roommate tries to help him understand the potential he has for recovery.Lyla tells Tim of her regrets about what happened between them, and Matt hits an all-time low.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E05 - Git 'Er Done
1.plot: The big game against the Tigers drawing closer, Coach Taylor must decide between Matt and the self-assured recruit Ray "Voodoo" Tatum for the starting quarterback. The feelings between Tim and Lyla grow stronger. Jason's newly-found motivation strives him to begin the rehab.

1.plot:
Ray Tatum faces the blame of his team mates after Panthers' win in the game last week might be overturned.

1.plot: As the Panthers get ready to face the dominating Laribee Lions, the 2000 State Champ quarterback, Lucas Mize is set to join the team.Smash catches his chance to convince a college scout of his talents. A focused Tim quits drinking. Jason's suspicions of Lyla and Tim's affair grow. Tyra and Billy set up an after game homecoming party.

1.plot: Julie thinks about going on a date with Matt. A discouraged Smash turns to foul play to improve his on-pitch performance. Cheered by Lyla and Tim, Jason has his first quad rugby game. A dinner turns into a fight for Coach Taylor, Tami, Riggins and his brother.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E09 - Full Hearts
1.plot: Smash continues to go the extreme to improve his performance. Rumors begin to spread about Tim and Lyla's relationship. Julie and Matt attempt to go out on a date but it is cursed from the beginning.The Panthers are in much anticipation for their upcoming game against the Gatling High.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E10 - It's Different for Girls
1.plot: The cheerleaders prepare for Championship Classic. Lyla is picked on when people find out about her and Riggins. Coach Taylor tries to keep Matt and Julie apart. Jason goes home after being released from rehab.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E11 - Nevermind
1.plot: The Panthers are preparing for another game they can't lose. Matt's father comes back from Iraq but his mother's condition is difficult to take in.Tami Taylor sees Tim Riggins regarding his grades. She believes he's not doing his homework by himself and asks Landry to tutor him for his next oral exam. If he doesn't pass, he won't play in the football team.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E12 - What to Do While You're Waiting
1.plot: The Panther's fate is hung up on the result of a game between two other teams and there is nothing they can do about it.Meanwhile, there is tension at the Street's house because of the lawsuit they introduced against Coach Taylor.Matt's father has a hard time adjusting back to real life.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E13 - Little Girl I Wanna Marry You
1.plot: The Panthers have only one more game to win in order to qualify for the play-offs. Smash's mother discovers something that could end his football dreams.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E14 - Upping the Ante
1.plot: The Panthers prepare for their first playoff game.Coach Taylor gets distracted as he has to come up with a solution to Smash's use of drugs. Tyra and Julie befriend while Riggins bonds with his alienated father.Buddy learns about Jason and Lyla's engagement.

1.plot: The Panthers savor their crucial playoff-win-until race issues emerge and sorely test their bond after Mac makes racial statements.Tami frowns upon Julie's newfound friendship with Tyra. The girls play a powder-puff football game.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E16 - Black Eyes & Broken Hearts
1.plot: Due to racial comments from Coach Mac, the black players on the team refuse to play unless he is sacked.Julie is sucked deeper into the vortex as her friendship with Tyra develops. Matt tries to win Julie back.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E17 - I Think We Should Have Sex
1.plot: After Julie reveals to Matt that she wants to have sex with him, Matt feels the need to put together something special. Tim clashes with his father.The Panthers are into the next round of the playoffs and looking solid.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E18 - Extended Families
1.plot: Lyla makes a surprise visit to the quad rugby camp where Jason is playing at, but she doesn't find the comfort she came looking for.Buddy Garrity's affair with Tyra's mother comes out. Consequently, Buddy decides to move in with the Taylors.Smash becomes suspicious about Waverly when she goes for a midnight swim with him.

1.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S01E20 - Mud Bowl
1.plot: An chemical spill near Dillon High School forces Coach Taylor and the Panthers to seek another facility in which to play the crucial State Semi-Final game.

Riggins faces the impending consequences of his relationship. Landry wonders whether he should tell someone about Tyra's situation.

Meanwhile, the Panthers are preparing themselves for the state championship.

Losing Coach Taylor to TMU might prove to be their biggest setback. Tyra gets a shock visitor. Matt and Landry struggle with their everyday life, as it is not what they expected.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E02 - Bad Ideas
2.plot: So many things have changed at Dillon High and the first day of school is the real test. Matt stands by as his world comes crashing down, while Landry still copes to make sense of his. All eyes seem to be focusing on Smash, while Tami tries to adjust to having a teenager and a newborn.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E03 - Are You Ready for Friday Night?
2.plot: Matt and Smash have a hard time listening to their coach as they prepare for their first game of the new season. Coach Taylor heads back to Dillon to check on his family and finds out just what is happening to the Panthers since he's left.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E04 - Backfire
2.plot: Tim and Jason go to Mexico as Street hopes to explore experimental surgery. Riggins, who is worried about Street, turns to Lyla Garrity, who's busy helping a newcomer acclimate to Dillon. Meanwhile, Coach Taylor decides on a big career move that will change his life. A development in a police search deeply affects the lives of Tyra and Landry.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E05 - Let's Get It On
2.plot: Coach Taylor returns to Dillon, but it is not an easy homecoming; the team must deal with conflict between Saracen and Smash; Riggins turns to Lyla for help in changing Street's mind about surgery.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E06 - How Did I Get Here?
2.plot: Key evidence comes in implicating Landry; when Tami's sister visits to help her with the baby, she stirs things up in the house; Riggins must prove to coach Taylor that he wants to be a part of the team.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E07 - Pantherama!
2.plot: As college football scouts approach Smash, he must make a life-changing decision. Coach Taylor has set his sights on a potential addition to the team. Tami appoints Lyla and Tyra to be in charge of this year's Pantherama. Matt is living his dream, with his new cheerleader girlfriend by his side, but yet he is drawn to the live-in nurse. Julie turns her jealousy into a twisted relationship.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E08 - Seeing Other People
2.plot: As Smash sets out on his first recruitment trip, Saracen asks his cheerleader girlfriend for an open relationship.

2.plot: Landry admits to the murder of Tyra’s assaulter but the struggle with his conscience continues. Meanwhile Jason Street is set up with an online dating service by Herc. The Taylors get ready for baby Gracie’s christening, while tensions increase between Tami and Julie.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E10 - There Goes the Neighborhood
2.plot: Dillon County is hit by a tornado with Laribee High School affected by the damage forcing both rivals to share Dillon's resources. Julie and Tami adjust to Tim Riggins' living in their house, and tension builds between Landry and Tyra.

Meanwhile tension is still high between Coach Taylor and Tim Riggins regarding the situation with Julie. Tim doesn't know where to turn. And all eyes are on Coach Taylor as he prepares the Panthers to play Laribee High School in the season's biggest game.

Elsewhere, Matt Saracen discovers that he is actually in love with his grandma's at-home nurse, while Brian "Smash" Williams learns that those close to him may not be ready for interracial dating.

2.title: FR - Friday Night Lights - S02E13 - Humble Pie
2.plot: Coach Taylor hires Tami as the girls volleyball coach and enlists the help of Tyra. Smash has a confrontation at a movie theater and is faced with a dilemma.

2.plot: Matt Saracen reaches at his lowest point. Meanwhile, Tami Taylor’s relationship continues to blossom with Tyra. Julie  becomes envious. Landry has an admirer. Elsewhere, Smash seeks advice from Coach Taylor.
