meta.plot: An explosion at the National Assembly kills everyone in the cabinet, leaving Park Mu-jin, the Minister of Environment, to become the next president. Park Mu-jin is a scientist-turned-politician who has no ambitions in politics, but as the acting president for 60 days, he is compelled to investigate the truth behind the attack. Based on the popular American series, Designated Survivor.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - The Acting President
1.plot: While driving with his family, Park Mu-jin sees that the unthinkable has happened at the National Assembly and soon finds his life turning upside down.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Commander-In-Chief
1.plot: Surrounded by generals and officials clamoring over what must be done, Park Mu-jin decides to pursue a hunch despite opposition from his own advisers.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Maintaining Status Quo
1.plot: Han Na-gyeong makes a startling connection after uncovering a clue. As a political rival incites public fear, Park Mu-jin weighs his options.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Confession
1.plot: A survivor is found at the disaster scene. Cha Yeong-jin’s briefing about approval ratings and presidential election polls makes Park Mu-jin uneasy.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - A Good Person
1.plot: Park Mu-jin’s live interview alarms the public and the Blue House staff. Jeong Han-mo questions Na-gyeong’s suspicions about Oh Yeong-seok.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Command
1.plot: As the staff tries to find ways to allay the public’s growing fear, Park Mu-jin makes an unexpected suggestion. Na-gyeong asks Yun Chan-gyeong for help.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Governance
1.plot: Han Ju-seung returns to the Blue House, Na-gyeong divulges a troubling detail to Han-mo, and Yun Chan-gyeong threatens Park Mu-jin with impeachment.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Doubt
1.plot: Yeong-jin thinks he’s found his candidate. Na-gyeong uncovers footage implicating Yeong-seok and urges Han-mo to brief Park Mu-jin before it’s too late.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Scandal
1.plot: The staff tries to control rumors brewing around Park Mu-jin, but he remains reticent. Ji Yun-bae tells Han-mo that he’s the only one who can save him.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - Accomplice
1.plot: Park Mu-jin receives distressing information from an unforeseen source -- and is told not to trust anyone. Cha Yeong-jin still doesn’t have his answer.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - The Acting President, Oh Yeong-seok
1.plot: Kang Dae-han interrogates Na-gyeong, who insists on briefing Park Mu-jin in person. The staff doesn’t know what to make of Yeong-seok’s actions.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - Answer
1.plot: Yeong-seok’s opportunistic maneuvering doesn’t go unnoticed. Choe Gang-yeon fears that Park Mu-jin has made his choice. Na-gyeong probes Yeong-jin.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E13 - Presidential Candidate
1.plot: Yeong-seok has cutting words for Park Mu-jin. Despite Ju-seung’s counsel, Yeong-jin starts preparing his candidate. Na-gyeong tries to assure Han-mo.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E14 - The Outcome
1.plot: As his advisers wonder whether Park Mu-jin is making decisions as an acting president or as a candidate, Yeong-seok informs him about his intentions.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E15 - The Trap
1.plot: Park Mu-jin tries dealing with a military threat by taking a gamble on Lee Gwan-muk. Yeong-jin receives photos putting a candidate in a delicate spot.

1.title: EN - Designated Survivor: 60 Days [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E16 - The Last Choice
1.plot: With limited time left as acting president, Park Mu-jin and his staff scramble to solve the case -- but the mysterious tailor remains an enigma.

meta.plot: Rascal Flatts bassist Jay DeMarcus and ex-beauty queen Allison DeMarcus write their own rules for juggling family and fun in this reality show.

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Rules We Live By
1.plot: Meet the DeMarcuses. Jay's always traveling for work, and it's tough to get in sync with the family. Will Allison pencil him into her busy schedule?

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Gone Camping
1.plot: Jay's got his heart set on camping — and showing the kids a life beyond room service. Can the family survive the wild without their creature comforts?

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Babies, Budgets and Birthdays
1.plot: Allison goes big, as usual, for Madeline's birthday party. Jay talks about having another baby till the fantasy brushes up against reality.

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Life Is a Highway
1.plot: We're going to Jackson — for a ceremony toasting grandma. Time to get on the bus and fill up on sisterly drama and manly life lessons.

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - A Dog Day Thanksgiving
1.plot: Gold, glitter and chaos are on the Thanksgiving menu. Allison copes with her father's absence. Jay adopts a new dog son and suits up to fry a turkey.

1.title: EN - DeMarcus Family Rules [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Rules for the Future
1.plot: Jay wants to live it up on the fairway with his pals. Allison needs to lay down the law — and plan a pageant. Worlds collide as the party comes home.

meta.plot: Dungeons, dragons... and delicious monster stew!? Adventurers foray into a cursed buried kingdom to save their friend, cooking up a storm along the way.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Episode 1: Hot Pot/Tart
1.plot: After a crushing loss, Laios, Marcille, and Chilchuck quickly reenter the dungeon to save Falin, but this time, they have a foolproof survival plan.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Episode 2: Roast Basilisk/Omelet/Kakiage
1.plot: After waking up to a tantalizing smell, Marcille receives a lecture from Senshi on a balanced diet. The crew helps an adventurer poisoned by a basilisk.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Episode 3: Living Armor
1.plot: Laios and crew access a hidden area guarded by mysterious Living Armor, who appear to be protecting something potentially delicious.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Episode 4: Stewed Cabbage/Orcs
1.plot: Reaching the third level of the dungeon, Senshi leads the crew to his secret vegetable garden. Later, they are accosted by a band of angry, desperate orcs.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Episode 5: Snacks/Sorbet
1.plot: As another group of adventurers discovers a treasure box, a swarm of bone-chilling ghosts chases Laios and his crew. Senshi, however, has a sweet plan.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Episode 6: Court Cuisine/Boiled in Salt Water
1.plot: A starving Laios angers a mysterious elf while hunting for food in Living Paintings. Later, Chilchuck finds himself trapped with a crabby Mimic.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Episode 7: Kelpie/Porridge/Broiled with Sauce
1.plot: Something's fishy on this new dungeon level! The crew crosses a treacherous lake, encountering vicious seafood and fallen adventurers along the way.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Episode 8: Raspberries/Grilled Meat
1.plot: Marcille recalls when she first met Falin as young students. After a quick wash up, an inadvertent misstep lands her in deep water with an angry spirit.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Episode 9: Tentacles/Stew
1.plot: The smell of meat lures in uninvited guests — among them, a familiar face emerges. To move forward, they must work together to defeat the Undine.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - Episode 10: Giant Frogs/Aboveground
1.plot: The crew avoid a stinging descent to the castle town, where the Red Dragon lurks. But to defeat it, they need a tight plan — and a morale-boosting meal.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - Episode 11: Red Dragon I
1.plot: The crew finally faces the Red Dragon, but their grand strategy quickly unravels. With the beast's fury escalating, who will get the final bite?

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - Episode 12: Red Dragon II
1.plot: A desperate search within the dragon's stomach leads to a gruesome discovery, revealing that resurrection magic alone won't be enough to restore Falin.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E13 - Episode 13: Red Dragon III/Good Medicine
1.plot: Falin starts acting strange in the middle of the night, leading Laios and crew to a menacing figure who wants them gone.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E14 - Episode 14: Sea Serpent
1.plot: Back in an upper dungeon level, Kabru and crew wake up to find their supplies missing and are ambushed on their way back to the surface.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E15 - Episode 15: Dryad/Cockatrice
1.plot: Trapped in the dungeon, a concerned Senshi cooks up a nourishing meal for the famished crew — giving Marcille enough energy to come up with a plan.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E16 - Episode 16: Cleaners/Dried with Sweet Sake
1.plot: Chilchuck figures out a way to escape the dungeon, but their ascent is halted by an unexpected encounter with an old friend in dire need of sustenance.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E17 - Episode 17: Harpy/Chimera
1.plot: The parties must band together to fend off an attack by vicious Harpies — but the unexpected appearance of a transformed Falin stuns everyone.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E18 - Episode 18: Shapeshifter
1.plot: While in pursuit of Falin, Laios and crew seek shelter from a blizzard but are overrun by Shapeshifter copies of themselves. How will they spot the fakes?

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E19 - Episode 19: Hag/Nightmare
1.plot: The crew is cornered by an acquaintance who demands help with a beastly problem. Later, Laios enters Marcille's nightmare and discovers her greatest fear.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E20 - Episode 20: Ice Golem/Barometz
1.plot: Izutsumi proves to be a useful ally despite her lousy table manners — and aversion to eating monsters. But the crew's kindness slowly opens her up.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E21 - Episode 21: Egg/The Golden Country
1.plot: With the dungeon's fate hanging in the balance, Kabru negotiates with the elves. Meanwhile, a ghost drags Laios and crew into the cursed Golden Country.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E22 - Episode 22: Griffin/Familiars
1.plot: Leaving the safety of the Golden Country, Senshi ends up in the clutches of a ferocious griffin. The crew must summon help if they want to save him.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E23 - Episode 23: Griffin Soup/Dumplings -1-
1.plot: Back at camp, Senshi finally reveals his painful history with the dungeon. The next day, the crew is rudely awakened by a perplexing transformation.

1.title: EN - Delicious in Dungeon [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E24 - Episode 24: Dumplings -2-/Bacon and Eggs
1.plot: Still wrestling with their new forms, the crew must overcome the gargoyles. Later, they descend deeper into the dungeon. What monsters will they try next?

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - DELETE: TRUST
1.plot: After a startling revelation, Lilly makes her way to see Aim. Later, Lilly seeks her chance to delete her husband using the strange device she found.

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - DELETE: FALSENESS
1.plot: In her search for Orn, Nicha reaches out to Aim. Meanwhile, a scandalous photo makes the headlines — and catches Too's attention.

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - DELETE: HATRED
1.plot: June finds herself in a confrontation with a schoolmate, Tong. She finds comfort when she confides in Lilly about her troubles in boarding school.

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - DELETE: TRUTH

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - DELETE: PAIN

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - DELETE: RAGE
1.plot: Too goes in pursuit of the person who last saw Lilly. Later, Aim is taken aback by an unexpected development.

1.title: EN - Delete [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - DELETE: SECRETS

meta.plot: As her 16th birthday approaches, a not-so-average teen rediscovers the fiery powers she's long suppressed and is forced to face her demons — literally.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Worst Birthday Ever
1.plot: While celebrating her birthday in Korea, Jentry realizes she can still shoot fire from her hands — and that a ruthless demon's out to steal her soul.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Fifteen Minutes of Flame
1.plot: A portal to the underworld in Texas opens the door to unwelcome guests. A burning secret makes Jentry's first day at Riverfork High School even harder.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Girl with a Pearl
1.plot: Jentry's having haunting visions that seem to reveal the past... but where are they coming from? A determined Gugu trains to master a new skill.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Forget the Alamo
1.plot: Ed tags along on a field trip to the Alamo, where the tour guide's frightening re-enactment of a famous battle goes a bit too far.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Some Gui My Prince Will Come
1.plot: Getting closer to Jentry prompts Michael and Kit to think about who they are — and who they really want to be. A new face stalks the halls at school.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - All's Fair in Love and War
1.plot: Deep-fried snacks, a secret Daoist magic market and a towering demon? A day at the State Fair brings big problems to Texas — really, really big.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Into the Zhong
1.plot: While Ed guards the portal to the underworld, Gugu leads Jentry to a dangerous middle realm that holds the answers to questions about her past.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Fifteen Finger Discount
1.plot: Jentry's got a plan to get rid of her powers so she can finally get her life back. But to pull it off, she'll need Kit's help.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Everyone Wins
1.plot: Just when Jentry's starting to feel normal, Michael's worried that he isn't. Spirit Week stirs up big feelings — and plays out on the field with a bang.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - A Night with the Stars
1.plot: Worlds collide in an epic clash as chaos comes to Riverfork, summoning demons to the Homecoming game and putting the whole town in danger.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - Good Intentions
1.plot: A month after the demon attack, Jentry and Ed steal away to Diyu on important family business. But nothing there is quite as it seems.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - Moonie Phases
1.plot: Armed with her mother's memories, Jentry tries to make up for lost time. Meanwhile, the students prepare for a Lock-In at school.

1.title: EN - Jentry Chau vs the Underworld [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E13 - Lock-In
1.plot: Tensions hit a boiling point within the walls of Riverfork High when demons crash the party, forcing Jentry and her friends to fight for their lives.

1.title: FR - Earnhardt - S01E01 - Ironhead
1.plot: Dale rockets to stardom on NASCAR's biggest stage with an unprecedented championship in just his second season, but a series of challenges on and off the track threatens his future. His upbringing inside North Carolina's racing culture sheds light on what drives him, while he and upstart team owner Richard Childress aggressively chart their path back to the top.

1.title: FR - Earnhardt - S01E02 - The Intimidator
1.plot: Dale transforms into 'The Intimidator' as the bad boy of racing chases Richard Petty's record of seven Winston Cup championships. As his legend grows, the intensifying demands of Dale's career fuel tensions within the family—and the life and death stakes of racing soon hit close to home.

1.title: FR - Earnhardt - S01E03 - One Tough Customer
1.plot: Dale's fame and fortune reach new heights as he pursues an eighth championship and an ever-elusive Daytona 500 win. But a younger crop of drivers challenge his reign, and family dynamics become more complicated when the Earnhardt kids set out to follow in their father's footsteps on the track.

1.title: FR - Earnhardt - S01E04 - Dale
1.plot: Father and son unite on the track at the 2001 Daytona 500, leading the pack in a fateful race that becomes a turning point for the family and the entire sport of NASCAR.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E01 - Tell Me Sweet Little Lies
1.plot: Every summer, Cadence Sinclair cherishes her time with her cousins Mirren and Johnny and her best friend Gat on Beechwood Island. At sixteen, what begins as their usual summer of mischief transforms when Cadence and Gat fall in love, while adult tensions rise in her family. She doesn't know this fairy tale will end with her alone on the beach, injured and with no memory of how she got there.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E02 - Wrap Her Up in a Package of Lies
1.plot: Following her mysterious accident, Cadence has suffered a year of illness, amnesia, and loneliness, having had no contact with The Liars. Returning to Beechwood for answers, she finds even her closest friends won't discuss the summer she can't remember. But the island begins triggering memories of Summer 16, starting with a Father's Day celebration marred by rivalry, betrayal, and heartbreak.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E03 - The Ties Were Black, the Lies Were White
1.plot: Having remembered a family tragedy, Cadence presses The Liars for answers. Mirren reveals a crush gone awry, Johnny recalls an unwanted visitor, and Gat recounts their relationship's painful turn. Tension between the aunts continues to rise, and Cadence suspects at least one Liar is hiding something, questioning whether what happened last summer was an accident at all.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E04 - The Fourth of You Lie
1.plot: As the Sinclairs prepare for a quiet Fourth of July, Cadence investigates one of The Liars, uncovering memories of last year's crowded celebration. While the Sinclair sisters vied for their father's approval, The Liars navigated their romantic lives and Ed surprised Carrie. In present day, Cadence discovers a shocking truth about one Liar, leading to a confrontation as explosive as the fireworks.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E05 - Lying Together in a Silver Lining
1.plot: Unsettled by a series of painful memories, Cadence tries to enjoy what's left of her summer – even if it means distracting herself with a potentially dangerous stunt. Despite her best efforts, she remembers a stormy day from Summer 16 when rising seas and frustrations threatened every Sinclair, exposing the family's darker side and forcing Gat and Cadence to confront their unspoken feelings.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E06 - When Lies Gives You Lemons
1.plot: Unable to continue keeping secrets from her, Gat finally opens up to Cadence about his perspective on the island – one that doesn't always reflect the fairy-tale nostalgia of her own experience. While they head into town in search of answers, Gat recounts his memories of an honored Sinclair tradition – Tipper's Lemon Hunt – and the unplanned visit from his mother that made him question everything.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E07 - Everybody Knows That the Captain Lied
1.plot: More uncertain than ever, Cadence reluctantly joins Harris on an excursion, triggering memories of their final confrontation in Summer 16. During a tense family dinner, The Liars confront their mothers about family secrets. In the aftermath of shocking revelations, The Liars mourn their once-beloved childhood playground and unite in an attempt to save their fracturing family.

1.title: FR - Nous les menteurs - S01E08 - My Friends Are Lying in the Sun
1.plot: Cadence devises a plan to trigger her latent memories of the final hours before her traumatic accident, but she can't do it alone – she must convince the reluctant Johnny, Mirren, and Gat to help her, even if it means risking everything. But as the truth begins to come back to her in fits and starts, Cadence realizes that she, herself, has been the biggest Liar of all.

meta.plot: Un an après l’accident qui l'a rendue amnésique, Cadence, 17 ans, retourne à Beechwood, une île au large de Martha's Vineyard, pour trouver des réponses. Trois générations de la famille Sinclair se réunissent dans une utopie estivale privée, mais personne ne veut parler de l'accident – ni ses amis d'enfance, “Les menteurs”, ni son premier amour Gat. Elle doit alors découvrir la vérité toute seule.

1.title: FR - Les Mille Morts de Nora Dalmasso - S01E01 - The Crime
1.plot: In the city of Rio Cuarto, a high-society wife and mother is murdered in her home, sparking a media frenzy that threatens to tear her family apart.

1.title: FR - Les Mille Morts de Nora Dalmasso - S01E02 - The Accused
1.plot: Nora's death is politicized. When a DNA test allegedly incriminates Facundo, a war ignites between the Macarróns and the press. The FBI becomes involved.

1.title: FR - Les Mille Morts de Nora Dalmasso - S01E03 - The Trial

meta.plot: Qui a tué Nora Dalmasso ? Dans cette série sur un crime réel, des membres de sa famille et de la presse se livrent sur son meurtre et sur la tempête médiatique qui a suivi.

1.title: FR - The Waterfront - S01E07 - Nice Try

1.title: FR - The Waterfront - S01E08 - Lost at Sea

meta.plot: Une éminente famille de pêcheurs de Caroline du Nord navigue en eaux troubles pour maintenir à flot son empire commercial en perdition.

Le beau Mitchell est un homme de ménage dans un hôpital, où son timide ami geek George y est quant à lui brancardier. Tous deux aimeraient aller en ville et traîner avec d'autres personnes, mais un petit problème s'oppose à leurs désirs : Mitchell est un vampire, et George un loup-garou ! Les deux jeunes hommes se rapprochent de leurs rêves lorsqu'ils emménagent ensemble et passent leurs soirées devant la télévision, dans leur canapé, bière à la main, comme les autres hommes de leur âge. Malheureusement, ils n'avait pas compté sur la présence d'Annie, le fantôme de la locataire précédente ! Ce trio surnaturel a une chose en commun : un désir désespéré d'être humain.

1.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S01E01 - Flotsam and Jetsam
1.plot: While Mitchell struggles with his growing lust for blood when asked out on a date, Annie has a harder time dealing with her emotions than she thought when she comes face to face with a someone from her past.

1.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S01E02 - Tully

1.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S01E05 - Where the Wild Things Are

2.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S02E08 - All God's Children
2.plot: Will Mitchell save his friends from Jaggat's experiments and will his friends save him?

3.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S03E01 - Lia

3.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S03E02 - Adam's Family

3.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S03E03 - Type 4
3.plot: Confronted with a 'type four', the housemates are forced to stare death in the face.

3.plot: Herrick is back, but is he megalomaniac vampire or defenceless victim?

3.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S03E06 - Daddy Ghoul
3.plot: George is shocked to discover that his father has died, then meets the ghost of George Sr.

3.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S03E07 - Though the Heavens Fall
3.plot: With the full moon looming and a house full of werewolves, pressure mounts on Mitchell.

5.plot: As ghost Alex adjusts to life after death with werewolf Tom and vampire Hal, we meet poisonous pensioner Captain Hatch, behind whose foul exterior lurks an ancient evil.

5.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S05E02 - Sticks and Rope
5.plot: Alex discovers she's not the only ghost haunting Honolulu Heights. Tom and Hal go head to head in the hotel's employee of the month competition, much to the delight of Captain Hatch, who feeds on werewolf / vampire conflict.

5.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S05E03 - Pie and Prejudice
5.plot: Tom learns how to be successful from werewolf mentor Larry, but is Larry everything that he claims to be? Alex discovers some worrying similarities with Hal's Regency ghost friend, Lady Mary.

5.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S05E04 - The Greater Good
5.plot: It's vampire rehab at Honolulu Heights when Crumb comes to stay. Tom has his work cut out reintroducing werewolf Bobby to a world he's long forgotten.

5.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S05E05 - No Care, All Responsibility
5.plot: When a damsel in distress seeks haven at the hotel, Tom and Hal are attracted to her for different reasons. Alex investigates her suspicions about Captain Hatch with dangerous consequences.

5.title: FR - Being Human : La Confrérie de l'étrange - S05E06 - The Last Broadcast
5.plot: Hal is ready to return to his vampire ways and Tom is set on killing him as an act of revenge, but the trio have to battle the devil and Captain Hatch.

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E01 - Crime scene
1.plot: On September 5, 2012, in a parking lot on a forest road in the Alps, a few kilometers from the village of Chevaline, an English family and a French cyclist were found dead, brutally shot. A little girl survived the tragedy and was rushed to the hospital: the killer had left her for dead after striking her on the head. The gendarmerie secured the crime scene and began a meticulous investigation to find any traces the killer might have left behind. A phone call from the owner of the campsite where the English family was staying would change everything.

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E02 - Inheritance
1.plot: The English family killed in the parking lot has been identified: they are the Al-Hillis. Well-established in an upscale suburb of London, nothing seemed to predestine them to such a fate. But investigators quickly uncovered a family dispute that could explain the tragedy: Saad, the victim, and his brother Zaid had clashed over their late father's substantial inheritance, following his death a few months earlier. For the French police, Zaid became the prime suspect, but the English police rejected this theory. Only high-level state intervention seemed capable of moving the investigation forward.

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E03 - In Iraq
1.plot: While everything suggests that the answer lies in the United Kingdom and that the brother may have orchestrated the massacre, new elements emerge, complicating the investigation. Saad had traveled to Baghdad to reclaim a family home and made enemies in Iraq. Hidden hard drives in the family caravan contain a significant amount of confidential data about Saad’s satellite company. Additionally, the discovery of Saad’s wife's astonishing secret life adds another layer of complexity. For the first time in his career, the public prosecutor must collaborate with intelligence services to advance a criminal investigation.

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E04 - So close
1.plot: Long considered a collateral victim of the Chevaline massacre, Sylvain Mollier, the French cyclist also found dead on September 5, has become the primary focus of investigators seeking to explain the tragedy. Those who might have had a motive against him are being investigated one by one. A small village, Ugine, has become the center of an investigation involving more than a hundred investigators. Sylvain Mollier was caught in the middle of a love triangle—passions that sometimes lead to the worst…

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E05 - A swiss weapon
1.plot: After years of investigation, the gendarmes are still facing a mystery. Everything must be started from scratch. A new prosecutor is trying to find the murder weapon, which is quite unique. It is an old Swiss weapon dating back to World War I. Even though it was produced in limited numbers, the search for this weapon is a painstaking task that stretches over months and across multiple countries. Years after the massacre, customs authorities alert the investigation unit: Swiss weapons have been identified, and their owners live near Chevaline. The GIGN is called in for a high-risk arrest—never before have they been so close to their goal.

1.title: FR - Chevaline - S01E06 - He is here
1.plot: The alibis of all identified suspects hold up, but one last unknown remains: the identity of the motorcyclist whom all witnesses claim to have seen near the scene of the massacre on the day it happened. The investigators' latest theory revolves around this motorcyclist. He might be the killer. And if he isn't, he must have either seen the perpetrator or be protecting him. A composite sketch is circulating. The man is being tracked by police forces across France and England. After searching every motorcycle helmet store (witnesses described a very distinctive helmet that was only produced in limited quantities) and scrutinizing all phone records of devices that connected to the area on the day of the massacre, the gendarmerie finally identifies the motorcyclist. His interrogation in police custody leads to astonishing twists.

meta.plot: Le 5 septembre 2012, dans un petit parking de montagne situé près du lac d’Annecy et du village de Chevaline, trois membres d’une famille de vacanciers britanniques et un cycliste de la région sont retrouvés assassinés, tués par balles. Des dizaines de douilles jonchent le sol.

C'est la rentrée des classes pour Peter Parker, un lycéen de 16 ans très doué en sciences mais également l'objet de risée dans son lycée. Ce que tous ignorent par contre, c'est que quelques mois plus tôt, Peter Parker s'est fait piquer par une araignée génétiquement modifiée lui conférant des super pouvoirs. C'est ainsi qu'il est devenu Spider-Man, un super-héros qui a promis de lutter contre le mal dans la ville de New-York suite au meurtre de son oncle Ben.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E01 - Survival of the Fittest
1.plot: While being pursued by the Enforcers, Spider-Man has to protect Norman Osborn from the vengeful supervillain Vulture.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E02 - Interactions
1.plot: When a lab accident transforms Max Dillon into supervillain Electro, he demands that Dr. Martha Connors find a cure as Spider-Man works to stop him.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E03 - Natural Selection
1.plot: When. Dr. Curt Connors' attempt to regenerate a new arm accidentally transforms him into the Lizard, Peter, Martha, Eddie and Gwen search for a cure.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E04 - Market Forces
1.plot: Following orders from Kingpin, Hammerhead hires Montana to steal a high-tech suit and, as the Shocker, destroy Spider-Man.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E05 - Competition
1.plot: As Peter Parker and Harry Osborn try out for the football team, Spider-Man must face convict Flint Marko, newly transformed into the Sandman in order to destroy Spider-Man.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E06 - The Invisible Hand
1.plot: As Otto creates the Rhino as a new distraction for Spider-Man, Peter takes Aunt May's advice and asks Mary Jane Watson to the high school prom.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E07 - Catalysts
1.plot: Peter and Mary Jane are a hit at the Fall Formal. Meanwhile, the Green Goblin's attack on Fisk Industries requires Spider-Man's intervention.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E08 - Reaction

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E09 - The Uncertainty Principle
1.plot: Spider-Man faces off against the Green Goblin and Tombstone. Elsewhere, Col. John Jameson attempts to land a damaged space shuttle.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E10 - Persona
1.plot: Disguised as Spider-Man, the Chameleon embarks on a crime spree that can only be stopped by Spidey and the Black Cat -- together.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E11 - Group Therapy
1.plot: When the Sinister Six escape from prison with plans to take down Spider-Man, they nearly succeed. But Peter wakes up with no memory of the battle.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E12 - Intervention
1.plot: As he struggles with the alien symbiote, Spider-Man's origins are revealed.

1.title: FR - The Spectacular Spider-Man - S01E13 - Nature vs. Nurture
1.plot: Venom -- the merged entity consisting of Eddie Brock and the symbiote -- attacks Spider-Man through the people he loves most.

meta.plot: Caprica est une planète du système Cyrannus, siège des 12 Colonies. Son nom est dérivé de son ancien nom, celui d'avant la colonisation par une tribu de Kobol, Capricorne. En politique, sciences et arts, Caprica est considérée comme la capitale d'une galaxie en paix… ou presque. 58 ans avant le début de Battlestar Galactica, 2 familles y vivaient : les Graystone et les Adama. Deux familles dont les destins se croisent et se mélangent. Deux familles au coeur de la disparition prochaine de l'humanité…

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: On the vibrant world of Caprica, in a culture recognizably close to our own, two dynamic families - the Graystones and the Adamas - live separately on opposite ends of society until they are brought together by tragedy.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E02 - Rebirth
1.plot: Zoe's avatar tries to adapt to her new life inside a robot's body while the Graystones and the Adamas cope with their losses. Elsewhere, Lacy dines with Sister Clarice, and young Will Adama spends some quality time with his shady uncle.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E03 - The Reins of a Waterfall
1.plot: Following Amanda's public revelation that their daughter was responsible for the MAGLEV tragedy, the Graystones must face the wrath of angry Capricans.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E04 - Gravedancing
1.plot: Daniel preps himself to go on the popular Backtalk with Baxter Sarno to put a good spin on his daughter's role in the bombing tragedy, despite protests from Amanda who is unaware that Sam is waiting for his moment to carry out his brother's requested hit.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E05 - There is Another Sky
1.plot: The avatar of Tamara Adama wanders V-World, unaware that she died nearly a month ago in the MagLev bombing and discovers a new side to V-World -- New Cap City, a place where people live random lives of violence and crime in search of the game’s elusive meaning.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E06 - Know Thy Enemy
1.plot: Tomas Vergis confronts Daniel over the theft of the meta-cognitive processor and the two workers who were murdered in the robbery. However, his means of revenge aren't quite what Daniel expects.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E07 - The Imperfections of Memory
1.plot: Amanda’s life spirals out of control as she begins to see visions of her brother, who died years earlier. As a result, Clarice sees an opportunity to gain her trust and we learn a dark secret from Amanda’s past that could have major implications for her life with Daniel.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E08 - Ghost in the Machine
1.plot: Daniel is beginning to suspect that Zoe-Avatar is in the robot, but his pleas for his daughter to reveal herself go ignored. In an effort to flush her out, he launches a campaign of psychological torture, resulting in escalating tests that force Zoe into a choice she cannot take back.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E09 - End of Line
1.plot: When Daniel finally sets a deadline for resetting the U-87 Cylon - and unknowingly ending Zoe-A’s existence as she knows it - she makes a desperate attempt to save herself. But when her plan backfires, she finds herself out of time and out of options.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E10 - Unvanquished
1.plot: Having lost both his wife and company, Daniel approaches the Ha'la'tha with a deal to capitalise on virtual avatars as a means of defeating grief.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E11 - Retribution
1.plot: Daniel's deal with the Ha'la'tha leads to some unpalatable choices.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E12 - Things We Lock Away
1.plot: Lines of loyalty have been drawn. Where do you stand?

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E13 - False Labor
1.plot: Sam Adama's illegal gun trade puts his life in danger, as he turns to an unlikely ally for assistance. Daniel's involvement with the Ha'La'Tha deepens.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E14 - Blowback
1.plot: Lacy's journey to Gemenon turns into a life or death race against the clock. The pressure on Amanda and Duram for evidence mounts as Clarice gets one step closer to Apotheosis.

1.title: FR - Caprica - S01E15 - The Dirteaters
1.plot: Joseph and Sam Adama revisit their past on Tauron and must make a decision about where their loyalties lie. Daniel discovers Zoe's avatar has survived, while Duram is burned at the GDD.

meta.plot: Underbelly, relatant la guerre des gangs qui fit rage entre 1995 et 2004 à Melbourne. On suivait l’ascension de Carl Williams, un petit malfrat, pas très fûté, mais animé d’une violence animale, ancien chauffeur des frères Moran

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E01 - The Black Prince
1.plot: The Melbourne gangland wars start the night the gangster Alphonse Gangitano, "The Black Prince of Lygon Street", and one of the legendary Carlton Crew gang, murders a low-life crim named Greg Workman at a St Kilda party for the sheer hell of it. The charming gangster Alphonse gets away with the murder by convincing two witnesses not to testify but the killing sets the tone for the mayhem that will follow, and sets Alphonse himself on a path to self-destruction.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E02 - The Sorcerer's Apprentice
1.plot: Convinced that Jason Moran was also involved in the nightclub assault, Steve Owens tricks Jason's driver Carl Williams into revealing that he did indeed ferry Jason to and from the scene. Carl Williams takes the first steps towards building his own empire. The police are determined to crack the "Carlton Crew" crime gang.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E03 - I Still Pray
1.plot: Brothers Jason and Mark Moran decide that the Carlton Crew needs to be pulled into the 21st Century. The Moran brothers do a deadly deal to expand their empire while Carl Williams starts his illegal dealings - in direct competition with Jason Moran. As tensions increase, the police convince a young mother to testify in a murder trial - with tragic results. Carl Williams meets the love of his life, Roberta.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E04 - Cocksure
1.plot: Carl Williams is caught red-handed whilst double-crossing the fearsome Moran brothers; the underworld is in an uproar over the mystery source of cheap drugs; a kidnap goes terribly wrong, from farce to disaster, when nobody wants to pay the victim's ransom, which only adds to the tension.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E05 - The Good, The Bad, The Ugly
1.plot: Carl Williams begins his deadly revenge on the crime-controlling Carlton Crew, and tries to increase his ever-expanding grip over the Melbourne crime world; whilst Jason Moran is in jail, his brother Mark takes control of the family business; Detective Steve Owen is determined to prove an underworld murder.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E06 - Luv U 4 Eva
1.plot: Lewis Moran hires Benji Veniaman to execute his son's, Mark Moran's killer. Subsequently, Veniamen is insulted by the Carton Crew and forms a dangerous alliance with their unpredictable rival Carl Williams; Steve and Jacqui's police instincts are tested when they try to disprove a murderer's alibi; when a criminal is shot dead multiple times, the Police realise there's a monster on the loose.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E07 - Wise Monkeys
1.plot: With their men in jail or dead, the women who love gangsters try to get on with their lives. With Carl Williams in prison, a rival crime boss tries to undermine his empire. A young lawyer falls for her client, a convicted killer linked to the Carlton Crew. The police make a major breakthrough in identifying the mystery hitman they know only as “Benji".

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E08 - Earning A Crust
1.plot: Amid growing public unrest, the police establish Task Force Purana to combat the gangland war. Loan shark Mario Condello faces his own financial crisis, which he solves with brutal efficiency. Bitter rivals Carl Williams and Jason Moran take out contracts on each other’s life. Taskforce Purana detectives are furious when police corruption derails their investigations.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E09 - Suffer the Children
1.plot: Jason Moran returns from self-imposed exile, determined to destroy his rival Carl Williams; death stalks a children's football match; Taskforce Purana finally gets the resources it needs to defeat the criminals; Benji is under constant police surveillance, so Carl is forced to find a new accomplice; Carl and Roberta celebrate their daughter's christening with a lavish party.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E10 - Scratched
1.plot: Carl Williams is now the undisputed king of the underworld, confident he can get away with murder; the police make the first major breakthrough in their investigations, but they may be too late to prevent another death; Benji's relationship with Carl and Roberta becomes increasingly personal.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E11 - Barbarians at the Gate
1.plot: Carl uses his high media profile to accuse Detective Steve Owen of corruption; Graham "Munster" Kinniburgh is gunned down and Mick Gatto tries to convince Carl Williams to end the gangland war; "Benji" Veniamin agrees to kill his former mentor Mick Gatto, but it's Gatto who lives to tell the tale; Carl and Roberta are rocked by the death of their closest friend.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E12 - Best Laid Plans
1.plot: Lewis Caine vows to avenge his best mate Benji's death, but can't trust his new colleagues; lawyer Zarah Garde-Wilson's plans for a romantic future are shattered when her lover is killed; Taskforce Purana finally gets the upper hand in their investigations.

1.title: FR - Underbelly - S01E13 - Team Purana
1.plot: Detective Steve Owen finally gets enough evidence to arrest Carl Williams for murder. After nine years the gangland war is over.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E01 - Aussie Bob & Kiwi Terry
2.plot: In the mid 1970s, Kiwi charmer Terry Clark and "Aussie" Bob Trimbole form a deadly alliance that will change the face of Australian crime forever.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E02 - Bad Habits
2.plot: Anti-drugs campaigner Donald Mackay makes deadly enemies with the Griffith mafia and corrupt NSW police. Melbourne crim Ray Chuck plans Australia's most audacious heist - the Great Bookie Robbery.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E03 - Brave New World
2.plot: A naive young Kiwi, Allison Dine, is swept off her feet by Terry Clark, becoming his lover, and most inventive drug courier.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E04 - Business as Usual
2.plot: Melbourne standover men Brian and Les Kane have ventured into unfamiliar territory by providing protection for Bob Trimbole's Melbourne heroin dealers. But things turn sour when dealer Wayne Robb is robbed of $200,000 cash on the Kane's turf. The Kane's suspect it was Vinnie Mikkelsen and Laurie Prendergast, two of Ray Chuck's mates from the Great Bookie Robbery.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E05 - A Tale of Two Hitmen
2.plot: Brian Kane plans Australia's most audacious gangland murder to avenge the death of his brother Les. Meanwhile, Ray Chuck forms an alliance with Mark "Chopper" Read in a Melbourne jail. Also, aspiring hitman Chris Flannery finally gets his big break and Terry's growing drug empire is under threat from problems in Australia and Singapore.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E06 - Stranded
2.plot:
When Terry is arrested after a boisterous party in a Brisbane luxury hotel, its an old New Zealand criminal charge that sees him extradited for trial in his home country. There he meets the striking Karen Soich, a member

of his legal team, and its quickly clear that the

attraction is mutual.

With Terry gone temporarily, Allison takes the reins in Australia, organising new couriers to ensure business stays booming.

Meanwhile, trusted drug couriers Doug and Isabel Wilson use Terrys absence to clear their consciences and tell all to the cops. Its only when Terry is acquitted in New Zealand

that the Wilsons realise the potential consequences of their actions. What Terry doesnt know doesnt hurt him, but Terrys on his way back, hes got contacts everywhere and if he finds out the Wilsons dobbed, they're in deep trouble.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E07 - A Nice Little Earner
2.plot: In episode seven of Underbelly, Terry decides to franchise his crime empire and expand into the UK market. Aussie Bob goes to extreme lengths to buy out Terry's share of the Organisation.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E08 - Diamonds
2.plot: Allison questions her role in the Mr Asia syndicate after her life is threatened by a corrupt Federal Narcotics Bureau agent. Colourful racing identity, George Freeman, takes extreme action after police raid his illegal casinos. The Mr Asia syndicate suffers a major setback when a drug courier is arrested.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E09 - Judas Kiss
2.plot: Aussie Bob Trimbole is pressured to arrange a gangland hit on his friend and colleague, Allison Dine. Meanwhile, paranoid and living in exile in the UK, Terry Clark must terminate his relationship with "Mr Asia". Also, George Freeman is determined to get revenge on his would be assassin, and aspiring hitman "Mr Rent-a-kill" gets his big break.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E10 - The Reckoning
2.plot: Terry Clark's drug empire starts to unravel when he is arrested for murder in the UK, while Allison is arrested by the FBI and becomes a star witness against organised crime. With his heroin supplies drying up, Aussie Bob plans Australia's biggest ever cannabis smuggling operation. Meanwhile, the Federal Police have a major win against corruption at the Narcotics Bureau.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E11 - The Brotherhood
2.plot: The Federal Police prepare to arrest crime boss and cancer sufferer Aussie Bob Trimbole. But a mole within the Feds threatens to create havoc with their investigation. Also, Alison Dine testifies at a coroner's inquest, and blows the lid on the Mr Asia syndicate.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E12 - O Lucky Man
2.plot: Australia's most dangerous hitman, Chris "Mr Rent-a-Kill" Flannery, moves to Sydney to build his deadly reputation. Terry Clark's UK murder trial reaches a sensational climax, but can Allison testify against her former lover? Meanwhile, Aussie Bob gets involved in arms smuggling for the IRA.

2.title: FR - Underbelly - S02E13 - The Loved Ones
2.plot: In the series finale of Underbelly, Chris "Mr Rent-a-Kill" Flannery becomes a victim of his own success. But who would dare order a hit on Australia's most dangerous hit man?

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E01 - Into the Mystic
3.plot: Ambitious teenager John Ibrahim earns respect when he cheats death and buys into his first nightclub. Naive country girl Kim Hollingsworth takes her first steps into prostitution, starting a chain of events that will rock the Golden Mile.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E02 - The Crucible
3.plot: Corrupt detectives organise an elaborate drug "sting" for their own profit. Meanwhile, senior police fear rampant corruption could lead to a royal commission.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E03 - Kingdom Come
3.plot: John Ibrahim dodges death after being shot, and gets some powerful career advice from George Freeman. Detective Trevor Haken strikes a profitable deal to control the drug trade in Kings Cross. Kim turns her back on prostitution and applies to join the NSW Police.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E04 - Fall Guy
3.plot: Kim Hollingsworth organises a strip show for a police charity. Smalltime bouncer Benny Kassab has an audacious plan to become King of the Cross. Bill and Louis Bayeh fight off threats to their drug dealing empire. Trevor Haken's alcoholism takes a toll on his marriage and his ability to manage police corruption.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E05 - Saving Face
3.plot: Louis Bayeh vows to avenge the drive-by shooting of his house. Debbie Webb becomes a whistleblower on police corruption, with shocking results. Kim Hollingsworth plans revenge on a police officer who betrayed her trust.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E06 - Women In Uniform
3.plot: Corrupt cop Dennis Kelly tries to further his career by joining the National Crime Authority. With her career in tatters, whistleblower Debbie Webb makes a fateful decision to join the fraud squad. Fed-up with prostitution, Kim Hollingsworth considers her career options.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E07 - Full Force Gale
3.plot: John Ibrahim is under pressure following a spate of gang violence on the Golden Mile. Debbie Webb finds a powerful ally in her fight against police corruption. Kim Hollingsworth tests the loyalty of her new boyfriend with a sexy challenge. Dennis Kelly uses all his cunning to turn a corruption allegation into a career opportunity.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E08 - Crossroads
3.plot: Kim Hollingsworth finally reaches breaking point when her friend Wanda is found dead. Politician John Hatton achieves his goal of a Royal Commission into police corruption, and the announcement of a Royal Commission has an unexpected bonus for John Ibrahim.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E09 - Dog Eat Dog
3.plot: Under pressure from the Royal Commission, Trevor Haken's paranoia reaches new heights. Drug boss Benny Kassab suspects a rat in the ranks, with deadly results. Police cadet Kim Hollingsworth is haunted by her colourful past.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E10 - Hurt On Duty
3.plot: Supergrass Trevor Haken risks everything to gather evidence against his mates. Chook Fowler takes bizarre steps to avoid testifying on police corruption. Kim Hollingsworth's police career is jeopardised when she agrees to go undercover for the Royal Commission.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E11 - Beauty and the Beast
3.plot: Corrupt cop Dennis Kelly betrays his best mate to the Royal Commission, with tragic results. Gerry Lloyd makes a deadly deal with drug boss Shaka to expose corruption on the Golden Mile. Kim risks her life by going undercover for the Royal Commission. When the operation ends, she receives a shocking reward.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E12 - The Good Lieutenant
3.plot: Danny "DK" Karam recruits his own private army to terrorise the Golden Mile. Ruthless newcomer Doc Kanaan stages a bloody coup to seize control of the drug trade from DK. With the corrupt cops banished from the Golden Mile, gang violence spirals out of control.

3.title: FR - Underbelly - S03E13 - Alpha and Omega
3.plot: In the explosive final episode, Doc Kanaan plots to kill John Ibrahim and gain control of the Golden Mile. Joe Dooley and Strike Force Lancer smash DK's Boys and restore order to Kings Cross. Dennis Kelly hires a hitman to clean up his dirty past, as he lobbies for the job of Police Commissioner. Kim risks her life to avenge her unfair dismissal from the police force.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E01 - The Worst Woman in Sydney
4.plot: The true story of glamorous crime queens Tilly Devine and Kate Leigh, and their deadly battle to control Sydney's underworld in the 1920s.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E02 - Whips and Scorpions
4.plot: The true story of glamorous crime queens Tilly Devine and Kate Leigh, and their deadly battle to control Sydney's underworld in the 1920s.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E03 - Cat Amongst the Pigeons
4.plot: Norman Bruhn's Razor Gang pushes the underworld to crisis point, threatening the crime empires of Kate, Tilly and Phil Jeffs. Amid public outrage, the police fight a losing battle to stop rival Razor Gangs terrorising the streets. The rival underworld bosses convene a summit to deal with Bruhn's gang, but are betrayed when Tilly takes matters into her own hands. After being rejected by Nellie and taunted by his rivals, Frank 'The Little Gunman' Green finally gets his chance to shine.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E04 - The Damage Done
4.plot: Furious over Tilly's decision to kill Norman Bruhn, Kate sparks an all-out war by recruiting Tilly's prostitutes to sell cocaine. Snowy Cutmore returns to Melbourne for a fateful showdown with crime boss Squizzy Taylor. Fresh from his first kill, Frank 'The Little Gunman' Green wins the ultimate prize — Nellie Cameron. But can he keep her?

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E05 - The Darlinghurst Outrage
4.plot: Phil Jeffs faces the hangman's noose for a scandalous crime that has all of Razorhurst guessing.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E06 - Blood Alley
4.plot: The rivalry between Kate Leigh and Phil Jeffs reaches boiling point, leading to a legendary street battle between their rival gangs. Jeffs is determined to put Kate and Tilly out of business by poisoning their cocaine supply and slashing their workers. The police create Australia's first drug squad to fight the deadly cocaine epidemic, and Kate starts an affair with a sexy young gangster, angering her faithful lieutenant Wally.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E07 - Tripe and Brains
4.plot: With Kate Leigh in prison, Tilly devises a radical new strategy for taking control of Razorhurst. Meanwhile, Wally faces an uphill battle to protect Kate's business and family interests while she is in prison. A dashing nightclub singer pledges his undying love to Nellie Cameron, with tragic results. And Black Aggie is publicly humiliated in a bar-room brawl with Nellie but finds love from an unlikely source.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E08 - A Big Shivoo
4.plot: Black Aggie strikes up a romance with Greg “the Gunman” Gaffney and gives-up prostitution. But she’s still dirty on Nellie for putting her out of work, so she fronts her with a cut-throat razor. Frank Green intervenes and gives Aggie thrice as many cuts and bruises than she started out with.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E09 - The Crash
4.plot:
Fresh out of prison, Kate Leigh puts a bounty on the heads of Tilly's husband, Big Jim Devine, and her chief henchman, Frank Green, as payback for the murder of Greg Gaffney and the razor attack on Bruce Higgs. In a pre-emptive reprisal Tilly vows to eliminate Kate's muscle before they eliminate hers.

Meanwhile, Kate learns the truth about her son-in-law and is forced to take action that will drive her own daughter away.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E10 - The Sentimental Bloke
4.plot:
Wally becomes an outcast when he gives evidence against Tilly's gunman.

Big Jim is desperate to hide his cowardice from the rest of Razorhurst, while Kate shoots to kill when she is the victim of a home invasion.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E11 - Jerusalem Revisited
4.plot: Tillys decision to visit London has dire consequences for her business and marriage. With Tilly in London, Kate moves to seize control of the drug trade. Fresh from prison, Guido is determined to become the Al Capone of Australia; and the police suspect they have a traitor in their ranks.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E12 - Big Moves
4.plot:
Big Jim faces the noose over the attempted murder of his wife but at the 11th hour Tilly refuses to testify against her husband and the charges are dropped.

The ultra-nationalist New Guard are proving such a danger to his government that Premier Jack Lang guarantees Bill Mackay the new title of NSW Police Commissioner if he can stamp them out.

His wife having left him and taken the kids, Frank throws in his lot with Nellie and the pair try to escape Razorhurst for a new life in Queensland.

Guido Calletti's ambitious plans to seize Kate's cocaine supply are forgotten when he and Frank clash over Nellie yet again.

4.title: FR - Underbelly - S04E13 - Armageddon
4.plot: After a decade of gang warfare, Kate and Tilly have their final showdown. Phil Jeffs returns from exile and vows to drive Kate Leigh out of business. Frank and Guido fight to the death over the love of Nellie Cameron, and Razorhurst celebrates the grand opening of the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E01 - Thy Will Be Done
5.plot: When a prisoner is abducted and murdered while on day-release, police embark on a massive man-hunt to find the killers. The 10-year investigation leads them to a ruthless underworld boss who is totally invisible to the police and the legitimate world.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E02 - Cut Snake and Crazy
5.plot: Taskforce Tuno cultivates a dangerous and unpredictable informant in their hunt for Terry Falconer's killers.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E03 - The Loaded Dog
5.plot: The police have a major breakthrough on locating Anthony Perish after Frank agrees to go undercover. Perish arranges a chilling summit meeting with a bikie boss, and one of Perish's henchmen gets a lesson in obedience.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E04 - Year of the Rooster
5.plot: When Strikeforce Tuno is disbanded, Gary devises a new strategy to solve the Falconer murder. The police finally track down Anthony Perish and arrest him, but Rooster proves more elusive than ever. Pam is stretched to breaking point with Gary.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E05 - Troubleshooting
5.plot: A car dealer's life becomes a nightmare when he befriends a charming new customer, Anthony Perish. Decker goes to extreme lengths to prove his loyalty to The Company. Camille comes face-to-face with Perish while undercover at the Mudgee vineyards.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E06 - Road to Nowhere
5.plot: Gary and Tim travel to Queensland in an attempt to stop an underworld execution. Undies goes into business for himself, with disastrous consequences. Newlywed Decker is drawn back into working for Anthony Perish.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E07 - Bang, Bang, Kill, Kill
5.plot:
Unaware he is under police surveillance, Decker juggles two different hit-man contracts with the impending birth of his baby. Police get a crucial breakthrough in the hunt for Anthony Perish.

5.title: FR - Underbelly - S05E08 - Strike Force Tuno
5.plot: Nine years after the death of Terry Falconer, the case against the Perish brothers appears doomed when Decker refuses to co-operate. Frank O'Rourke risks his life to testify against Anthony Perish.
