1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Father Jacob is approached by a young girl who believes her father is possessed by the devil. Although he is initially skeptical, Jacob is forced to take extraordinary steps to ensure her safety by staging a dramatic exorcism, despite the misgivings of his church colleagues.

1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Jacob realises that Vimal's friends could be next after he is found dead. Jacob realises that in able to exorcise the murderer he will have to meet him on his terms.

1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Jacob visits a prisoner who could be possessed. Jacob is surprised though when he discovers the man might be possessed by a saint.

1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Father Jacob is called to a woman's health centre where supernatural forces appear to be at work.

1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: When a young Muslim, Zaid, claims to see visions of the Virgin Mary, Jacob is sceptical. But when the boy also claims to have seen visions of his dead father suffering in hell, Jacob is convinced that Satan is tricking the boy. Zaid holds his imam hostage in order for Jacob to perform a reverse exorcism, to free Zaid's father from hell. Cardinal Bukovak advises they go ahead with the ritual, despite Jacob's misgivings and the potentially catastrophic consequences...

1.title: FR - Apparitions [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: After performing the reverse exorcism, Jacob is unable to complete Mass. Cardinal Bukovak calls in a psychologist to assess Jacob, but Jacob realises what is needed: he needs to be exorcised himself.

meta.plot: Après qu'on lui ait tiré dessus, Alex Drake, flic de son état, est propulsée dans les années 80 ! Elle y découvre un monde nouveau, peuplé de gens habillés comme dans Deux flics à Miami et écoutant une musique depuis longtemps tombée dans l'oubli... Comme si cela ne suffisait pas, Alex est obligée de faire équipe avec un certain Gene Hunt afin de résoudre des crimes ! Entre la sexy et ambitieuse Alex et cette brute épaisse, la cohabitation s'annonce explosive...

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Deja Vu
1.plot:
DI Alex Drake is taken hostage and shot, and wakes up in a brothel... in 1981. Rescued in a police raid, she quickly recognises DCI Gene Hunt and his team from detailed reports made by DCI Sam Tyler about his own trip to 1973.

Gene is determined to address London's growing drugs problem, and has targeted city playboy Edward Markham as the brains behind the operation. Alex suspects Arthur Layton, the man who kidnapped her in 2008. Could Layton be the key to her return to her own time?

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Happy Day
1.plot: DCI Hunt is determined to keep a lid on protests against the London Docklands development. When a suspected member of the London Liberation Front is arrested, Alex asks her mother, a lawyer, to defend him. Meanwhile, Prince Charles is marrying Lady Diana Spencer and the in-crowd is partying at the Blitz Club.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Nothing Changes
1.plot: Fresh from a successful drugs bust, Gene and the team investigate a prostitute's rape allegation. A dangerous serial attacker may be at large, but the case is hampered by an unreliable witness and the suspect's connections.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - The Missing Link
1.plot: CID investigate a murder, and discover a plot to sell stolen nuclear secrets to the Revolutionary Workers Front. When Gene and Alex get trapped in a secret Government facility at Edgehampton, the temperature rises.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - The Smoking Gun
1.plot: Gene and Alex discover that a notorious pimp and drug dealer has a major firearms deal in the pipeline. In an attempt to locate him, the team go undercover in a gay club, and Ray goes beyond the call of duty to get his man.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Over the Hill
1.plot: An armed robbery leads Gene to Chas Cale, a criminal he tried to bring down in Manchester. But when Chas reveals his alibi, Gene begins to wonder if he is past his prime as a DCI. Alex sends Ray and Chris undercover at the local pub in order to solve the case.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Charity Begins At Home
1.plot: The team investigates the armed robbery of a fundraiser who has been travelling across the country in a bathtub full of baked beans to raise money for Children in Need. Alex thinks that a crime reconstruction on Police Five will do the trick, but Gene prefers some old-fashioned police work.

1.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Alex's Big Day
1.plot: Alex is determined to prevent the murder of her parents in a car bomb attack. Gene, meanwhile, is determined to give a good impression to a visiting Lord Scarman, but the station is still dealing with the aftermath of a Gay Pride demonstration.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E01 - Found in Soho
2.plot: When a dead man is found in a Soho strip club, it looks like a sex game has gone wrong. So when the deceased is discovered to be a police officer, Gene and Alex are ordered to keep the case under wraps.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E02 - Reckless Driving
2.plot:
The team is on the hunt for major vehicle thief Jed Wicklow, but when a car chase leads to his death, Gene stands accused of causing it through reckless driving.

Alex is adamant that there was something wrong with Jed at the wheel and wants to prove that the crash wasn't Gene's fault. The deceased Jed was a Romany gypsy, and hostilities run high on the camp as CID heavy-handedly try to uncover the circumstances of his death. But in an investigation that's already met with resistance, someone in the police force also appears to be standing in their way.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E03 - Fight for their Rights
2.plot:
Animal rights activists have threatened a series of attacks in London and the first victim, the daughter of a commercial laboratory owner, is in hospital. Gene orders his team not to sleep until those responsible are behind bars.

Their first stop is a prison where Robin Elliot, a known animal rights campaigner, is serving time for killing a scientist in the 1970s. Alex is convinced that Robin knows about the planned attacks, but with no contact with the outside world, there doesn't appear to be any way for him to be involved. Robin's eerily prescient knowledge of the future makes Alex think that he could be involved not only with the case, but with her own fate; having heard the voices of ambulancemen, Alex worries that hope is fading for her survival in the present day.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E04 - Gene's Queen
2.plot: A face from Gene's old stomping ground of Manchester shows up called Jackie Queen. Jackie is a reporter who is investigating teenagers who traveled to London from the north and have disappeared.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E05 - Blood Staines
2.plot:
When a violent burglary occurs at Alex's in-laws' house, she comes face-to-face with their son Peter, the 14-year-old future father of Molly! Alex is desperate to help Molly's grandparents all she can, but Gene wants a big collar to bury the press stories of police corruption, and dismisses the case as trivial.

When the fingerprints from the crime scene reveal the burglar was George Staines, a notorious gangster, now supposedly dead, Gene realises this could be the catch he was after. Alex remembers hearing stories about the burglary, and is convinced that she would remember if the culprit was as infamous as Staines. Gene is determined to uncover the truth and get the headline he deserves.

Alex finally meets the mysterious man who has been leaving roses in her apartment and office. He tells her that she can go home to see her daughter again, but involves her becoming corrupt.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E06 - Truth Canal
2.plot: After a dead body is found in the canal it is identified as Colin Mitchell. Alex is certain that the dead man's wife Donna is not telling everything and she is determined to uncover the truth. Back in 2008, Alex has surgery to remove the bullet from her brain.

2.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S02E07 - Traitor
2.plot: CID find a body buried in concrete as they investigate a drugs drop at a building site. Alex thinks she is getting better and will soon wake up in her own time. Working on the case though starts to clash with her wish to be back home.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Alex soon realises she has not returned home after all, and wakes up in 1983. Gene is on the run, and DCI Jim Keats has arrived from Complaints to investigate CID following the shooting. Newly-promoted DI Ray Carling leads an investigation into the kidnapping of a young girl, and sets up a sting operation. Alex decides that she will have to discover the truth about Gene if she is ever to get back to her own time.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: A severed hand is sent to Fenchurch station. Discovering that several women have been murdered, Alex decides to join the dating agency they all used. Alex tries to discover the truth about Sam Tyler's death, but Gene is obstructive.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Gene and the rest of CID are feeling the pressure to stop a series of politically motivated arson attacks in the lead up to the 1983 General Election, after a military compound and a polling station are set alight. DCI Jim Keats announces his plans to monitor the way Hunt and his team work while trying to turn each member of of the team against Gene. Elsewhere, Alex continues to mount her investigation into what really happened to Sam Tyler in 1980 and is struggling to work out why she is being haunted by the young police officer.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Gene discovers that an undercover operation to catch several drug dealers is taking place on his patch without his knowledge. Determined to take control Hunt blows the cover of an undercover operative who turns up at CID and is eventually placed under his protection, yet it seems someone on the inside is twisting things to help the drug dealers stay out on the streets. Meanwhile, the deceased police officer continues to haunt Alex. Could he actually be her key to getting home?

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: When DCI Gene Hunt's former Manchester colleagues, DCI Litton and DI Bevan, turn up on his patch he immediately smells a rat. They're in pursuit of northern comic Frank Hardwick who's wanted for stealing 2,000 pounds from the Police Widows Fund. However, their desperation to track him down leaves Gene and DI Alex Drake suspicious of their real motive.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: All hell has broken loose at Fenchurch East prison; the inmates are rioting and DCI Gene Hunt is ready to go in all guns blazing to teach the lags a lesson. However, things don't go to plan; the riot team are hugely outnumbered, and in the chaos of the retreat someone is left behind.

3.title: FR - Ashes to Ashes [VOSTFR] - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot:
DCI Jim Keats has almost finished his report into DCI Gene Hunt and his team, but he's still pushing DI Alex Drake to find out what really happened to Sam Tyler.

When reports come in of a disturbance at an ANC illegal drinking den Gene heads in all guns blazing. The men at the club are quick to dismiss the disturbance as nothing, but when DI Ray Carling spots blood on the floor and discovers a dead body, it leads Gene into a murder investigation.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Megan Smith, a recent graduate from Yale University unable to find success in the journalism field, accepts a job offer from Laurel Limoges - tutoring her two snobby, stuck-up billionaire twin granddaughters with the hopes of getting them into Duke University.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E02 - All About Honesty
1.plot: Megan is ecstatic to be attending a gala event of the rich and famous, where Laurel introduces her to several influential individuals. However, the event turns sour when Megan gets into a heated argument with her sister Lily, Rose spots her ex-boyfriend with another girl, and Megan has to rescue both Rose and Sage after the two get caught driving without a license.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E03 - All About What You Really, Really Want
1.plot: After Rose is told that she must repeat her freshman year of high school due to poor grades, Megan visits the headmaster and tries to get her a second chance. However, a connection sparks between the headmaster and Megan and she later accepts to go out with him - causing Charlie to feel jealous.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E04 - All About the Power Position
1.plot: Megan is shocked when she finds an adult DVD in Rose's bookbag, but even more shocked when Rose reveals that she is not a virgin and is planning on having sex with her current boyfriend. Meanwhile, Sage invites Lily out to a restaurant to dig up dirt on Megan and the two end up drinking together, something that infuriates Megan. Finally, Megan is worried when she thinks that Jacob might be losing interest in her.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E05 - All About Friends and Family
1.plot: Laurel gives Megan the task of chaperoning the twins' pool party, thus forcing her to cancel plans for a spa weekend with Jacob. Meanwhile, Charlie confesses to Marco that he is in love with Megan, and Megan is convinced by Rose to invite Lily to the pool party.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E06 - All About Appearances
1.plot: Megan's relationship issues with the opposite sex reach a new level when she realizes that Jacob is still interested in his ex-girlfriend and Charlie decides to put the brakes on their friendship. Meanwhile, Laurel is persuaded by Megan to include Sage and Rose in her marketing campaign.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E07 - All About the Haves and the Have Nots
1.plot: Megan is concerned that Rose and Sage don't have enough extra-curricular activities to get into Duke, so she arranges for them to volunteer with a charity that provides prom dresses to under-privileged girls. Rose and Sage make a mess of the dresses they are supposed to alter, but they fix the problem in their own unique style. Meanwhile, Megan decides the time has come to reconnect with her estranged father and invites him to dinner at the estate. Megan asks Marco to prepare dinner for two, but when Lily, Will, Rose and Sage also show up for dinner, the party goes surprisingly well until Sage catches Lily in an embarrassing situation. Megan comes to a new understanding with her dad, but later that night, she has a nasty confrontation with her best friend Charlie.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E08 - All About Defining Yourself
1.plot: Megan tells Laurel she wants to write a biography about her, but Laurel wants to hire a ghost writer to write the book which makes Megan feel left out. But later, Megan investigates and learns a dark secret from Laurel's past. Meanwhile, Rose and Sage have different goals when Sage hires a publicist, named Patty Kingston, to boost their fame careers when Rose thinks school is more important.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E09 - All About Insecurities
1.plot: Megan is thrilled when her former college roommate Caryn visits and updates her on her present career, which prompts Megan to think about her own life and where it might lead. She also confides in Caryn about her interest in Will, who has taken a job as an assistant photographer for a magazine editor, and who is not aware of his wealthy background. Meanwhile, Rose and Sage's publicist books them for their first gig as a singing act at a prestigious nightclub where Sage becomes jealous that Rose will eclipse her in the spotlight.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E10 - All About Overcompensating
1.plot: Megan becomes more uncertain about where she stands in her growing romance with Will when he claims to have dated a lot more that she has, So, Megan asks Charlie's latest girlfriend, Mandy, to set her up on a blind date with one of her co-workers. Meanwhile, Rose gets a 'D' on her English exam and plots to keep herself from failing her upcoming history exam by stealing a copy of the test, and Sage devises a crafty plan so Rose will not get caught. Elsewhere, Laurel confides in Megan about her long-lost romance with her one-time boss, while Megan also learns that Lily is now dating her irresponsible punk boyfriend again.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E11 - All About Love, Actually
1.plot: Megan decides to punish Rose after learning that she tried to cheat on her history exam by grounding her, which is not an easy thing to carry out when Rose takes her punishment a little too seriously. Meanwhile, Laurel travels to Santa Barbara, California to rekindle with an old flame, named Miles Franklin, who follows her back to Florida. Charlie has doubts about living with Mandy at his place. Also, the family chef, Marco, gets a new partner in the kitchen: Charlie's cousin, Louis, whom clashes with the demanding and snobbish Sage. Elsewhere, Will tries to make his romance with Megan work when his work plans change.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E12 - All About the Ripple Effect
1.plot: Megan becomes more neurotic and uncomfortable when her eccentric and estranged mother Shelby, whom she hasn't seen in 16 years, suddenly shows up to visit Arthur. Megan instead confides in Charlie about her problems, which makes Will feel left out and a little jealous over Megan's friendliness with Charlie. Megan also learns that Lily has eloped with her punk boyfriend, which makes Megan feel that she's losing control even more. Meanwhile, Rose asks Marco to help set up Sage with the sous chief Louis, while Sage makes a bet with Rami the doorman to try to set up Rose with her old boyfriend Zack.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E13 - All About What Lies Beneath
1.plot: Hoping to spend more time with Luis, Sage and Rose plan a charity dinner for Cuban refugees. Megan comes clean to her mother about her feelings of abandonment. Charlie returns to school, spurning jealousy from Mandy when he seeks Megan's help. Megan learns that Lily has been arrested.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E14 - All About Tough Love
1.plot: Megan seeks to aid her sister, and in so doing learns why Lily is in jail. Will offers to bail Lily out, but both Arthur and Megan refuse saying that Lily should learn a lesson by staying in jail for her long history of making the same dumb mistakes and getting involved with the wrong people. Shelby secretly meets with Will behind Megan's back to ask for his assistance, and he agrees to help... only to find out later what Shelby's real reason is. Meanwhile, Rose helps Sage pick out a lavish gift for Luis to further get his attention, but neither sister foresees his reaction, while at the same time, Rose finds a love poem and assumes that her nebish classmate Zack wrote it for her.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E15 - All About the Big Picture
1.plot: When Megan tells Will that her mother has disappeared again, along with his money, Will suggests that it's time for Megan to separate herself from her family's problems. However, Megan is heartsick that Arthur is in denial about the situation and Lily is angry and hurt that she didn't even get to see her mother. When a picture of Rose and Sage with bassist Pete Wentz of the band Fallout Boy at a nightclub upsets Rose's boyfriend Zach, Sage has to admit that her pursuit of fame is taking a big toll on their social lives. Meanwhile, Laurel gives Marco the money to start his own restaurant, but he realizes that isn't what he really wants. Finally, Megan meets Will's parents, Elliot and Josephine, and feels guilty for involving Will with her own dysfunctional family, but Will surprises Megan with a declaration of his true feelings for her.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E16 - All About Confessions
1.plot: When Charlie announces that he will be leaving down to go back to college in San Diego, Megan's natural neurotic reaction is that she fears she will never see her best friend again. Then one evening during planning for a going away party for Charlie that his girlfriend, Mandy, planning, Charlie kisses Megan and expresses that he loves her which fills her with conflicting emotions, and fills Will with anger and jealousy. Meanwhile, Sage tells Louis that she happens to be a virgin, and gets a surprise when he tells her the same about him, and in an attempt to understand her better, invites her to his church. Also, Rose confides in Zack that she is not a virgin, and he reveals the same about him... And a twist comes when Rose gets a visit from Elyse, the daughter of Miles Franklin where she confides the secret that Miles is her late mother's natural father.

1.title: FR - Privileged - S01E17 - All About Betrayal
1.plot: Rose tells Sage the truth about who their grandfather is, causing a confrontation between Laurel and the twins. Laurel gets more bad luck when Elyse Valencour, Miles Franklin's daughter, brings a lawsuit against her for emotional distress against her father when she informs her that Miles has been hospitalized from a fatal heart attack. Sage also confides in Rose that she feels indirectly responsible for their parents death years earlier. Meanwhile, Will's father decides to start a new magazine and Megan wants to contribute to the first issue. But Megan and Will soon meet the editor-in-chief, David Besser, whom is much harder to please than anticipated. However, the strain on both Will and Megan for the same job puts a strain on their relationship. Elsewhere, Marco goes to drastic measures to win Keith back when he finds him living with his best friend Jennifer who wants to get romantically together with Keith to start a family.

meta.plot: À 23 ans, Megan Smith, tout juste diplômée de l'Université Yale, souhaite devenir journaliste pour un grand magazine new-yorkais. Cependant, tout ne se passe comme prévu et le seul poste qu'elle obtient est celui de pigiste dans un tabloïd. Elle finit par se faire renvoyer de ce tabloïd et rencontre la reine des cosmétiques, Laurel Limoges, qui l'engage comme préceptrice pour ses deux petites-filles, Rose et Jade Baker. Megan s'installe ainsi à Palm Beach et se trouve plongée dans l'univers luxueux et complexe de ce lieu mythique avec pour objectif de réussir à faire entrer les filles à l'Université Duke et de lancer sa carrière d'écrivaine et de journaliste.
Follow Yolanthe Cabau's journey from Dutch fame to a fresh start in LA as she uncovers her past and seeks new beginnings.

1.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Equilibrium

1.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - We Are Brothers
1.plot: Simon and the Kings plan their next heist. Mo agrees to do the job, under one condition. Zaza forces Mimi to try and set up a meeting with Tlotlo.

1.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Sacrifice

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E01 - Episode 1

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Veronica still has a lot to answer about her life in the last 20 years. Trying to figure out what happened to Simon, Angela grows suspicious of Mo.

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: After the big heist, the police take the Masire clan for interrogation and Phumzi reveals her secret to Mo. Tlotlo faces one of the most dangerous Masire enemies.

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: The Masire patriarch is killed and now Mo must find out who did it. Tlotlo gets into a dangerous negotiation with Zaza. Mo and Angela have a moment.

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E05 - Episode 5

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: In Simons Memorial Service, Mo is attacked, but the mermaid's power protects him. He now has a difficult decision to make in order to save Phumzi.

2.title: EN - Kings of Jo'Burg [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S02E07 - Episode 7

1.plot: When a suspicious shipwreck draws the eyes of the law, the fractured Buckley family must put aside their grievances to cover their tracks.

1.title: EN - The Waterfront [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Taking Control
1.plot: Cane and Harlan take bigger risks to keep the business running. Bree seeks proof to confirm her suspicions about her family.

1.title: EN - The Waterfront [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Playing with Fire
1.plot: As Harlan re-enters a risky alliance tied to the family's past, Belle makes quiet moves to protect what's left of their legacy.

1.title: EN - The Waterfront [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - You Can't Trust a Buckley
1.plot: Cane works to contain the growing fallout at home. Harlan connects with a new player — and learns the rules of the game have changed.

1.title: EN - The Waterfront [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - I'm a Hugger
1.plot: As pressure mounts and operations get riskier, Belle and Harlan struggle to keep a low profile. Old wounds resurface between Cane and Bree.

1.title: EN - The Waterfront [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - Hunting Season
1.plot: Belle receives upsetting news about the family's future. A hunting trip troubles the fragile alliance between Harlan and Grady. Bree makes a confession.

1.plot: Hoping to regain control of his operation, Harlan tries to outmaneuver an imminent threat. A violent warning shakes the Buckley family to its core.

1.plot: As tensions flare, a dangerous standoff at sea brings the Buckleys face-to-face with their enemies.

meta.plot: Who killed Nora Dalmasso? In this true-crime series, family and journalists share the untold story of her murder and the media storm that followed.

1.title: EN - The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - The Crime
1.plot: In the city of Rio Cuarto, a high-society wife and mother is murdered in her home, sparking a media frenzy that threatens to tear her family apart.

1.title: EN - The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - The Accused
1.plot: Nora's death is politicized. When a DNA test allegedly incriminates Facundo, a war ignites between the Macarróns and the press. The FBI becomes involved.

1.title: EN - The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - The Trial
1.plot: A new suspect is charged, and stories of marital crisis and dirty money abound in the courtroom and the press. Shocking new details emerge in 2024.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E01 - Do You Think We Can Come To Terms?
1.plot: The chase game between Kartal, the mafia leader, who is the "protector" of Çıngıraklı, a colorful Roman neighborhood with its unique characters and harsh rules, and Efe, the reckless and unruly commissioner of the Organized Bureau, turns upside down with a murder case. Trying to escape from the police forces and his rivals in the criminal world at the same time, Kartal's path crosses with the murderer.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E02 - I Know This Look
1.plot: Although Kartal does not accept Efe's offer of a deal, Efe is sure that they need to work together to find the murderer. While trying to get rid of Efe, Kartal has to pay the price of the damage he did to Mesut, more than he expected. Kartal, who is in a fight with Nezih to protect his position in the criminal world, looks for the cure in his daughter Bahar. When the veil of mystery over the murders is lifted a little, Kartal is forced to reconsider Efe's offer this time.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E03 - Daddy's Son
1.plot: The tag sent to Kartal is the only clue that he and Efe can track down the killer. But apart from the two of them, there is another person who realizes the importance of the tag. While Efe confronts his father as a result of his deal with Kartal, Kartal, who continues his struggle with Nezih, comes before Bahar to try his luck for the last time. For the first time, İrfan panics when he encounters someone who is approaching to learn his secret. But the moment he thinks he's settled the matter in cold blood, he gets a new surprise.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E04 - I Have a Dream
1.plot: The encounter with İrfan Oktay deeply affects both of them. While İrfan is struggling with the trouble of not being able to explain his rightness, Oktay confronts his painful past that he has buried at the bottom of the bottles for years. Bahar, whom Kartal hides in the neighborhood, sees the real face of Kartal, understands what she is actually up against and experiences anxiety. Efe's failure to keep his promise inflames Leyla's anger and causes her to confront Efe. Kartal, on the other hand, is shaken by Efe's betrayal, but he quickly recovers and moves against Efe to take revenge. Efe, whose hands are tied by a move of Kartal, has to choose between acting in spite of Kartal or together with Kartal.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E05 - I'm Ferhan
1.plot: Efe finds himself in the middle of Kartal's wedding rush while trying to track down the murderer who is under their noses. While trying to complete this wedding, which is his last trump card against Nezih, Kartal learns that the murderer may be in the neighborhood. İrfan, on the other hand, drags Efe and Kartal into a surprising plan with the knowledge he gained from his next target. A mysterious message to Efe, who is put to the test by Leyla, shocks Kartal on the very wedding day.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E06 - Wedding and Funeral
1.plot: Destroyed by İrfan's message, Kartal barely comes to the wedding with Efe's support. While trying to prove that he was not destroyed by friend or foe at his wedding, he is also heartbroken. While Efe thinks that he has recovered Kartal, he disperses after the blow he received from Leyla at the wedding. Kartal, whose weak side is revealed when Irfan, whom he calls his brother, pierces his common wounds, gets a new enemy when he receives another wound from the most unexpected place. The circle around İrfan is getting narrower. When he comes across a murder he thought he was covering up, İrfan is forced to reveal his most intimate secret.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E07 - All Thanks to Dad
1.plot: Kartal is disappointed when he does not get the support he expected from his father Oktay to catch İrfan. Still, he not giving up, Kartal tracks down İrfan with Efe, but the duo finds themselves in unexpected danger. This move against İrfan narrows İrfan's playing field. Determined to teach Kartal and the neighborhood a lesson they will never forget, İrfan makes a striking move. However, İrfan's move creates an unexpected result for Oktay.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E08 - Everybody Deserves a Second Chance, Don't They?
1.plot: When Kartal and Efe chase after İrfan with the "alias" they have, they enter the radar of someone they did not expect. Before Irfan disappears, he gives Kartal another chance at his mother's insistence and gives Kartal one of the most difficult dilemmas of his life. While trying to reconcile with Leyla, Efe also tries to protect Kartal from İrfan. On the other hand, İrfan's next step will hit Kartal and Efe from an unexpected place.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E09 - Let It Be War!
1.plot: Efe learns that Kartal released İrfan, and he is enraged, thinking that he also had a share in Leyla's kidnapping. Efe, who follows Leyla with Kartal, has to make a very difficult choice in this process. Efe's emotional reactions, who push his limits to save Leyla, do not go unnoticed by Kartal. Another blow comes from Nezih to Kartal, who has been shaken by the disappearance of Leyla. While Kartal is planning his revenge on Nezih, Bahar's move will surprise everyone.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E10 - The Three Pennies' Men
1.plot: İrfan sneaks into his house to kill Efe. But when he encounters Efe's hidden agenda, he leaves an important message for him. When Efe comes to Kartal to decipher İrfan's message, he learns of the war between Kartal and Nezih. Kartal is determined to see the end of the war as a victor, and Efe is determined to end the war before anyone gets hurt. Despite Leyla's warnings, Efe realizes his plan and finds himself on the verge of a big change. Kartal realizes that he needs Bahar as much as his intelligence to survive his war with Nezih. İrfan, on the other hand, makes the first move of his new game with a maneuver that no one expected.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E11 - The Enemy Of My Enemy Is My Friend
1.plot: Although Kartal and Efe do not want to come to an agreement with İrfan, they realize that they are obliged to work with Baybars because they know that they will never find Baybars. As they take action to realize their plans step by step, Azad, who is their first target, brings them to their feet and this meeting comes as a great shock to both of them. Bahar, who lost everything with her father's death, pours out her heart to Leyla. This bond established between them will enable Kartal and Efe to unite against Azad, their new rival. Efe, on the other hand, has a separate plan, which he hides even from Kartal, in the game they set up with Kartal in order to bring this tough and powerful opponent to his knees. But as soon as they think they have won the game, they meet a new person who connects them to İrfan again.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E12 - The Snakes Among Us
1.plot: Kartal and Efe manage to reach Çetin with İrfan's guidance. Çetin enables Kartal and Efe to win a great victory against Azade. But Çetin, who has a personal animosity with Baybars, has a special agenda that he hides from everyone on the way to Baybars. Bahar begins to hide some things from Kartal as Adnan confuses her. Leyla is determined to tell Efe's secret to her brother Kartal. When Azade, who does not write defeat in her book, makes an unexpected move to Kartal and Efe, everything changes.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E13 - Fathers and Sons
1.plot: Kartal accepts the dangerous task given to him by Azade in order to find a solution to the financial difficulties in the neighborhood. When Kartal, who takes action despite Efe, comes face to face with death, things become inextricable. Oktay, who wants to protect his family, asks Efe to find out why Neriman is meeting with Ferhan. Learning that Leyla also met with Ferhan, Efe confronts Leyla. Bahar prepares a surprise for Kartal with the help of Leyla and manages to melt the ice between them. The inclusion of Korkmaz, one of Baybars' special men, whom Kartal will face in his new position, will have unexpected results.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E14 - The Choice is Yours
1.plot: When Kartal thinks that the end is near, he recovers with unexpected help from Efe and Çetin. Knowing that Kartal will pursue his revenge on Korkmaz, Efe tries to stop him, but his deep bond with Oktay causes him to make an unexpected choice. Çetin knows that Kartal's path is dangerous and tells Efe to restrain Kartal for his sake. When Efe thinks he has solved Çetin's mystery, he realizes that Çetin has much more information about him than he thought. When Bahar decides to confront Azade, she faces the truth that will shock her. Kartal, on the other hand, enters into a bargain with İrfan in order to bring his revenge plan to an end.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E15 - I Came, I Saw, I Erased
1.plot: Kartal's bargain with İrfan causes him to get an unexpected reaction from Efe. With this anger inside, Efe is preparing a hard move against Kartal. After Bahar learns the truth about her father's death, she puts her plan into action and surprisingly changes the target of Korkmaz's attack. Kartal takes action when he realizes Korkmaz's threat. Neriman, who is under probation of İrfan, whom Kartal could not hold in his hand, takes a big risk upon the secret message.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E16 - Vanished Into Thin Air
1.plot: The decision that Neriman makes as a result of confronting Baybars causes Baybars to take a step that will include İrfan. Kartal, even more, sharpened after Bahar's last move, makes a clever plan against Korkmaz. But she is not aware that behind this plan, Efe has set a big trap for him. Çetin realizes that he underestimates his opponents while showing his side in the conflict between Kartal and Efe. Kartal, who no longer trusts anyone, manages to secure himself against Çetin, but a nasty surprise awaits him.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E17 - Dangerous Games
1.plot: Kartal and Leyla are in for a shock when the secret that Neriman has kept for a lifetime is revealed. Kartal's punishment of Neriman ignites the irreversible war between Şahin and Kartal. Efe gets very close to seeing the end of his game, which he started with the support of Çetin in order to let Azade, Korkmaz and Baybars in with Kartal. When Çetin says yes to the offer from Baybars to reunite with his mother, the hunt and the hunters change places.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E18 - New World
1.plot: When Kartal returns to the neighborhood, he sees that everything has changed and is shaken. Çıngıraklı is now under Şahin's control. Seeing that he is not wanted in the neighborhood, Kartal is going to leave everything behind and walk away, but it is Leyla who shakes him and brings him to his senses. Learning that he has a child with Bahar, Kartal takes action to reunite his family with his own child at any cost. For this reason, he first confronts Efe, but finds Efe in a situation he never expected. Kartal makes a big plan to bring Efe back to himself, and Kartal's path crosses with İrfan once again in this plan.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E19 - Ateş's Father
1.plot: Although Kartal is in pain of having to sacrifice Ferhan, he is aware that he must activate the revenge plan he inherited from him. In the surprise confrontation of Efe and Çetin, everyone sheds their stones on their skirts. Kartal reminds him that despite all he has learned, the target of all three is the same person. The steps of the compulsory cooperation between Kartal, Efe and Çetin are taken. In the first battle they won together against Şahin, they get an unexpected response and Kartal becomes Korkmaz's target. While trying to stop Bahar, who is about to leave the country with her son, Kartal, with the support of Efe and Çetin, will try to take her revenge on Şahin, who cooperated with the man who shot his father.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E20 - Time Is Of The Essence
1.plot: Before Kartal can fully experience the excitement of reuniting with his son and Bahar, an unexpected attack overshadows his happiness. Kartal, driven mad by the fear of losing Ateş and Bahar, takes action to take revenge. When he learns who the perpetrator is, he makes a request to Kartal. Kartal's attack affects Efe deeply. Efe, who comes to Leyla for fear of losing the woman she loves, acts much more courageously this time. Şahin confronts Azade as a result of the plan he turned behind his back, but he puts into action a plan that even Azade would not have guessed. While Kartal, Efe and Çetin are preparing to deal a big blow to Baybars, someone they never expected helps them. Baybars, on the other hand, makes the most serious move to overcome the defeats he has suffered and takes a step that will completely change the game.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E21 - 10... 9... 8...
1.plot: The most brutal move of Baybars, Kılıç, leaves great destruction in the places it passes as it is included in the game. Kılıç's brutality intimidates Şahin. Şahin makes a plan with Neriman to eliminate Kılıç. While Kartal and Efe are busy with their wedding preparations, Şahin's game pits Kartal and Çetin against each other. Cetin, who realizes that Kılıç has returned, confronts his brother. As a result of the harsh confrontation between the two, Çetin makes an unexpected offer to Kartal and Efe to get rid of Kılıç.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E22 - It Can't Exist An Us
1.plot: While the Çaka family is making preparations for the wedding with excitement from all sides, Kılıç is on their neck without them noticing. Realizing that after Kartal's last move, Kılıç's revenge plan, which he will take with his own methods, can come true at any moment, Şahin tries to consolidate his position. Kartal, who was dispersed by Kılıç's blow at the wedding, confronts Şahin. In the fierce fight between them, Şahin learns that Kılıç has done much more harm to his family than he thought.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E23 - Become a Family
1.plot: Baybars gives Kılıç, who killed Neriman, the task of bringing back Çetin, the only memory of the woman he loves. While looking for Çetin, Kılıç encounters Efe and a duel begins between the two. While Kartal is trying to protect his family in this process, Kılıç will take a step that Kartal did not calculate.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E24 - It's Our Turn
1.plot: Thanks to Çetin, Kartal saves Konyalı, but he is determined not to leave Çetin with Baybars. When Bahar realizes that a war similar to the past has begun, she decides to fight alongside Kartal instead of running away. Bahar, who first secures Ateş, then takes action to help Kartal with a clever plan. While Kartal and Efe are struggling to keep the whole family together, they encounter a move they never expected.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E25 - Don't Be Afraid
1.plot: Although Kartal and Efe managed to save Çetin, they realize that Baybars will play the game much harder this time. Efe's move to arrest Adnan has tied Baybars' hands, but he thinks that Kartal is the one who will save him from this situation. With the help of Kılıç, he kidnaps Bahar and offers Kartal a deal. Although Efe and Çetin are not sure of Kartal's decision, the possibility of Ateş being in danger will make all three of them dock.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E26 - Two Children
1.plot: Kartal does not accept that he has lost his favorite woman in life, Bahar. While trying to suppress his pain, his old friend Ferhan, who understands this pain best, appears before him. Ferhan gives Kartal the strength to take action for revenge. Efe and Çetin are aware that they need to bring Kartal back to their senses, even though they missed Kılıç and Baybars at the last moment. But they are always one step behind Kartal, who walks to his death alone in pursuit of revenge. After the tension between Kılıç and Baybars due to Bahar's death, Baybars is forced to continue his escape plan alone. The moment Kartal thinks that he has cornered Baybars, he has to make a choice again.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E27 - Finally
1.plot: Having difficulty facing the death of his father, Kılıç begins to eliminate anyone who knows how Baybars was killed. Kılıç puts his brother Çetin, who had a share in the murder of Baybars, on the death list along with Kartal. When the sword strikes most fiercely for revenge, it does more damage to one of the family members. Seeing that violence only breeds more violence, Leyla takes Efe's side against Kartal. Determined to protect his family, Efe turns a blind eye and implements his plan to open the last curtain, including Şahin and Çetin.

1.title: FR - Üç Kuruş - S01E28 - Resignation
1.plot: It will not be easy for Efe to realize the plan that opened the last curtain with Kartal. The incident that Kartal causes as soon as he enters causes both of them to fall into Kılıç's lap when they least expect it. This incident angers Efe and their arguments with Kartal make both of them question their past. Kartal, who does not give up easily, prepares a big surprise ending for Kılıç when he comes across the ward with a new plan that he gets support from Çetin. The final showdown between Kartal and Kılıç will take everyone's breath away.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary [VOSTFR] - S02E22 - Franklin Institute
2.plot: Abbott Elementary takes a field trip to the Franklin Institute; Gregory is eager to spend time with a reluctant Janine; Ava teaches the students about aliens, which leads to chaos.

meta.plot: Dans cette comédie en milieu de travail, un groupe d'enseignants dévoués et passionnés - et un directeur légèrement sourd - sont réunis dans une école publique de Philadelphie où, malgré les obstacles qui leur sont opposés, ils sont déterminés à aider leurs élèves à réussir dans la vie. Bien que ces incroyables fonctionnaires soient en infériorité numérique et sous-financés, ils aiment ce qu'ils font - même s'ils n'aiment pas l'attitude moins que stellaire du district scolaire envers l'éducation des enfants.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When the staff relates their needs, Principal Ava presents alternative options.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E02 - Light Bulb
1.plot: Janine takes it upon herself to fix every problem when she notices a flicking light bulb in the hallway. Gregory asks Barbara for help talking to a parent, which leads him to spend his lunch period in an unexpected way.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E03 - Wishlist
1.plot: The teachers to ask the local community for new school supplies. Janine takes to TikTok and with Ava’s assistance, her video is a success and goes viral. Janine encourages Gregory to decorate his classroom.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E04 - New Tech
1.plot: When a new computer program is introduced at Abbott, Janine is excited to finally help Barbara with something. Barbara is reluctant to accept change and finds herself in a tricky situation. Melissa surprises Jacob.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E05 - Student Transfer
1.plot: After a negative teacher review, Janine gets a confidence boost when a student gets transferred from Melissa's class into hers. Jacob tries to forge a friendship with an uninterested Gregory.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E06 - Gifted Program
1.plot: Janine convinces Ava to start a gifted program at Abbott led by Jacob. However, when some students begin to feel left out, Gregory and Janine put their heads together and come up with a solution. Elsewhere, Barbara pushes a hesitant Melissa to start dating again.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E07 - Art Teacher
1.plot: When the school’s art teacher retires, Janine is thrilled when the replacement ends up being her best friend from college, but things quickly turn sour when Sahar gets in the way of Melissa’s class traditions. Meanwhile, Jacob and Barbara bond over their love for gardening and decide to start a school garden; but when it turns out they don’t know how to successfully grow anything, Gregory secretly gets involved to fix all of their mistakes

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E08 - Work Family
1.plot: After Jacob reveals a detail about his personal life, Janine realizes she doesn't know the other teachers as well as she thought; Gregory's stern teaching approach is causing his whole class to underperform.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E09 - Step Class
1.plot: Janine is thrilled when Ava asks to help her teach the after-school step class, but the two don’t see eye to eye on how to run the program. Later, when Barbara, Melissa and Jacob plan an “eat-off” to decide who makes the best pizza in Philadelphia, Gregory is forced to reveal a secret

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E10 - Open House
1.plot: It’s Open House night at Abbott Elementary, and while Janine prepares to meet her struggling student’s mother, the rest of the faculty uses the time to relax. Gregory is taken aback when he learns how Ava got the principal job, and later, Barbara’s daughter’s visit creates a commotion in more ways than one when

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E11 - Desking
1.plot: When the students start participating in a new online trend that causes disruption to the school, the teachers band together to put an end to it. Meanwhile, Mr. Johnson provides comforting life advice to Gregory; and later, the teachers finally meet Jacob’s boyfriend, Zach, who joins in to help stop the students “desking.”

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E12 - Ava vs. Superintendent
1.plot: With the school board threatening to pull their funds, Janine and Gregory decide to help Ava out with her presentation in front of the Superintendent. However, their plan is derailed when a curveball is thrown at Ava. Meanwhile, Barbara offends Melissa when she doesn’t agree with her blackmail idea.

1.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S01E13 - Zoo Balloon
1.plot: While on Abbott's annual zoo field trip, Tariq reveals that he has been offered a job in New York; Janine struggles with a big choice; Barbara starts questioning her future after finding out her favorite tuatara has been retired because of old age.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E01 - Development Day
2.plot: The teachers are back for development week, a time to prepare for the upcoming year. Janine is determined to start the year off right and leave her problems at home. Ava runs a side hustle out of the school parking lot.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E02 - Wrong Delivery
2.plot: After Janine gets a look at the new charter school down the street, she becomes determined to fix up Abbott and make it just as good. As Gregory goes out of his way to avoid Barbara due to an awkward situation with his personal life, and Ava takes to the school library to host a “Shark Tank”-style pitch to decide what to do with the rest of the funds from the grant.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E03 - Story Samurai
2.plot: A traveling storytelling troupe Jacob used to be in visits Abbott Elementary for a day of education and entertainment. Jacob can’t wait to share this part of his past with his colleagues; but when he realizes they think the performers are corny, Janine does her best to help him embrace his nerdy side. Meanwhile, Melissa struggles with the new normal of her combined second and third grade class.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E04 - The Principal's Office
2.plot: After Gregory sends a disruptive student to the principal’s office, he’s dismayed to find out the kids actually enjoy spending the supposed disciplinary time with Ava. Meanwhile, Melissa invites Janine over to her house to teach her how to cook, but Janine becomes determined to reunite Melissa with her estranged sister

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E05 - Juice
2.plot: Janine is thrilled to help introduce a new beverage to the cafeteria, but it ends up causing unexpected consequences for the students, teachers and school plumbing system. Elsewhere, Melissa clashes with her new aide, Ashley, who brings more disruption than help to the classroom.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E06 - Candy Zombies
2.plot: It’s Halloween at Abbott Elementary! When a student steals a bag of candy meant to be given out to the kids at the end of the day and starts distributing it during school hours, the teachers band together to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Janine is invited to a Halloween party by an old friend and starts to reconsider her personal life.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E07 - Attack Ad
2.plot: The teachers are appalled after seeing a commercial in support of charter schools criticizing Abbott Elementary. When students begin to transfer schools, Jacob, Ava and Melissa invite the leader of the charter school organization to Abbott and ask him to take down the ad. Elsewhere, Janine and Gregory talk about Janine’s relationship with Tariq .

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E08 - Egg Drop
2.plot: When the eighth-grade science class participates in an egg drop activity, Janine insists her second-grade class joins in. Even when the science teacher and Gregory tell her that her students aren’t ready for physics lessons, Janine is determined to prove them wrong. Then, when Barbara is shocked at the clothing one of her student’s parents wears, she learns to not judge someone solely based on their appearance.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E09 - Sick Day
2.plot: Janine is out sick for the day; but with the substitute teacher shortage, Ava grows desperate and must step in herself to help out. She starts the day in an unconventional fashion, disrupting the students’ typical routine as well as neighboring classrooms. Meanwhile, Barbara and Melissa revel in the quieter-than-normal teacher’s lounge.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E10 - Holiday Hookah
2.plot: On the last day of school before winter break, Janine is convinced by her friend to go to a popular hookah club where she runs into unexpected colleagues. Elsewhere, Jacob crashes Barbara and Melissa's traditional holiday dinner and in the process begins to learn the true meaning of Christmas.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E11 - Read-a-Thon
2.plot: The competition heats up between Melissa and Janine as their classrooms go head-to-head in a read-a-thon sponsored by a local pizza shop. Both teachers encourage their students to hit the books hard but face some unexpected obstacles on their path to pizza glory. Meanwhile, Jacob and Gregory join forces and attempt to get their student-podcasting club off the ground.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E12 - Fight
2.plot: During a day of touchdowns and missed plays, the Abbott Elementary faculty find themselves learning lessons in teamwork. Two of Janine’s students aren’t getting along in class, leading her to seek advice from her colleagues on how to help repair their friendship. Meanwhile, Melissa and Ava plot to bring down Mr. Johnson in fantasy football.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E13 - Fundraiser
2.plot: Barbara organizes a candy-selling fundraiser to raise money for a school field trip to the science museum. When sales don’t go as planned, Ava steps in to teach the students new, unconventional selling tactics. Elsewhere, Mr. Johnson and Jacob butt heads about how to take care of a cat found in the janitor’s closet.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E14 - Valentine's Day
2.plot: On Valentine’s Day, the Abbott teachers discuss their relationships and plans for the holiday. Janine finds out one of her students has a crush on her and when turning to a colleague for advice, she inadvertently learns a secret about another teacher. Elsewhere, Ava sits in on Jacob’s Black History class after receiving a complaint

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E15 - Fire
2.plot: Barbara’s candle accidentally starts a small fire in the teacher’s lounge and a counselor suggests that she might not be handling the aftermath well. Meanwhile, Melissa rekindles her childhood dream of being a firefighter.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E16 - Teacher Conference
2.plot: The Abbott staff heads to the Pennsylvania Educational Conference. Gregory reluctantly attends after a disagreement with Amber and bonds with Janine over their similarities. Jacob finds himself charmed by the Addington teachers.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E17 - Mural Arts
2.plot: Jacob secures a visit from a mural arts program for his students but doesn’t agree with their chosen design and attempts to influence their decision. Barbara and Melissa learn parents are petitioning to turn Abbott into a Legendary charter school.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E18 - Teacher Appreciation
2.plot: It’s Teacher Appreciation Day. When the district gives Abbott two courtside tickets to a 76ers game, the teachers must decide who deserves them. Later, Janine invites the teachers to her house for game night and her sister, Ayesha, comes to visit.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E19 - Festival
2.plot: Abbott Elementary rallies together to fight the threat from Legendary Charter Schools. Ava pitches a festival to draw parents to school and collect their signatures for a petition. However, Draemond shows up with the intention of derailing the event.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E20 - Educator of the Year
2.plot: Gregory is named Educator of the Year. Later, Janine deals with a difficult student, and it's revealed that Barbara hasn't completed her teaching requirements.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E21 - Mom
2.plot: Janine's plan for a Memorial Day weekend solo trip is derailed when her mother shows up unannounced asking for help; Gregory notices his colleagues are great at small talk and realizes he needs to brush up on his people skills.

2.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S02E22 - Franklin Institute
2.plot: Abbott Elementary takes a field trip to the Franklin Institute; Gregory is eager to spend time with a reluctant Janine; Ava teaches the students about aliens, which leads to chaos.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E01 - Career Day (1) / Career Day (2)
3.plot: It's a new year at Abbott Elementary, and Janine is as eager as ever. She plans a district-wide initiative - Career Day - and is anxious for it to be a success. Meanwhile, Ava has a new approach to her job, and Melissa is asked a surprising question.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E02 -
FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E03 - Gregory's Garden Goofballs
3.plot: Gregory is hesitant when kids start hanging out in his classroom at lunch, looking to him for advice; Barbara is shocked to find Tariq is dating the mother of one of her students; Janine and Jacob try to hire an ASL interpreter.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E04 - Smoking
3.plot: After a student is caught smoking, the Abbott staff come together to revamp the outdated drug policy. Meanwhile, Janine tries to prep the new substitute teacher for her class but finds it challenging to give up her former role.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E05 - Breakup
3.plot: When Barbara's church choir uses the gym for rehearsals, Ava notices tension in the group. Jacob's eagerness for a full social calendar worries Gregory. Melissa and Janine investigate a new substitute.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E06 - Willard R. Abbott
3.plot: Abbott Elementary is deemed a Philadelphia historical landmark, much to Ava and Janine’s delight; however, Barbara and Melissa are not as impressed. The school plans a celebration in honor of its namesake, but not everything goes as planned.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E07 - Librarian
3.plot: Janine spearheads a pilot program that brings a librarian to Abbott; however, when friction arises with one of the teachers, it strains Janine's relationships with both parties. Meanwhile, both Melissa and Jacob deal with some big changes at home.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E08 - Panel
3.plot: Ava and Gregory are invited to speak on a panel about public schools. Elsewhere, the other teachers must complete CPR training, and Janine faces challenges securing district approval for her librarian extension program.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E09 - Alex
3.plot: Jacob is shocked when he finds out his colleagues are not invested in his frequent email messages and haven’t even been writing their own replies. Meanwhile, Gregory turns to Janine for help with a former student.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E10 - 2 Ava 2 Fest
3.plot: Ava Fest is back, and with the help of the teachers, Ava’s set on outdoing last year by any means necessary. After Janine accepts the offer for a full-time position at the district, she just has to check off one last thing to make it official.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E11 - Double Date
3.plot: Two teachers head out on a double date, but when they run into familiar bar patrons, it proves to be an unfortunate distraction. At Ava’s first book club meeting, the group ends up in a debate over who would be the best post-apocalyptic leader.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E12 - Mother's Day
3.plot: Barbara invites Gregory to her family’s Mother’s Day brunch. Jacob scrambles to figure out how to organize a school field trip.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E13 - Smith Playground
3.plot: Jacob manages to pull off a schoolwide field trip to the park; however, when Abbott must share the playground, the fun and games turn competitive. Elsewhere, Mr. Johnson enjoys having an empty school to himself.

3.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S03E14 - Party
3.plot: It’s the last day of school! Ahead of summer vacation, Janine throws the perfect end-of-year party for her colleagues and friends, taking all their interests into consideration.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E01 - Back to School
4.plot: The neighboring construction site of a new golf course causes issues at Abbott, forcing the teachers to find creative solutions; an HR representative visits the school; following their kiss, Janine and Gregory's relationship status is revealed.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E02 - Ringworm
4.plot: When it’s revealed that a student in Jacob’s class has ringworm, the faculty must band together to stop it from spreading through the entire school.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E03 - Class Pet
4.plot: Janine gets a budget for class pets, but Melissa is resistant to taking on the added work and responsibility for her room's guinea pig; an IT rep from the school district arrives to set up new computers.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E04 - Costume Contest
4.plot: It’s Halloween at Abbott Elementary! Janine and Gregory proudly show off their couple’s costume, but it fails to translate. Meanwhile, Barbara faces pushback from parents concerned about hygiene and her beloved apple-bobbing tradition.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E05 - Dad Fight
4.plot: Gregory forms a bond with one of his students, but the student’s dad becomes jealous of their relationship and seeks a confrontation. Melissa suffers a fall but avoids receiving medical attention for the injury.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E06 - The Deli
4.plot: When the neighborhood deli is forced to close to make room for a trendy smoothie place, Melissa, Barbara and Jacob team up to fight the gentrification. Meanwhile, the district asks Ava to give a presentation to fellow principals.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E07 - Winter Show
4.plot: Despite a few setbacks, Barbara is determined to make Abbott Elementary’s first-ever holiday show a success. Meanwhile, Jacob’s brother arrives for his visit earlier than planned.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E08 - Winter Break
4.plot: Melissa hosts the Schemmenti family Christmas Eve dinner and goes to great lengths to make sure everything is perfect. Meanwhile, Janine and Gregory get an unexpected guest.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E09 - Volunteers
4.plot: Ava announces the school district is sending a group of volunteers to help out at Abbott. However, when they arrive, things don’t go as planned.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E10 - Testing
4.plot: Janine must rethink her lesson plans after her class performs poorly on a practice test, while Jacob struggles to engage a disinterested student. The district sends a new custodian to train under Mr. Johnson.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E11 - Strike
4.plot: City buses have stopped running due to a strike, resulting in many students being absent from school. The teachers at Abbott try to find creative solutions and adapt to hybrid learning. Meanwhile, Gregory and O’Shon strike up a friendship.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E12 - Girard Creek
4.plot: The Abbott Elementary students and staff are invited to a special grand opening preview of the Girard Creek Golf Club.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E13 - The Science Fair
4.plot: While supervising the kids making their science fair projects, the teachers' competitive sides come out.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E14 - District Budget Meeting
4.plot: Ava and the Abbott teachers plan for the annual school district budget meeting. Janine and Gregory prepare for Valentine's Day as a couple

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E15 - 100th Day of School
4.plot: During Abbott's 100th day of school celebrations, Barbara receives a surprise from her daughter. Jacob and Mr. Johnson join forces to conduct a search party.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E16 - Books
4.plot: A debate over a controversial book leads Ava to remove it from the library, but some parents push for its return.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E17 - Karaoke
4.plot: When the teachers hit a karaoke bar for a night of fun, Jacob bumps into an old friend.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E18 - Audit
4.plot: Ava and the teachers must band together to hide the golf-course contraband.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E19 - Music Class
4.plot: Barbara and Gregory are in over their heads when they find themselves in new roles at Abbott Elementary.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E20 - Ava Fest: Tokyo Drift
4.plot: The Abbott teachers turn their open house into a car wash to help raise money for the school.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E21 - Rally
4.plot: Ava and the Abbott teachers go to the district to plead for Ava’s job back. Meanwhile, Gregory handles duties as interim principal.

4.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S04E22 - Please Touch Museum
4.plot: Abbott Elementary goes on a schoolwide field trip to the Please Touch Museum, which has some of the older kids skeptical.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E01 - Team Building
5.plot: The teachers prepare for the upcoming school year with new faces and big changes on the horizon.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E02 - Cheating
5.plot: Melissa tries to outsmart her students; Tariq causes chaos in Janine's class; a new guidance counselor joins the school.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E03 - Ballgame
5.plot: The Abbott crew heads to the ballpark for Teachers' Appreciation Night at the Philadelphia Phillies game.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E04 - Game Night
5.plot: Gregory steps in to host game night at his apartment. Mr. Johnson, Ava, Barbara and Melissa head to the DMV to renew their licenses.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E05 - Camping
5.plot: Barbara organizes a Halloween camping trip for older kids.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E06 - No Phones
5.plot: Abbott Elementary participates in the district’s "No Phones Day" initiative.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E07 - Goofgirl
5.plot: A new member joins Gregory's Garden Goofballs, and Janine pitches a new club idea to Ava.

5.title: FR - Abbott Elementary - S05E08 - Birthday
5.plot: Jacob takes the lead on organizing Abbott's annual winter show, and Janine celebrates her 30th birthday.

meta.plot: Un jeune homme vit dans l'appartement 9K situé dans l'immeuble dans lequel il a grandi, pris en sandwich par l'appartement de ses parents, 9J et celui de son frère, de sa belle-soeur et de leur bébé, le 9L. Il va devoir tenter de placer des limites à sa famille bien pensante mais intrusive.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A time in Mark Feuerstein's adult life when he lived in apartment 9K in the building he grew up in, sandwiched between his parents' apartment, 9J; and his brother, sister-in-law and their baby's apartment, 9L and his attempts to set boundaries with his intrusive but well-meaning family

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E02 - Relationship Guy
1.plot: Josh's mission to have his first successful one night stand is derailed when his date, Lily, bonds with his parents the following morning. Also, Andrew is surprised to learn that Eve intended for him to be a one night stand.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E03 - Cool Friend Luke
1.plot: Judy forces Josh to choose between her and his new best friend, Luke, when she finds out his pal is the upstairs neighbor she claims caused water damage. Also, Andrew asks Nick the doorman to help him assemble Wyatt's new playpen.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E04 - High Steaks
1.plot: Josh begs to join Andrew and Harry's monthly racquetball game. Eve and Judy begrudgingly spend their free evening together.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E05 - The Key to Life
1.plot: Josh is caught in a bind after his refusal to give Judy a new spare key to his apartment; Eve tries to avoid being cropped out of the family holiday card.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E06 - TV MD
1.plot: Harry and Judy shower Andrew with attention after he lands a local television gig as a medical correspondent, with help from Josh. Also, when Eve grows frustrated by the lack of boundaries between her in-laws and Andrew, she tries to turn their attention back to Josh.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E07 - Nanny Wars
1.plot: Eve and Josh vie for the attention of Wyatt's perfect new nanny, Sara, until Josh realizes she is better with babies than adults. Also, after Andrew gets Harry and Judy a new TV, they both remember why they prefer to watch in separate rooms

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E08 - Make Thanksgiving Great Again
1.plot: Josh asks Nick to retrieve Nana Roberts from her nursing home for the family’s Thanksgiving gathering, but when Nick arrives with the wrong nana, the family is forced to deal with a stranger who antagonizes everyone. Also, Judy begins to realize her own critical tendencies, and Andrew prepares for a sexy calendar photoshoot.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E09 - Lovers Getaway
1.plot: After Harry gets sick, Josh accompanies Judy on a pre-planned anniversary spa getaway where everyone believes the two are a couple. While there, Josh alternates between “dates” with his mother and Natalie, a woman he meets at the spa

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E10 - The Family Plot
1.plot: After learning that Josh and Eve don't want their gifted burial plots, Harry and Judy try to find a compatible couple to spend eternity with; Josh hooks up with Nick's sister.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E11 - Set Visit
1.plot: Josh is horrified when the director of his new film hires his parents as background actors in his most important scene; Nick tries to teach Andrew how to dance.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E12 - It Happened One Night
1.plot: Josh and Nick coach their friend Luke on how to amicably break up with his girlfriend; Judy and Harry invite their rivals over to play bridge; Andrew and Eve celebrate their anniversary with their own gift-giving tradition.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E13 - Heavy Meddling
1.plot: After Josh hits it off with Lauren, Judy's friend Myra's daughter, they have an epiphany about the nature of their meeting, and it all circles back to their mothers' meddling. Also, Eve and Andrew are weary of letting Harry babysit Wyatt, so they rope in Nick to babysit both of them.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E14 - Fridays with Harry
1.plot: After Harry scales back to a four-day work week, Josh suggests he take acting class on Fridays to avoid spending the day together; Josh is frustrated by Harry's refusal to break character at home; Judy is called back to her doctor for another test.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E15 - Stalker Status
1.plot: Judy is determined to help Josh win back the attention of Patty, his former stalker, when his feelings are hurt that she is now fixated on an up-and-coming actor. Also, Andrew and Eve try to connect intellectually over reading the same book.

1.title: FR - 9JKL - S01E16 - Tell All
1.plot: While digesting the dirty laundry that's aired in Josh's ex-wife's tell-all book about their family, the Roberts are flabbergasted to learn that Josh is considering reconciling with her.
