meta.plot: En 2024/2025, la nouvelle formule de l’UEFA Champions League, avec encore plus de matches, sera diffusée en intégralité sur les chaînes CANAL+. Dans cette perspective, pour renforcer son équipe de commentateurs, CANAL+ s’est lancé à la recherche d’une nouvelle voix pour commenter le football sur ses antennes. Un processus de recrutement exceptionnel, en plusieurs étapes, ouvert pour la première fois à tous les amateurs et amatrices de football. Des concurrents âgés de 18 à 64 ans, de toutes catégories professionnelles et sociales.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E01 - In Treacherous Waters
1.plot: A series of explosions rocks Gotham. Batman finds himself in the middle of a turf war between rival crime bosses Rupert Thorne and the Penguin. Meanwhile, Commissioner Gordon and his daughter Barbara look for ways to fix Gotham's corrupt Criminal Justice System from the inside.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E02 - ...And Be a Villain
1.plot: When a glamorous movie star disappears, Batman and Detective Montoya find themselves tangled up in the dark web of a mysterious avenger haunting the soundstages.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E03 - Kiss of the Catwoman
1.plot: After her multi-millionaire father goes to prison, leaving her strapped for cash, thrill-seeking dilettante Selina Kyle turns to a life of crime as the daring Catwoman, evading the law at every turn. Batman hatches a plan to end her crime spree while two renegade police detectives intend to see that she uses up all her nine lives in one fell swoop.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E04 - The Night of the Hunters
1.plot: When Mayor Jessop assembles a task force to catch Batman, Detective Montoya is put in charge. Detectives Flass and Bullock take matters into their own hands in an attempt to trap Batman, putting Gotham in a fiery jeopardy.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E05 - The Stress of Her Regard
1.plot: Someone is kidnapping and brain-washing rich, powerful men in Gotham, and Batman must find out who and why. When Barbara Gordon begins to suspect that one of her friends may be involved in the abductions, her investigation puts her on a collision course with the Dark Knight.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E06 - Night Ride
1.plot: After a series of robberies in Gotham, Batman wrestles with the possibility that the culprit might be from beyond the grave. Meanwhile, Harvey Dent's morality is tested when a generous campaign donation comes in from a most nefarious source.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E07 - Moving Target
1.plot: In the aftermath of a botched assassination attempt on Commissioner Gordon's life, Montoya vows to do everything in her power to protect Gordon. Batman's investigation into who was behind the hit leads him down a rabbit hole with only one clear answer: trust no one.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E08 - Nocturne
1.plot: When children start going missing at a Harvey Dent campaign event, Batman's sleuthing into the underbelly of a local carnival hosting it uncovers something far more sinister.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E09 - The Killer Inside Me
1.plot: After Harvey Dent's accident, both Batman and Bruce Wayne must work to stop the DA on his quest for the wrong sort of justice.

1.title: FR - Batman: Caped Crusader - S01E10 - Savage Night
1.plot: Barbara Gordon and Batman's attempt to keep Harvey Dent safe until he testifies in court leads to an all-out war between Gotham's heroes and villains.

meta.plot: Bienvenue à Gotham City, où les criminels sévissent et les honnêtes citoyens vivent dans la peur. Forgé dans le feu de la tragédie, le riche mondain Bruce Wayne devient quelque chose d'à la fois plus et moins humain-BATMAN. Sa croisade solitaire pour la justice attire des alliés inattendus au sein de la police et de la mairie de Gotham, mais ses actions ont des conséquences imprévues.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E01 - Reunions
1.plot: Everyone says their last goodbyes to Roberto, who in his will divides his shares equally for Mila, Betty, and Armando, on the condition that Betty is once again president of Ecomoda. Will she accept? Will she decide to formalize her divorce with Armando after an unfortunate encounter?

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E02 - Betty Takes Power
1.plot: While Betty and Armando try to get to an agreement, Gutiérrez returns to Ecomoda. Mila tries to convince Betty to take the presidency, but she is not willing to. Furious with her mother and having found her father in a compromising situation, she seeks refuge in Marcela. To get her daughter back, Betty makes up her mind.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E03 - Betty, The President
1.plot: Armando and Betty are still distant, and she is sworn in as the new president of Ecomoda. Nacho continues to spy on the company, and Betty finally learns Armando's secret, as Hugo tells her that he has not paid the employees' social benefits for months. Will this mean the end of Ecomoda?

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E04 - Armando Dismantled
1.plot: Jeff organizes a neighborhood bazaar in honor of his grandmother and invites all his Ecomoda fellows. He asks Mila to attend, but she prefers to accept an invitation from Nacho, this will not go as expected. After attending group therapy with Freddy, Armando arrives at the bazaar ready to confess the whole truth to Betty.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E05 - Your Prison
1.plot: Ecomoda's board reunites, and everyone refuses to pay Armando's bail. The espionage against Ecomoda is discovered, but Nacho manages to incriminate Armando. Pressured by everything, Mila gets into trouble with the police. Later, Betty goes to jail to ask Armando for explanations, still the conversation turns into something more.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E06 - A Long Midsummer Night's Dream
1.plot: Betty leaves the prison confused and crosses paths with Majo. Meanwhile, Mila manages to get out of the police station with the help of Nacho and later argues with Marcela, who, worried, confesses to Betty that she does not know where her daughter is. Finally, Majo gets Armando and Gutiérrez out of jail. What will she ask for in return?

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E07 - Box of Memories
1.plot: Five years ago, Betty and Armando celebrated Mila's 15th birthday. In the middle of the joyful family celebration, Mario Calderón returns, and his presence generates a lot of tension between Armando and Betty. Meanwhile, Marcela and Nacho form a secret alliance. After finding Marcela and Armando in a compromising situation, Betty decides to leave him.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E08 - Least Expected Night
1.plot: Hugo leads a strike by the workers' union at Ecomoda, while Betty, Marcela, Mario, and Esteban visit Pascual to convince him to sell them the warehouses. Also, Mila has new proposals to help Ecomoda. Hermes finds Betty's diary and deciphers the past. After a night out with her friends, Betty ends the night in an unexpected way.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E09 - Blanked Out Cassette
1.plot: Betty wakes up with no memory of the night before and is surprised that she is not at home. Mila discovers Nacho's true colors. Will he take the opportunity to confess his identity to everyone? Armando decides to visit his daughter and Betty, but he meets Hermes, who stops him in his tracks, requesting for explanations about what he read in Betty's old diary.

1.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S01E10 - Don't Blame It On The Beach
1.plot: Mila reads Betty's diary and completely breaks down. Full of resentment towards her father, she demands him to sign the divorce papers. Will this mean the end of their relationship? Time later, Betty enjoys in Cartagena with a mysterious man... Who could it be?

2.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S02E01 - Shuffle and Start Over
2.plot: Love affairs in Cartagena, pregnancy announcements, and longed-for reunions. Which former member of the squad will return to the company? The "Nachos" plan to keep all the shares. Will they succeed? Betty's new romance becomes the most desired gossip among employees.

2.title: FR - Betty la Fea : L'histoire continue - S02E02 - Eco-Wedding
2.plot: Unexpected marriage, celebrations, and new surprises. Freddy returns renewed and transformed. What tensions will his return generate? Amid the celebration, the employees learn that the company is practically bankrupt. A particular investor comes into the picture. Will he be their salvation?

meta.plot: Betty ne vit plus avec Armando depuis deux ans, après l'avoir découvert dans une situation compromettante avec Marcela. Ravie du retour de sa fille en Colombie, elle essaie de renforcer son lien avec elle, mais les pressions qui pèsent sur Ecomoda et les ennemis du passé vont tout faire pour l'éloigner de Mila et Armando.

1.title: FR - La Coupe du Monde de Messi : le sacre d’une légende [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Last Cup
1.plot: A confident Argentina arrive at Qatar ’22, seeking the coveted crown that has eluded Messi. But their Cup kicks off with a shocking twist.

1.title: FR - La Coupe du Monde de Messi : le sacre d’une légende [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - We Can Dream Again
1.plot: The shadow—and glow—of Diego Maradona lingers over Messi's every move as he drives Argentina's effort to stay in World Cup contention.

1.title: FR - La Coupe du Monde de Messi : le sacre d’une légende [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - The Weight of a Nation
1.plot: As Argentina face a formidable quarterfinal foe, Leo's painful past in World Cup and Copa América finals looms over the team's tournament run.

1.title: FR - La Coupe du Monde de Messi : le sacre d’une légende [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Redemption
1.plot: Messi, his teammates, and Argentina's supporters put the hopes of a nation into an unforgettable Cup final against Mbappé's mighty French squad.

meta.plot: Suivez le parcours incroyable de la légende à travers cinq Coupes du monde, jusqu’au triomphe de 2022. En revenant sur cette course folle, Messi se livre sur son vécu en équipe nationale, et les défis qu’il a surmontés.
Que mangeaient nos ancêtres avant l’apparition de l’agriculture et de l’élevage, et comment ce bouleversement a-t-il modifié leur développement ?

1.plot: Former nurse-turned-exotic animal broker Tonia Haddix fights to retain custody of her “kids” — seven chimpanzees at the Missouri Primate Foundation (MPF). Other chimp moms are introduced, including one who raised a baby chimpanzee alongside her own infant daughter.

1.title: FR - Chimp Crazy - S01E02 - Gone Ape
1.plot: PETA launches an investigation after a former Hollywood chimp named Tonka goes missing. It’s a high-stakes legal battle, particularly in light of a brutal attack that happened years earlier when another chimp nearly killed a Connecticut woman.

1.title: FR - Chimp Crazy - S01E03 - Head Shot
1.plot: Actor Alan Cumming, who also has a special relationship with Tonka, adds $10,000 to a reward for Tonka’s whereabouts, and the film crew faces an ethical dilemma as parallels are drawn to a previous PETA case that took a dangerous turn in Oregon.

1.title: FR - Chimp Crazy - S01E04 - Fantasy Island
1.plot: Tonka’s fate becomes clearer while Tonia struggles to let go and dreams of one day opening her own island sanctuary where she can live among chimpanzees.

meta.plot: L'amour d'une courtière en animaux exotiques pour les chimpanzés devient un jeu du chat et de la souris quand un des chimpanzés disparaît.

meta.plot: Dans chaque épisode, quatre inconnus unissent leurs forces pour répondre de manière unanime à des questions de connaissances générales. Plus l'équipe prend de temps pour répondre, plus le prix en argent diminue. À la fin de chaque épisode, les participants doivent également diviser l'argent accumulé en trois parts inégales, toujours à l'unanimité. Pour empocher le plus d'argent possible, les joueurs doivent se montrer aussi convaincants que savants, parce que CHAQUE SECONDE COMPTE!

meta.plot: Jesse Mach, motard au sein de la police, est blessé au cours d'une opération. Recruté par les services secrets américains, il pilote le Tonnerre Mécanique, moto révolutionnaire équipée d'armes perfectionnées et capable de dépasser les 500 km/h.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Jesse's best friend is killed by a black truck and Jesse himself is injured in the accident. He can't ride a motorcycle again until a man named Norman Tuttle turns up and offers him a knee operation and a job as a test pilot for a top-secret government project, code named Street Hawk.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E02 - A Second Self
1.plot: Jesse's old mate (George Clooney) shows up in town after years of not seeing him. Unknown to Jesse he is in town to kill Street Hawk.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E03 - The Adjuster
1.plot: Jesse impedes a jewel sale, but a murderer, pretending to be a cop, retrieves the gems. This episodes introduces an enemy unknown to Street Hawk. This enemy is the masquerading cop boss whom we only know of via telephone conversations.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E04 - Vegas Run
1.plot: Unwittingly Jesse and Norman become embroiled in the case of Linda Martin, an important witness against a mobster. She is persued by the mobster's henchman who are hell-bent on getting rid of her.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E05 - Dog Eat Dog
1.plot: Jesse attempts to convince a rock star to appear in a public service announcement.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E06 - Fire on the Wing
1.plot: A series of arson attacks at six different factories make Jesse and Norman doubt about their fortuity. Yet, when they set out to investigate, they are both completely baffled by the fact that the detonator responsible for each incident is untraceable.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E07 - Chinatown Memories
1.plot: Jesse comes to the assistance of an old girlfriend. Her family gets in trouble after an statue is stolen.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E08 - The Unsinkable 453
1.plot: The Widow of an overthrown dictator employs an escaped prisoner for a hideous scheme. Jesse investigates after the prisoner leaves a stand-in at the jail.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E09 - Hot Target
1.plot: Jesse pursues a gang of gunrunners and their trail leads him to a laser weaponry. There Norman re-encounters an old flame, gets captured, and Jesse is left to do all work on his own.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E10 - Murder Is a Novel Idea
1.plot: Jesse helps an author solve a murder committed years earlier. The writer is about to release an book which supposedly incriminates those responsible, but only puts her in danger since the killers now need to get rid of her.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E11 - The Arabian
1.plot: Jesse competes with a beautiful and intelligent Insurance Agent when they investigate a horse switching scheme and a murder of a stable hand.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E12 - Female of the Species
1.plot: Altobelli comes to Jesse's aid when a Federal Agent tries to justify his failure to stop an assassination. However, the assassin is really seeking revenge against the fed who put her away years earlier. Watch out for the face to face confrontation between Altobelli and Jesse as Street Hawk.

1.title: FR - Tonnerre Mécanique - S01E13 - Follow the Yellow Gold Road
1.plot: Street hawk is up against a band of Gold thieves    with a little help from the neighbourhood watch.

meta.plot: Les Winslow forment une famille comme les autres. Carl, policier, et sa femme, Harriette, ont trois enfants : Eddie, Laura et Judy. Estelle, la mère de Carl, et Rachel, la soeur d'Harriette, habitent également avec eux. Mais leurs petites vies tranquilles sont bouleversées le jour où ils font la connaissance de leur voisin, Steve Urkel, un garçon surdoué mais très maladroit...

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E01 - The Mama Who Came to Dinner
1.plot: Mother Winslow moves in and immediately begins to usurp Carl's authority. Eddie wants to go out with his friends, but he has a strict curfew that complicates things with Carl.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E02 - Two-Income Family
1.plot: Hariette loses her job to automation, forcing the family into austerity measures while Carl stews over the family debts.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E03 - Short Story
1.plot: Rachel writes a short story with characters that seem all too familiar; Carl becomes obsessed with the family's out of proportion water bill.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E04 - Rachel's First Date
1.plot: The Winslows finally get to be alone together when Rachel accepts a date with a man from the church choir.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E05 - Straight A's
1.plot: Eddie comes home with straight A's on his report card and the whole family is proud of him. Rodney comes over and tells him that he changed the grades on the report cards on the school computer. Eddie doesn't want to tell the truth because he fears that he will hurt Carl's feelings.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E06 - Basketball Blues
1.plot: Carl's efforts to get Eddie psyched for a pro basketball career is enhanced by a visit from basketball star Bolton.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E07 - Body Damage
1.plot: Rachel takes an unauthorized spin in the classic automobile that Carl plans to drive in the Columbus Day Parade.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E08 - Mr. Badwrench
1.plot: Self-proclaimed handyman Carl decides to install a shower in Mother Winslow's quarters while she's out of town.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E09 - Stake-Out
1.plot: After Carl is on an all-night stakeout with his attractive new partner, Harriette finds a room key to Louie's Love Grotto in his pocket.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E10 - False Arrest
1.plot: The Winslows are aghast to discover that their TV idol has been arrested for assaulting a police officer - Officer Carl Winslow.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E11 - The Quilt
1.plot: Laura sells a quilt Grandmother Winslow considered an heirloom.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E12 - Laura's First Date
1.plot: Laura wants to go to an upcoming dance with a good-looking boy. Carl and Eddie try to find Laura a date. Carl asks Steve Urkel to take Laura to the dance, while Eddie asks one of his friends to take her out. When Laura finds out what happened, she is humiliated.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E13 - Man's Best Friend
1.plot: Carl has a rule he intends to enforce not pets in the house until he meets a big, playful puppy who follows the kids home from school.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E15 - The Big Reunion
1.plot: Carl decides to lose weight before going to his high-school reunion.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E16 - The Party
1.plot: A "No Guests" rule spells no fun for Eddie, who's left in charge of the house while the adults are away for the weekend.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E17 - The Big Fix
1.plot: Eddie persuades Laura to date a guy he's indebted to.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E18 - Sitting Pretty
1.plot: Laura's babysitting service floods the house with children at a bad time on the night Carl has invited his captain over.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E19 - In a Jam
1.plot: Eddie wants to do the right thing when faced with protecting Steve from a bully who threatens to beat him up, which could get Eddie creamed as well.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E20 - The Candidate
1.plot: Eddie places image over integrity in his class president bid when image-maker Laura offers a thousand points of light to illuminate his campaign.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E21 - Bowl Me Over
1.plot: The men vie with the women in a bowling match and Carl's philosophy about accepting defeat gracefully ends up in the gutter when Harriette aces him out.

1.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S01E22 - Rock Video
1.plot: When Eddie's big ego threatens to disband his group during the making of a rock video for a contest, the rest of the Winslows offer some ideas.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E01 - Rachel's Place
2.plot: Feeling like a freeloader, Rachel decides to look for a career beyond writing and opens up a diner after Steve accidentally burns down Leroy's.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E02 - Torn Between Two Lovers
2.plot: Steve develops a crush on Rachel and believes it is reciprocated when she invites him to a candlelight dinner at her restaurant, while Rachel is actually dating her bank's loan officer.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E03 - Marriage 101
2.plot: For a class project, Laura is "married" to Steve for a day. Meanwhile, one of Carl's sergeants casts his eye on Rachel.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E04 - Flashpants
2.plot: A braggart with a badge transfers to Carl's divisions just in time for the precinct's annual dance contest, which Carl and Harriette aim to win by dancing circles around their fierce rival.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E05 - The Crash Course
2.plot: Eddie crashes the car through the front of the house while trying to impress his girlfriend.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E06 - Boxcar Blues
2.plot: Carl gets trapped inside a railroad boxcar with Steve and a cargo of cattle.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E07 - Dog Day Halloween
2.plot: Steve and Laura are held hostage during a Halloween bank robbery.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E08 - Cousin Urkel
2.plot: Steve's cousin from Biloxi sets out to sweep Eddie off his feet.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E09 - Dedicated to the One I Love
2.plot: Harriette points out the obvious when seductive neighbor Loretta sets her sights on Carl; and Laura may soon regret steering Steve to a shy young girl when she finds herself jealous of his attentions.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E10 - The Science Project
2.plot: Everyone vies to be partners with budding scientist Steve, who teams up with Laura for a science project - an A-bomb.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E11 - Requiem for an Urkel
2.plot: Steve charges like a raging bull to the boxing ring when a bully threatens to pummel any guy who asks Laura out.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E12 - Fast Eddie Winslow
2.plot: Eddie is cornered by a tough pool hustler.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E13 - Have Yourself a Very Winslow Christmas
2.plot: Alone and fending for himself during the holidays, Steve shatters Laura's old fashioned Christmas ornament along with holiday visiting privileges at the Winslows'. Meanwhile, Carl does battle with other shoppers as he searches for a scarce teddy bear for Richie.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E14 - Ice Station Winslow
2.plot: When Carl, Eddie and Steve go ice fishing at Lake Wannamuck, Carl has a potentially critical accident; and at home, Judy dislikes the fuss made over Richie.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E15 - Son
2.plot: After an escalating spat with his father, grounded Eddie escapes from the house to keep a date, and Harriette must mediate a father-son feud when Carl gets tired of Eddie's attitude and Eddie threatens to move out.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E16 - Do the Right Thing
2.plot: Carl finds a diamond bracelet and wrestles with doing the right thing, as does Steve, who holds in his hands the academic fate of his romantic rival Todd, who needs Steve's tutoring skills.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E17 - High Hopes
2.plot: In a hot-air balloon, Carl tries to overcome his fear of heights. Harriette and Rachel clash over a car won in a contest.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E18 - Life of the Party
2.plot: At a rooftop party, some kids spike Steve's punch; and Rachel must talk him down from the ledge.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E19 - Busted
2.plot: When Eddie cracks up the family car, Steve suggests raising repair money at an illegal gambling hangout.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E20 - Fight the Good Fight
2.plot: Laura is inspired to make a difference by encouraging support for a black-history class, but her efforts fan the flames of racism at school.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E21 - Taking Credit
2.plot: Rachel and the kids recall how Eddie took credit for a story written by Steve, and how Carl shared his glory with Lt. Murtagh.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E22 - Finding the Words
2.plot: A charming, mysterious figure, claiming to be a family friend from the past, comes to visit - and turns out to be Harriet and Rachel's long-lost father.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E23 - Skip to My Lieu
2.plot: Carl senses a promotion if he can help Lt. Murtagh get a date with Rachel.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E24 - The Good the Bad and the Urkel
2.plot: In a dream, Carl and Steve duel over a compost heap as Old West characters Carl and Two-Gun Urkel - the most annoying gunslinger in the West.

2.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S02E25 - I Should Have Done Something
2.plot: Steve schemes to take the reluctant Laura to a hot-ticket concert; Carl takes out his frustrations on the family, unable to shake the memory of a shooting he feels he could have prevented in the aftermath of a hostage case.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E01 - Boom!
3.plot: Urkel rescues an orangutan from laboratory experiments. Carl steps on a treadmill booby trapped with a bomb.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E02 - Brain over Brawn
3.plot: Urkel's future hangs in the balance during a rope-climbing contest pitting brains against brawn to win Laura's affections.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E03 - The Show Must Go On
3.plot: In the school play, Romeo Steve looks forward to kissing Juliet Laura when the original Romeo lands in the hospital with appendicitis.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E04 - Words Hurt
3.plot: Sleepwalking Urkel undergoes hypnosis to uncover the cause of his anger: he thinks Carl hates his nerdy guts.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E05 - Daddy's Little Girl
3.plot: Laura's behavior suddenly changes when she meets Carl's younger new partner and surf's up for Steve.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E06 - Citizen's Court
3.plot: Urkel is so bugged when Carl squashes his pet beetle that he takes him to court - TV's Citizen's Court - to settle the matter.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E07 - Robo-Nerd
3.plot: Steve creates the Urkelbot, a mechanical Urkel that is all too much like its creator.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E08 - Making the Team
3.plot: When Laura gets snubbed by fellow cheerleaders, she seeks advice from Urkel, who tries out for the basketball team and ends up as equipment manager.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E09 - Born to be Mild
3.plot: A street gang causes trouble for the Winslows, and things become personal when they vandalize Rachel's Place and attack Eddie. Carl wants to take matters into his own hands, but Urkel decides to infiltrate the gang and tricking them into confessing.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E10 - The Love God
3.plot: Steve thwarts Eddie's potential romance, while Carl is undercover in drag.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E11 - Old and Alone
3.plot: Laura may be sorry for banishing Urkel from her life: in her dreams, she's a 90-year-old spinster whose only visitor is a now-married Urkel.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E12 - A Pair of Ladies
3.plot: Rachel reluctantly hires a loudmouthed, pushy Harriette to help at the restaurant; and Urkel bets the ranch on Carl's cutthroat poker game at home with the guys.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E13 - Choir Trouble
3.plot: Steve joins the Winslows at church with faith that he'll get into the choir, but he's kicked out by new choir director Rachel, whose position has gone to her head.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E14 - A Test of Friendship
3.plot: The Winslows are ripped off when Carl dozes off; Urkel takes the heat after helping Eddie cheat on a chemistry test.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E16 - Brown Bombshell
3.plot: Mother Winslow regales Eddie's classmates with tales of her late fighter-pilot husband and of World War II's Tuskegee Airmen.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E17 - Food, Lies and Videotape
3.plot: Urkel enrolls in a home economics class with Laura, thinking it'll be a piece of cake, but he soon learns he less than an A-student.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E18 - My Broken-Hearted Valentine
3.plot: Urkel again tries to intervene in Laura's budding romance with Daniel Wallace, whom Steve has learned is nothing but trouble. Laura believes Urkel is meddling in her love life and tells him to go away.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E20 - Love and Kisses
3.plot: Hoping to win Laura, Urkel strikes a deal with R&B singer Johnny Gill: his treasured baseball card in exchange for serenading her; Carl and Harriette discover that their honeymoon love nest is of the outdoor type.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E22 - The Urkel Who Came to Dinner
3.plot: Urkel's stay at the Winslows brings chaos when he swallows a fish that Carl was "fish-sitting," urges Richie to fight a preschool bully and drives away Laura's study mate.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E23 - Robo-Nerd II
3.plot: It's hasta la vista to the criminal element and hello Urkelbot after Urkel revives his robot for law-enforcement use in solving a rash of convenience store robberies on Carl's beat; meanwhile new shampoo changes the women.

3.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S03E25 - Farewell, My Laura
3.plot: Urkel plays bumbling, hard-boiled gumshoe Johnny Danger in a 1940s film noir spoof with Laura as a sultry client who needs protection for her aunt Rachel singer and supper-club owner marked for murder.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E01 - Surely You Joust
4.plot: Feuding neighbors "Hurricane" Urkel and "Bonecrusher" Carl take a not-so-neighborly, macho grudge match to TV's American Gladiators.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E02 - Dance to the Music
4.plot: Home-coming Queen Laura gets the royal treatment from Urkel, who gets popular jock Ted to ask her to the dance; Carl meets Harriette's new piano teacher..

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E03 - Driving Carl Crazy
4.plot: Carl hopes to practice stress management by keeping his cool, but he nearly blows a gasket teaching Urkel to drive.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E04 - Rumor Has It
4.plot: As rumors begin to fly that Ted has "scored" with Laura, Urkel must warn her that the guy she's dating means to boost his rep by ruining hers.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E05 - Number One with a Bullet
4.plot: Carl and Urkel are hospital roommates and Urkel, as usual, is a pain -until he gets the opportunity to save Carl's hide.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E06 - Whose Kid Is it Anyway?
4.plot: Richie is upset when Eddie's hot Halloween date conflicts with his promise to take his little cousin trick or treating.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E07 - An Officer and a Waldo
4.plot: Eddie's insult sends Waldo off to join the Army; Harriette and Carl set up a sting to catch a shady repairman.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E08 - Just One Date!
4.plot: Urkel resorts to despearate measures to win a date with Laura by camping out on the Winslows' roof, even though a big blizzard is fast approaching Chicago. Meanwhile, Richie meets new next door neighbor Gwendolyn.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E09 - The Oddest Couple
4.plot: Eddie's sloppy habits and Steve's scientific experiments don't make for domestic bliss when the two become roommates.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E10 - It's Beginning to Look a Lot like Urkel
4.plot: Laura's guardian angel shows Urkel what it's like to be Laura.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E11 - Muskrat Love
4.plot: Eddie breaks a date with a smart and witty girl his friends disapprove of, while Laura regrets encouraging Maxine to date Ted; Carl gives Harriette fitness gear.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E12 - Hot Wheels
4.plot: Carl buys a hot rod for Eddie, hoping it will be the road to a father-son bonding session; and Urkel strengthens his bond with Laura using a new wonder glue he invented.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E13 - The Way the Ball Bounces
4.plot: A college woos athlete Eddie, who has only fame and fortune in mind after accepting a scholarship; meanwhile, Laura forgoes sleep to study for her PSATs.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E14 - A Thought in the Dark
4.plot: Laura and Ted momentarily derail Urkel's efforts to win Laura by fixing him up with Ted's brainy cousin Myra for a double date to a concert.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E15 - Tender Kisses
4.plot: Eddie gets more than he bargained for when he and his pals sneak into R&B singer Tracie Spencer's hotel room in search of tickets to her concert; and Carl is in for a big surprise when he discovers Harriette's diary.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E16 - Heart Strings
4.plot: Lonely and depressed after breaking up with Ted, Laura grants Urkel a few bittersweet hours of bliss as her valentine; Gwendolyn charms Richie with "yucky goo-goo stuff"; and Harriette and Carl search for admirable qualities in each other.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E17 - It's a Mad, Mad, Madhouse
4.plot: Eddie tries to cover for his poor record in school by claiming he has family problems at home - so his teacher arrives to evaluate his dysfunctional family environment.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E18 - Higher Anxiety
4.plot: At a party, Urkel, Eddie and Waldo get trapped on a fire escape. A heartbroken Eddie mourns his split with two-timing Oneisha, while Carl gives the cold shoulder to his mother's beau Fletcher, who has big plans for her future.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E19 - Mama's Wedding
4.plot: Thanks to Eddie, Mother Winslow's "simple family wedding" brings more than the family bargained for 150 extra guests.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E20 - Pulling Teeth
4.plot: Waldo dates Laura's friend; Richie tries to get rid of a baby tooth.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E21 - Walk on the Wild Side
4.plot: When peer pressure comes a-knocking, Laura goes a-walking on the wild side, at Club Buff--a male strip joint.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E22 - Hot Stuff
4.plot: Myra enlists Laura's help in snaring "hot stuff" Urkel; Eddie asks Carl a lot of questions after buying a hot car stereo.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E23 - Stormy Weather
4.plot: Urkel's nerdiness gets under the skin of Laura's arrogant prom date (Ross Leon), who's itching to order Laura to write off Urkel as a friend.

4.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S04E24 - Buds 'n' Buns
4.plot: As a part-timer at the Mighty Weenie fast food joint, Carl doesn't relish answering to the top dog - Eddie; Urkel takes Laura's advice and commits to Myra.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E01 - Hell Toupee
5.plot: Carl shops for a toupee, hoping to turn Harriette's head. Meanwhile love struck Myra accuses Laura of trying to take Urkel away from her and the two get into a food fight.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E02 - It Didn't Happen One Night
5.plot: Laura oversleeps and misses her bus to Cincinnati for a cheerleading competition and Steve offers to take her in his Isetta. Laura is not pleasant company and Steve confronts her about it.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E03 - Saved by the Urkel
5.plot: The Winslows find themselves - unbelievably - indebted to Urkel after he saves Carl's life with CPR. The family showers him with gratitude and feels obligated to put up with the nerdy, annoying dweeb.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E04 - A Matter of Principle
5.plot: Laura and Eddie's romantic tips have obsessive Myra entangled in a web of errors with Urkel when she invades Steve's school; Carl's sage advice leads Harriette to a confrontation with her boss - and a possible layoff.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E05 - Money Out the Window
5.plot: A thug named Bones pays Eddie a visit after Waldo and Weasel enlist Eddie in their football-betting venture.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E06 - Best Friends
5.plot: Harriette tries to fit in with Laura's friends but gets the cold shoulder from Laura. And Waldo's not so hot as Eddie's new hire at Mighty Weenie.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E07 - Grandmama
5.plot: The NBA's Larry Johnson plays Grandmama (his TV-ad alter ego), who becomes Urkel's new partner in a city basketball competition after Eddie dumps Urkel for star player Kenny.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E08 - Dr. Urkel and Mr. Cool
5.plot: A space-age potion turns Urkel into Stefan Urquelle suave, smooth-talking life of the party, but Laura finds she soon misses the old Urkel.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E09 - Car Wars
5.plot: Laura believes that by donning a moustache and men's clothing she'll be better prepared to haggle with a sexist used-car dealer ; Steve is close to ruining Eddie's love life.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E10 - All the Wrong Moves
5.plot: At the drive-in movie, Laura's new boyfriend (Kevin Mambo) has trouble getting the message that no really means no; and at home, Carl just doesn't get it when his insults drive Harriette to retaliate.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E11 - Christmas is Where the Heart Is
5.plot: Urkel and Carl are stranded on a stalled subway with a car full of grouchy shoppers. Urkle teaches everyone, including Carl that Christmas is a state of the heart, and can be celebrated anywhere and with anyone.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E12 - Scenes from a Mall
5.plot: Urkel tells Myra that he needs some space and ends up breaking her heart, while Maxine is ready to break Waldo's neck for acting like a jealous fool.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E13 - Rock Enroll
5.plot: Eddie changes his mind about college at a concert fund-raiser after singer Shanice performs a song he wrote; and Urkel has no luck rallying friends to celebrate his birthday, but soon finds that Laura is his biggest cheerleader.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E14 - Like a Virgin
5.plot: Eddie becomes the laughingstock of the boys' locker room after Urkel spills the beans that Eddie is still a virgin.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E15 - Good Cop, Bad Cop
5.plot: Carl refuses to accept Eddie's story that he got pulled over for speeding ""because he was a black in a white person's neighborhood"" ... until the portly cop finds out the ugly truth. Meanwhile, Urkel tells Richie that he has nothing to fear when going to the dentist, but the nerd soon regrets his move when he has cavities of his own that need filling.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E16 - Presumed Urkel
5.plot: When accident-prone Steve is blamed for a chemistry lab explosion, Laura represents him at a school trial.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E17 - Father of the Bride
5.plot: Carl bribes Laura to go bowling with Urkel and dreams that they are married with four kids who look like Urkel.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E19 - That's What Friends Are For
5.plot: Everyone applauds Eddie on his college scholarship except Waldo, who fears he's losing a friend. Meanwhile, Carl' s fear of failure could keep him from a job promotion; and Urkel tortures Carl into telling him where Myra is by showing him slides of his cheese-tasting trip.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E20 - Opposites Attract
5.plot: Urkel develops hiccups after being robbed.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E21 - A-Camping We Will Go
5.plot: Urkel tags along on Carl's camping trip in Minnesota and an irritated Carl stubbornly refuses to listen to know- it-all Urkel's words of warning about bears and geysers; Harriette seeks a job.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E22 - Nunsense
5.plot: Urkel fears that his rejection has sent Myra to join a nunnery, so he enlists Eddie and Waldo to dress in habits and join him in a search for her at the convent.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E23 - Aunt Oona
5.plot: Urkel's accident-prone Aunt Oona visits shy, dowdy woman who get a confidence-building makeover from Harriette and then takes her new-found confidence to a karaoke bar, where chaos erupts when she holds a singing contest.

5.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S05E24 - Stefan Returns
5.plot: Laura pleads with Urkel to step back into his transformation chamber and bring back her perfect guy the handsome, cool, caring Stefan Urquelle. Freddy Jackson sings You Are My Lady"".

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E01 - To Be or Not to Be (1)
6.plot: Laura doesn't want Stefan to change anything about himself for her, while Urkel - as his nerdy self - is a 10 in Myra's eyes. Meanwhile, hoping to improve his vision, Carl steps into Urkel's transformation chamber.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E02 - To Be or Not to Be (2)
6.plot: After a vengeful Myra tampers with Urkel's transformation chamber, Carl steps into it and steps out as an Urkel-like nerd.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E03 - Till Death Do Us Apartment
6.plot: College man Eddie moves into an apartment with Waldo and promptly plans a hot night with two female guests which inflames Waldo's steady, Maxine.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E04 - The Looney Bin
6.plot: A homeless janitor gets trapped in the school bomb shelter with Urkel and Carl.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E05 - Beta Chi Guy
6.plot: His friendship with Urkel damages Eddie's reputation with a group of ultra cool fraternity brothers.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E06 - Dark and Stormy Night
6.plot: On a dark and stormy Halloween night Winslows play Pass the Ghost Story, in which Carl and Harriette are 19th-century vampires licking their chops over the wayfaring Sir Steven (Urkel).

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E07 - Par For the Course
6.plot: Duffer Carl is reluctant to stand up to his cheating boss during a round of golf, but Harriette isn't reluctant to go looking for Laura when she misses her curfew.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E08 - Sink or Swim
6.plot: It's no secret that Urkel is deathly afraid of the water and his heart sinks when he learns that he can't graduate from high school unless he can pass a pass a swimming test, so he asks Carl for lessons.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E09 - Paradise Bluff
6.plot: Urkel's life flashes before him atop Paradise Bluff, where Myra hands him an ultimatum; and Harriette rates her mate and finds Carl needs to spice up his technique - at barbecuing.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E10 - Flying Blind
6.plot: Carl and Urkel must land a plane after their vengeful pilot bails out on a charter flight to Detroit, leaving the m with only their emotional baggage.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E11 - Miracle on Elm Street
6.plot: Richie brings home a homeless person on Christmas.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E12 - Midterm Crisis
6.plot: Carl loses points with Capt. Savage by telling him the truth about the woman he loves; and Eddie and Urkel cook u p a lie about Waldo's midterm baking project, which they devoured.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E13 - An Unlikely Match
6.plot: Urkel sets an example of forgiveness after getting harassed by a gang of ruffians at school - when he discovers the ringleader has leukemia, he organizes a bone marrow drive; and a police-auction bargain overshadows Carl's good judgment.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E14 - The Substitute Son
6.plot: The transformation machine turns Urkel into a karate master who defends Laura's honor at a rough longshoreman's bar; Waldo becomes Carl's substitute son when Eddie starts taking his father for granted.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E15 - The Gun
6.plot: Gritty episode in the style of NYPD Blue, where Laura is robbed by female gang members and considers purchasing a gun to ward off future trouble.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E16 - Wedding Bell Blues
6.plot: Urkel and Carl risk their lives to save the distraught Mr. Looney from committing suicide when he is jilted on hi s wedding day; meanwhile at home, Laura fumes when her parents are more protective of her than of Eddie.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E17 - Ain't Nothin' But an Urkel
6.plot: Another transformation-chamber mishap turns Urkel into a gyrating Elvis with a hunka hunka lot of explaining to do during a meeting with an MIT recruiter (Kline).

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E18 - My Uncle Hero
6.plot: Suspicions mount for Myra as Urkel and Laura put their heads together to plan a surprise birthday party for her. Meanwhile across town, Richie hopes to impress his classmates on a field trip to Carl's office at the police station.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E19 - My Bodyguard
6.plot: After failing to foil a robbery, Carl is assigned to protect Urkel, who stopped the thief; the boss's daughter comes on to Eddie.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E20 - Cheers Looking at You, Kid
6.plot: Carl and Henriette send Laura off unchaperoned to cheerleading championships in Omaha where Laura's handsome partner Gary looks a lot like trouble in Urkel's spying eyes.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E21 - What's Up Doc?
6.plot: A therapist helps the Winslows get to the root of their tensions by reflecting on life with Urkel.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E22 - We're Going to Disney World (1)
6.plot: As a finalist in a contest, Urkel invites the Winslows on his trip to Disney World, where Laura has a fantasy romance---with Stefan Urquelle.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E23 - We're Going to Disney World (2)
6.plot: Myra rushes to Disney World, fearing something is amiss with Urkel. And it's no Mickey Mouse worry: he's proposed to Laura by the time Myra arrives.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E24 - They Shoot Urkels, Don't They?
6.plot: At a dance marathon, Laura cuts a rug with Waldo's cousin, and Carl and Urkel boogie till the sun comes up.

6.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S06E25 - Home Sweet Home
6.plot: To avoid being banished to Russia (where his parents are moving), Urkel--and his termites--move in with Eddie and Waldo.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E01 - Little Big Guy
7.plot: Urkel and his transformation chamber move in with the Winslows--where he creates havoc by shrinking himself and Carl in an experiment gone awry.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E02 - The Naked and the Nerdy
7.plot: Steve and Laura have an accidental encounter in the nude; Harriette unwraps an anniversary gift she thinks is from Carl.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E03 - Bugged
7.plot: Feelings of guilt bug Urkel after he meets a knockout of a fellow insect collector; Harriette's boss annoys Carl and his buddies as a guest at their poker games.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E04 - Teacher's Pet
7.plot: An English class full of hooligans gives substitute teacher Urkel a pain--and an idea on how to get through to his defiant charges.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E05 - Walking My Baby Back Home
7.plot: Greta's dad forbids Eddie to date his daughter--but he welcomes Urkel as her new escort.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E06 - She's Back
7.plot: Myrtle, Urkel's cousin from Biloxi, squares off with Greta over Eddie's affections.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E07 - Hot Rods to Heck
7.plot: When Laura's emotions go into overdrive for a daredevil drag racer, Urkel challenges him to a high-octane grudge race at the local drag strip.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E08 - Talk's Cheap
7.plot: A family feud erupts on a TV talk show featuring Urkel, Stefan and cousin Myrtle, along with Laura, Eddie, Myra and Waldo.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E09 - Struck By Lightning
7.plot: Laura and Myra's friendship turns stormy as they compete for the same job; a rainstorm renders Urkel "a human lightning rod."

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E10 - Best Years of Our Lives
7.plot: Urkel could use some help designing a float for homecoming; and Carl believes he's helping his mom by encouraging her to "slow down."

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E11 - Fa La La La Laagghh!
7.plot: Carl's bah-humbug attitude toward Urkel's rooftop Christmas decorations changes once he learns that the family could win a decorating contest.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E12 - Friendship Cycles
7.plot: Carl backpedals on his refusal to teach Urkel to ride a bike when it seems that the clumsy kid might wreck his new car.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E13 - South of the Border
7.plot: Carl, Urkel and Eddie hop a plane for Central America to bust Waldo out of jail; and Harriette talks Laura into a blind date.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E14 - Life in the Fast Lane
7.plot: Handyman chores leave Urkel hyped up and hammered out after he inadvertently downs Laura's diet pills, which she' s using for a quick trim down.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E15 - Random Acts of Science
7.plot: Teamwork and the transformation chamber give Carl and Urkel an edge against thieving gang members.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E16 - Tips For a Better Life
7.plot: Carl issues an ultimatum concerning Eddie's drinking. Meanwhile, female fans become intoxicated with Stefan Urquelle.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E17 - Swine Lake
7.plot: At a recital, Eddie and Greta's pas de deux from "Swan Lake" is interrupted by an ugly duckling from down south--Myrtle.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E18 - My Big Brother
7.plot: Urkel volunteers as a Big Brother to a street kid who harbors a secret about his reading ability.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E19 - Eau de love
7.plot: Urkel's love potion prompts a sudden devotion from Laura; airline nightmares plague Carl and Harriette on their second honeymoon.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E20 - Twinkle Toes Faldo
7.plot: Waldo can tap dance with pizzazz but he's a klutz on the basketball court. Elsewhere, Carl is turned down for a loan to pay Laura's tuition to Harvard.

7.title: FR - La Vie de famille - S07E21 - Scammed
7.plot: Eddie and Waldo fall victim to a scam; Urkel's glue provides Laura with a super facial.

meta.plot: Magic of Disney’s Animal Kingdom gives viewers a backstage pass to explore the magic of nature within Disney’s Animal Kingdom Theme Park, Disney’s Animal Kingdom Lodge and The Seas with Nemo & Friends at EPCOT. Each episode dives into the details, unveiling the multifaceted aspects of animal care, conservation and Disney Imagineering and showcases the parks’ magnificent array of more than 300 species and 5,000-plus animals and the herculean tasks their animal care experts undertake to keep things running day and night.

1.title: EN - Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kenya, the Gutsy Giraffe
1.plot: On the Harambe Wildlife Reserve, Kenya, a Masai giraffe, steps up for a pedicure that could make Disney history as animal keeper Rory and the team attempt to provide unique hoof health by training her to undergo a “nail” trim, voluntarily. Kenya proves to be a very apprehensive patient, but the team perseveres knowing one small step for her is one giant leap for the park’s giraffes. Meanwhile, out on the savanna, African elephant Mac, -- the park’s biggest resident -- has a routine checkup that reveals a mouthful of mystery. Over in the Affection Section at Rafiki’s Planet Watch, it’s make or break for a much smaller resident, Popcorn, a rescued chicken with an egg problem who requires surgery. Behind the scenes, Disney Imagineers, including the visionary Joe Rohde, dream up a magical palm tree that illuminates the elephants during the park’s evening safari.

1.title: EN - Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Happy Birthday, Gino!
1.plot: Gino, the most admired western lowland gorilla at Disney’s Animal Kingdom, celebrates his 39th birthday with animal manager Rachel, who’s known Gino since he was a teen. Gino’s presented with a storybook-worthy cake, but festivities are stalled when he struggles to overcome a chest infection. Meanwhile, animal keeper Lori notices a lump on beloved alpha lioness Kinsey, which requires urgent medical attention, but transporting the 300-pound cat to the Veterinary Treatment Room poses a challenge. Over at The Seas with Nemo & Friends at EPCOT, aquarist Amanda, who’s expecting her first child, prepares to welcome another little ray of sunshine into the world: a spotted eagle ray pup. At Discovery Island, trainer Katelyn teaches two newly arrived macaws, Santiago and Emmett, the navigation skills needed to become members of the Winged Encounters flight team.

1.title: EN - Magic of Disney's Animal Kingdom [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Betty and the Beast
1.plot: For the first time in the park’s history, Hartmann’s mountain zebras arrive on the savanna at Disney’s Animal Kingdom! Keeper Meaghan and the team do their best to acclimate the mischievous herd and prepare the other animals to meet their new neighbors, including a curious young Hartmann’s mountain zebra, Clementine, and mom-to-be Prima. Meanwhile, babirusa pig Betty is introduced to a bachelor babirusa, Mentari, with the hope that the plucky pigs hit it off and give the park its first-ever babirusa piglet. At The Seas with Nemo & Friends at EPCOT, an 1,800-pound rescued manatee, Lou, has a potentially infected tail, so keepers must use a crane to lift him out of the aquarium to transport him to the Veterinary Treatment Room for a high-def CT scan.

2.title: EN - The Buccaneers [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Holy Grail

2.title: EN - The Buccaneers [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Get Her Out

2.title: EN - The Buccaneers [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Ice Cream

2.title: EN - The Buccaneers [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Every Single Piece of My Heart

1.title: EN - Smoke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Size Matters

1.title: EN - Smoke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Manhood
1.plot: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

1.title: EN - Smoke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Whitewashed Tombs

1.title: EN - Smoke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Mirror Mirror

meta.plot: Laura intègre le lycée Ichio cours d’année. Elle y rencontre Julie, sa nouvelle meilleure amie et, surtout, une bande de cinq élèves très étranges, les Joyeux Loufoques, une brochette de cancres survoltés réunis par leur physique atypique et leurs multiples redoublements. Toujours prêts à distraire leurs camarades pendant les cours, les Joyeux Loufoques font le désespoir de leur professeur, mademoiselle Hilary. Celle-ci n'hésite pas à employer la manière forte pour les punir, mais c'est souvent peine perdue.

À la station de métro Shinjuku, il suffit d'inscrire « XYZ » sur le tableau d'information pour solliciter l'aide de City Hunter, une agence de détectives privés composée de Ryo Saeba (alias Nicky Larson en VF) et Kaori Makumura (Laura). Kaori n'est autre que la sœur de l'ancien partenaire de Ryo, qu'il s'est promis de protéger après la mort de celui-ci. Alors que Ryo Saeba est extravagant, pervers et exhibitionniste, Kaori est toujours là pour essayer de calmer ses ardeurs envers la gent féminine. Malgré ce comportement, Ryo Saeba traîne toujours sa réputation d'ancien mercenaire derrière lui…

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E01 - One Cool Sweeper: XYZ is a Dangerous Cocktail
1.plot: When there is a spate of random shootings in Shinjuku, a sister of one of the victims wants Ryo to catch the killer and bring him to justice.  But Ryo can tell that there is much more than justice that his client is interested in.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E02 - Please Kill Me: Crosshairs Don't Become a Pretty Girl
1.plot: Ryo's client is a daughter of a known scientist who developed a deadly microbe that could render humanity sterile.  His client wants him to protect her at all costs while she develops a vaccine, but should she be captured, she wants him to kill her before terrorists can extract the knowledge of the microbe from her.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E03 - Love Don't Leave Me: A Ten Count to Tomorrow
1.plot: A boxer is killed over a fight for a championship title, and Ryo must deal with the victim's rival obsessed with glory.  At the same time, he must deal with the boxer's girlfriend, whose pain is not only in her heart, but also in her body as well.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E04 - Lady Vanish: Boutique of the Shadows
1.plot: Ryo's partner Hideyuki is frantic over the disappearance of her sister Kaori as a spate of abductions of women have swept Shinjuku.  As he is trying to find his partner's sister, he comes across a man who is not who he seems to be.  Together, they must find the secret into the kidnappings.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E05 - Goodbye Makimura: A Tearful Birthday on a Rainy Night
1.plot: Hideyuki is killed on Kaori's birthday as he refuses to do a request for the head of a powerful crime syndicate.  Ryo must avenge his death.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E06 - No Romance for this Actress: The Last Shot for Hope
1.plot: As Kaori takes over as Ryo's new partner, Ryo is called upon to solve a string of incidents involving actress Yumiko Sato.  As he delves deep into the mystery, he comes across a powerful adversary, as well as a client who may have a deadly death wish.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E07 - A Gunshot to set the Heart Aflutter: Sad Lonely Girl
1.plot: Ryo's client is a man who wants to fake his own death to be free from a powerful politician so he could be reunited with his daughter.  The man admits to be spineless but he is more than meets the eye.  Ryo must masquerade as the hitman not only to save his client, but to ensure that the men working for the politician do not bother his client again.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E08 - A One-Hole-Shot to a Lovely: Hands Off My Lady Detective
1.plot: A Police detective named Saeko Nogami hires Ryo to obtain a crown containing a microchip which has stolen top secret plans inside.  While Ryo agrees to do his job, he awaits his ""payment"" which leaves Kaori confused as to how this payment would be applied.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E09 - The Gambling Queen: A Bet for Wonderful Love
1.plot: Ryo must protect a lovely casino dealer as she prepares for a showdown with a rival syndicate in order to win her freedom.  Meanwhile, Ryo is pitted against a powerful gambler who exploits Ryo's weaknesses to their fullest extent.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E10 - One Dangerous Tutor: Home-Cooking from the Heart for a Sukeban
1.plot: Ryo is tricked into doing bodyguard work for the daughter of a Yakuza Boss being stalked by a biker team.  Ryo realizes that the daughter is the leader of a female gang at her school, and finds there is much more than what the Yakuza boss is requesting.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E11 - That Pretty Girl in Tights Prefers the Tulips
1.plot: Ryo is requested to assist a female thief in stealing a black tulip from a fraudulent psychic.  Kaori finds out that the psychic's butler has a crush on her and decides he may be helpful in obtaining the plant.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E12 - Kids Get Special Treatment: A Beautiful Lady from a Dangerous Land
1.plot: Ryo must protect a woman and a young boy from another country from being abducted by foreign agents.  Kaori soon discovers that the young boy's actions and demeanor are exactly as Ryo's.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E13 - She's Getting Married at Age Sixteen: A Hot Kiss with a Pop Idol
1.plot: Ryo is assigned to protect young pop idol Nagisa from an unknown fanatic, however he is more interested in her female manager.  However, it turns out that Nagisa is very attracted to Ryo and Ryo decides to use this to his advantage to ensure her safety.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E14 - My Foe is a Beautiful Lady?: The Biggest Woman Trap in History
1.plot: Saeko enlists the help of Ryo to solve the dissappearances of beautiful women in Shinjuku.  The stakes are even higher when Kaori, mistaken for a beautiful woman, is also kidnapped.  Ryo encounters the mastermind of the scheme, a supposedly beautiful woman who may not be who she seems to be.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E15 - Ryo's an Instructor at a Women's School?: To Protect a Sweet Young Lady
1.plot: Ryo is requested to protect the daughter of a dead tycoon who claims that Ryo had saved her from kidnappers once before.  As Ryo tries to find out who is trying to kill her, her stepmother comes up as a very likely suspect, but is being controlled by someone else.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E16 - One Frisky Stewardess: Ryo - Self Defense Instructor
1.plot: An old friend of Kaori's is being stalked by strange characters who are after strange looking watches that were slipped into her bag.  Despite Kaori's efforts to keep her away from Ryo, Kaori is kidnapped by the men and Ryo and her friend must rescue her.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E17 - Summer's Lovely Designer: Ryo has a Thing for the Super-High-Leg Type
1.plot: Ryo is recruited by a famous fashion designer's assistant after her designs were stolen by her boss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E18 - A Divine Prophecy on a Summer's Evening: Shrine Maiden gets first lesson in love
1.plot: Corrupt businessman, an incompetent assassin, and a old lady complicates Ryo's job to protect a beautiful psychic.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E19 - A Beach to Remember: An Audition full of Danger
1.plot: Ryo is asked to investigate threats made to women attending an audition for a film featuring a handsome actor. One of these ladies attending this audition is hoping to reunite with her long-lost father, the director of the movie.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E20 - Her Ladyship Leaves the Mountain: One Long Day for Ryo
1.plot: Ryo is hired to defend a jungle princess from members of her own tribe intent in breaking their isolation from the modern world.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E21 - Faceless Snipers: Ryo's and Saeko's Dangerous Game
1.plot: When Ryo finds himself in a hotel with Saeko, he is forced to accept a job to protect a former newspaper magnate from hitman that he hired himself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E22 - Ryo Plays Cupid: Here's to Diamonds
1.plot: While snooping around a lingerie show, Ryo comes across a woman who stole a beautiful diamond necklace from a wealthy young man. The woman asks Ryo to be her lover, but Ryo is aware that there is more to her story than meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E23 - Buzz Buzz Buzz go the Killer Bees
1.plot: A bride literally falls into Ryo's lap and along with it, some goons hired by the jilted groom. While trying to sneak up on her during the middle of the night, Ryo gets stung by an experimental, but deadly bee. The bride does have the antidote, but as Kaori finds out, it has "terrible" side effects, most notably showing the feminine side of City Hunter.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E24 - A Rosy Hospital Stay?: An Angel in White in Danger
1.plot: In order to find out who is targeting a nurse who is due to be the recipient of a large inheritance, Ryo breaks his foot and ends up in the same hospital the nurse is staying. While Ryo must not tell the nurse that she is being targeted, he also finds out she does not have enough experience being a nurse.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E25 - An International Relationship of Love: My Counterpart is a Blonde Beauty
1.plot: Ryo teams up with a beautiful American agent to find out who is smuggling tanks from Japan.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E26 - What is Love?: Ryo's course in Proper Romance
1.plot: When a father requests the services of City Hunter to protect his daughter from someone stalking her at work, he finds out that the stalker IS City Hunter. The father then requests that City Hunter convince her daughter to quit her job as he feels that she may be in danger of other stalkers. Ryo realizes that the young woman has lived a sheltered life and decides to teach her a few lessons in love.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E27 - Ryo & Umibozu's Sweet Daddy Longlegs Story (Part 1)
1.plot: Umibozu returns to ask Ryo to help him protect Maki, the daughter of his old mentor. Ryo learns of the story of Daddy Longlegs and that Umibozu has been supporting her from a distance. Ryo pretends to take Umibozu's place and then tries many opportunities to sleep with Maki.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E28 - Ryo & Umibozu's Sweet Daddy Longlegs Story (Part 2)
1.plot: Umibozu reveals that the man after Maki is Snake, a former comrade who betrayed Umibozu and her father. The final showdown between Umibozu and Snake takes place in a theater where Maki is performing in her concert. Ryo reveals to Maki who her "Daddy Longlegs" really is.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E29 - A 500 Yen Job: A Cute Little Girl wins Ryo's Heart
1.plot: A young girl manages to convince Ryo to help her idol, a budding children's author, from corporate bullies representing a publishing firm. The price: 500 Yen.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E30 - Ryo's Rival In Love: Give Me Kaori
1.plot: A nephew of a missing wealthy explorer seeks Ryo's services to protect him from his aunt who seeks to obtain his uncle's fortune. However, the young nephew begins to have feelings of affection for Kaori. Kaori meanwhile, is using this opportunity to see how Ryo reacts to the presence of a "rival".

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E31 - Fast Paced Romance: A Girl's Love Closing in Fast
1.plot: Ryo and Kaori come across two opposing jobs involving the same people. Kaori is hired by a member of a Biker Gang who wants her to pretend to be his girlfriend in order to deflect attention from the daughter of a tycoon. And Ryo is hired by the daughter to convince the biker to leave his gang and live a normal life.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E32 - Don't Die Ryo: Hard Boiled Magnum
1.plot: When Ryo is hired by Saeko to bait a well known assassin, the assassin takes notice and issues a formal challenge to Ryo.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E33 - Go For It Umibozu: One, Hard-Boiled First Love Concerto
1.plot: Umibozu is injured while protecting a female pianist with whom he has affection for. He enlists the help of Ryo to help protect the girl from a corrupt politician involved in a bribery scandal and who is trying to report the story in honour of her dead fiance.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E34 - Shock! Ryo's a Papa Don't Wake that Sleeping Child
1.plot: A young girl comes up to Ryo claiming that he is her father. But this is all a ruse by a desperate mother to protect her from her late husband's father who intends to take her away from her mother. Ryo and Kaori both develop a bond with a little girl and Ryo realizes that the late husband's father is not as bad as portrayed.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E35 - A Vision Newscaster Ryo's Mokkori Scandal Report
1.plot: Ryo is assigned to protect a famous reporter as she tries to cover a report involving a corrupt politician and Yakuza.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E36 - A College Girl Plays Hardball for Love! Someone is Trying to Kill Me
1.plot: Ryo must try to ascertain whether or not the adopted daughter of a wealthy tycoon is trying to kill herself. The daughter, however, maintains that it is her adopted father who is trying to kill her. In fact, this is part of an extortion scheme from parties unknown.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E37 - Shinjuku Honor All the Way! The Kimono Beauty Wants To Be My Student (Part One)
1.plot: When Hoodlums try to harass the owner of Otora's cafe into selling her business, Ryo intervenes with the help of a young girl who claims to be a member of the Hanafubuki Gumi, a group representing honor and dignity. However, the hoodlums are members of the Hanafubuki Gumi themselves. When the daughter Kikunosuke asks Ryo to teach her about honor and the Japanese way, the Hanafubuki Gumi hoodlums return and kidnaps Otora. Ryo and Kikunosuke must rescue her and Ryo learns that Kikunosuke is the daughter of the leader of the Hanafubuki Gumi.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E38 - Shinjuku Honor All the Way! The Kimono Beauty Wants To Be My Student (Part Two)
1.plot: Cast away from the Hanafubuki Gumi, Kitoo and the other hoodlums plot to kill Kikunosuke's father and their former leader. Meanwhile, Kikunosuke, on orders from her father, boards with Ryo to learn more about dignity and honor. Kaori goes to Kikunosuke's father with a request to allow her daughter to live a normal life.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E39 - Princess from the Moon! Amnesia Gives Ryo Headaches
1.plot: Ryo runs into a woman who claims she has amnesia and gets notoriously drunk after one sip. Ryo deduces that the girl is not actually suffering from memory loss and is attempting to run away from an overwhelming fact.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E40 - One Sexy Partner! After Shower Compensation
1.plot: Ryo is hired by a female "sweeper" who works for the insurance industry. Their goal is to recover a very expensive diamond stolen from a business tycoon. Once recovered, however, the owner of the diamond double-crosses them and kidnaps Aya. Ryo must rescue her with Kaori's help.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E41 - Saeko's Little Sister is a Private Eye A Passionate Lady's Big Secret (Part One)
1.plot: A new private investigation agency opens next door and it is run by Reika Nogami, Saeko Nogami's younger sister. While Ryo makes constant advances towards her, he learns about Reika's blackmail tactics against Yakuza gangsters as well as the death of her former partner. He also learns that someone has ordered a hit on Reika herself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E42 - Saeko's Little Sister is a Private Eye A Passionate Lady's Big Secret (Part Two)
1.plot: Reika explains to Ryo about how a corrupt police officer is interfering with narcotics investigations, and how her former partner was killed by the Yakuza and her desire to clear his name. This leads to a showdown against an expert marksman and also lands Ryo, Kaori, and Reika in Jail after being set up by the corrupt police officer.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E43 - Utako's Cookie Anniversary Moles on Her Chest and a Love Poem
1.plot: Ryo is requested to protect a famous poet from an increasing number of stalkers following her. When Ryo finds out that the men following her are not ordinary stalkers, he also finds out that his client is also not an ordinary girl.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E44 - We Asked One Hundred Kids, They said, "Ryo's Our Hero."
1.plot: Two brothers have a handful as they deal with a pervert supposedly after their sister who works as a hairstylist. But when they discover a hidden stash of cash stolen in a robbery at a construction site, their sister is kidnapped by the robbers and they must turn to City Hunter for assistance. What they don't realize that the man after their sister is none other than Ryo himself.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E45 - Three Sisters are Calling! Ryo's Skiing Heaven
1.plot: Ryo is requested to take care of three sisters at a ski resort.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E46 - Picking Pockets is a Thrill Pick Pockets for Tomorrow!
1.plot: Ryo and Kaori run into Mariko, an old friend of Kaori's and an aspiring pickpocket. Out of concern for her friend, Kaori asks Ryo to try to convince her to give up pickpocketing. Ryo then issues a challenge: if Mariko can steal Ryo's Wallet, then Mariko can continue as a pickpocket. Otherwise she must quit the profession. Little do the three of them know that Mariko has been targeted by Yakuza after stealing a piece of jewelry containing secret files from a daughter of a Yakuza boss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E47 - Mokkori is the Best Medicine?! A Pool Shot to a Pretty Hustler's Heart
1.plot: Ryo is hired by Yuri, daughter of a famous pool player while she prepares for a match that may determine the fate of her father's pool club. Ryo discovers that Yuri is not a person who does well under pressure, and as such, tries to help her overcome this handicap during the match.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E48 - O Spring Come Soon to Love's Widow Take Off Those Clothes of Mourning
1.plot: A Job referral from Saeko has Ryo protect the widow of a dead tycoon from an unknown extortionist. At the same time, the butler realizes that only Ryo can help the widow from letting go of her tragic loss.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E49 - Sister in Doubt Mokkori is Her Guide to Love?
1.plot: Ryo runs into a young beautiful nun who has lost her cross after a night in the town.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E50 - The Deadliest Enemy! Ryo and Kaori's Final Match (Part One)
1.plot: Kaori has a recurring nightmare regarding Ryo's impending death. Meanwhile, Umibozu narrowly escapes death at the hands of three siblings who are powerful assassins hired by the Lodos Mafia. Badly shaken and wounded, Umibozu tries to find Ryo. At the same time, Saeko and Reika hire Ryo to help them bust a smuggling ring headed by the Lodos Mafia at a large masquerade. The three assassin siblings notice and decide to use this to their advantage. Their target: to kill Ryo by using Kaori Makimura as a hostage.

1.title: FR - Nicky Larson - S01E51 - The Deadliest Enemy! Ryo and Kaori's Final Match (Part Two)
1.plot: With Kaori Kidnapped by the three assassin siblings, the Lodos Mafia issues a formal challenge to Ryo. Ryo, with the help of Umibozu, infiltrates the Lodos Mafia boat in search of Kaori. Kaori realizes that her nightmares foretelling Ryo's death may be true.

1.plot: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

meta.plot: Quand un enquêteur incendie doit faire équipe avec une lieutenante, leur traque de deux pyromanes se transforme en jeu du chat et de la souris.

Pieter, 16 ans, tranquille et taciturne, vit une semaine sur deux chez sa mère policière, ce qu’elle ne sait pas c’est qu’il pratique en cachette le parkour. Un jour, par hasard, il se retrouve à jouer les justiciers. Il est alors repéré par une enquêtrice en herbe, qui, avec son meilleur ami et la cousine de celui-ci, vont bientôt devenir inséparables et membres de la même équipe de choc pour l’accompagner dans ses aventures acrobatiques et masquées.
