meta.plot: When a young boy arrives in a small Mexican village, a profound friendship blossoms with a local kid — and a dark secret seals their bond forever.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - The Secret
1.plot: Manuel arrives in his grandmother's town to a mixed reception. A sight at the market soon captivates him, while Erik hesitates to open up.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Don't Tell Anybody
1.plot: The boys are haunted by eerie visions. Manuel starts school, facing new challenges — and finding solace with the Muxes. A discovery is made at the river.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - There is such a thing as good lies
1.plot: After lying their way out of a situation with Pau's help, Manuel and Erik skip school in search of the truth, growing closer than ever in the journey.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - Together Forever
1.plot: The case takes an unexpected turn. After a looming loss, Rafaela steps in to protect Manuel, but before long, Manuel must face what he most fears.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - Sicarú
1.plot: Years pass, and a mysterious woman arrives in the town, shocking those who see her and finding herself baffled by the enigma surrounding her old home.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Crossroad
1.plot: Sicarú confronts her past, while Erik confronts his own feelings. Alejandro welcomes someone new to the town. Pau gets her results.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - Back Together
1.plot: Pau wonders what's really going between Erik and Sicarú. The Muxes act quickly to shield Emi, who discloses a much darker truth than imagined.

1.title: EN - The Secret of the River [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - One Thousand Loves
1.plot: The Muxes spring into action to drive Felipe away. Ana finally hears what really happened to Pedro, but the turmoil in the town is far from over.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E01 - Tip of the Spear
1.plot: Team Bravo, an elite Tier One Navy SEAL unit, is sent on a clandestine mission to capture a most-wanted terrorist alive.  Meanwhile, team leader Jason Hayes must deal with personal issues affecting his marriage and family.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E02 - Other Lives
1.plot: While on an evidence-collecting mission in Syria, Jason and the SEAL Team find innocent civilians in desperate need of rescue just as enemy forces close in on them. Also, while on the mission, the team debates whether or not to tell Ray that his wife has gone into labor.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E03 - Boarding Party
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL team must rescue a group of researchers being held hostage on a ship in the South China Sea. Also, Clay is ranked in the “bottom five” of his class, jeopardizing his future as a SEAL

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E04 - Ghosts of Christmas Future
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team refuse to abort a mission to capture a dangerous war criminal after it goes sideways. Also, Clay’s controversial father, Ash Spenser, comes to town on his book tour.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E05 - Collapse
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team must protect the American Embassy in South Sudan when the ambassador refuses to evacuate as the country becomes increasingly unstable. Also, Clay and Stella take their relationship to the next level.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E06 - The Spinning Wheel
1.plot: The SEAL Team must work with Jason’s longtime rival, Beau Fuller, and his team to plan and perfect a raid under the watchful eye of top military brass. Also, Clay delivers solemn news to a teammate’s next of kin.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E07 - Borderlines
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team must rescue an undercover CIA operative after she is captured by radical terrorists to be used as a bargaining chip. Also, Clay undergoes the final harrowing exercise for his candidacy into Tier One.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E08 - The Exchange
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team have mixed feelings when they are tasked with bringing home an American soldier who was captured after deserting, in exchange for detainees in Gitmo.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E09 - Rolling Dark
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL team must rescue a Russian scientist and his wife and bring them across the Afghanistan border to safety as Chinese and Russian Special Forces close in, intent on stopping them. Also, Clay endures his first day with Jason’s unit.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E10 - Pattern of Life
1.plot: Tensions are high when Jason and the SEAL Team enter a Yemeni house to locate a cell phone linked to a terrorist network, and interrogate the family while the daughter lays in critical condition after being accidentally shot.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E11 - Containment
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL team are sent to intercept the sale of nuclear weapons, but the mission goes sideways when they must make the treacherous journey back to base with nukes that have unsecured fuel rods. Also, Ray is sidelined with a shoulder injury, and Jason and Alana are shocked by their kids’ reactions when the topic of their reunion is brought up.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E12 - The Upside Down
1.plot: While on a mission to retrieve a downed top-secret drone, Jason and the SEAL Team disobey orders so they can save Clay, who is trapped beneath a room full of armed terrorists. Also, Clay and Stella’s relationship takes a new turn.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E13 - Getaway Day
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team must leave their families immediately when their deployment date is moved up after the team they were going to relieve is ambushed. Also, Jason and Alana make a big decision about their future, and Clay and Stella feel the weight of his marriage proposal.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E14 - Call Out
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team settle into deployment life and get closer to discovering who ambushed Echo Team after Mandy gets a lead from an unlikely source on the base.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E15 - No Man's Land
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team close in on avenging the deaths of Echo Team when they find the money that funded their murder on a nearby poppy farm that was previously used to make heroin. Also, Jason meets an intriguing woman on the base.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E16 - Never Get Out of the Boat
1.plot: Jason leads the SEAL Team on a dangerous daytime mission where Sonny is wounded and must now rely on Clay and his brothers to save his life.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E17 - In Name Only
1.plot: As Jason and the SEAL Team come closer to avenging the loss of Echo Team, Mandy takes matters into her own hands after her boss won’t green-light her mission to take out their biggest target. Also, Jason is unsure of where his relationship with Amy stands.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E18 - Credible Threat
1.plot: Jason and the SEAL Team are tasked with protecting a delegation of congressmen and department of defense officials who come to Jalalabad for a publicity tour even though a credible threat has been made against them.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E19 - Takedown
1.plot: The SEAL Team sends Ray undercover in a busy spice market to make a high-stakes money swap, and Jason attempts to take down a terrorist known to wear a suicide belt. Also, Ray realizes the devastating consequences of his decisions.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E20 - Enemy of My Enemy
1.plot: The lives of Jason and the SEAL Team are in jeopardy when a risky mission to capture a highly valuable target may actually be a trap. Also, Clay and Davis commiserate about the frustrations of having long distance relationships, and Ray has a meeting regarding his involvement with the accidental death of the local boy that could affect his military career.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E21 - The Graveyard of Empires
1.plot: Following a helicopter crash, the SEAL Team must proceed with the mission as hostiles bear down on them and an injured and impaired Jason goes after their target alone.

1.title: FR - SEAL Team - S01E22 - The Cost of Doing Business
1.plot: After Jason lies about his concussion to get cleared for combat, he and the SEAL Team plan a final mission to avenge Echo Team’s deaths once and for all before they return home from deployment.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E01 - Fracture
2.plot: Jason and Bravo Team head to the Gulf of Guinea to rescue American hostages after an oil platform is overtaken by armed militants.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E02 - Never Say Die
2.plot: Jason and Bravo Team travel to Saudi Arabia, where extremists take hold of an underground water source and threaten to release anthrax into the water supply. Also, Ray contemplates joining another team.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E03 - The Worst of Conditions
2.plot: After tragedy strikes, Jason is faced with a huge decision regarding his future with Bravo Team.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E04 - All That Matters
2.plot: Bravo Team is in Mumbai to rescue a U.S. Foreign Service officer being held hostage by radicals who attacked the city. Also, Jason reevaluates his parenting style and finds a way to connect with his kids.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E05 - Say Again Your Last
2.plot: While tasked with rescuing a group of American students held hostage in Mumbai, Bravo Team suffers life-threatening injuries.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E06 - Hold What You Got
2.plot: Bravo Team partners with the Mexican Marines to hunt the head of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E07 - Outside the Wire
2.plot: Bravo Team continues to follow tips that will lead to Andres Doza, the head of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E08 - Parallax
2.plot: Jason and Mandy go undercover as a couple on vacation at an upscale night club in Mexico City in order to track one of Andres Doza's cartel members.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E09 - Santa Muerte
2.plot: Following an ambush, the SEAL team suspects someone on the inside is leaking information to the cartel.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E10 - Prisoner's Dilemma
2.plot: The hunt for Andres Doza comes to a head when the SEAL Team makes one last ditch effort to find and capture the leader of one of the most powerful and lethal drug cartels in Mexico.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E11 - Backwards in High Heels
2.plot: Bravo Team partners with the British Special Air Service to rescue passengers on a hijacked plane who are taken hostage by terrorists.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E12 - Things Not Seen
2.plot: Bravo Team travels to Turkey to rescue a young American who voluntarily married an ISIS leader.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E13 - Time to Shine
2.plot: Bravo Team desperately works to save Sonny from a life-threatening situation, after he becomes trapped in a submarine torpedo tube during a clandestine mission off the coast of North Korea.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E14 - What Appears to Be
2.plot: Bravo Team works with the Congolese Army on a covert mission to capture the head of a rebel militia group. Jason argues with Emma about college. Sonny and Davis make a big decision about their future.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E15 - You Only Die Once
2.plot: Bravo Team sets out on a special ops mission to take down the financier and mastermind behind several terrorist attacks.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E16 - Dirt, Dirt, Gucci
2.plot: As Bravo Team prepares for what they expect to be a “cushy” deployment with the luxury of staying in a hotel in the Philippines, Jason tries to find a way to pay for Emma’s college.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E17 - Paradise Lost
2.plot: While Bravo Team is deployed to train Filipino SEALs, a surprise bomb attack in Manila leaves them in peril.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E18 - Payback
2.plot: Bravo Team is out for revenge as they search for the person responsible for the surprise bomb attack that left one of their own in peril.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E19 - Medicate and Isolate
2.plot: While Bravo Team is on a recovery mission in Mali, their friend, former Navy SEAL Brett Swan, continues to struggle with his mental health.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E20 - Rock Bottom
2.plot: The tension between Jason and Ray comes to a head, and Lisa faces her final test in officer candidate school.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E21 - My Life for Yours
2.plot: Bravo Team desperately searches for Ray after he gets separated from them while in enemy territory.

2.title: FR - SEAL Team - S02E22 - Never Out of the Fight
2.plot: Bravo team’s future is on the line when Commander Shaw recommends they be split up, but Jason’s unit has one final mission to prove him wrong.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E01 - Welcome to the Refuge
3.plot: Jason Hayes leads the team on a mission in Serbia to track down an organization linked to the bombing of multiple American military outposts.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E02 - Ignore and Override
3.plot: Bravo Team continues their mission in Serbia to track down an organization linked to the bombing of multiple American military outposts, when Jason Hayes’ past returns to haunt him and leaves him contemplating his future.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E03 - Theory and Methodology
3.plot: Bravo Team is on a mission in Azerbaijan to help retake a power plant in order to avoid political instability in the area.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E04 - The Strength of the Wolf
3.plot: Tensions boil over among Bravo members when they disagree while training for a mission, and Jason must select a new candidate to join the team.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E05 - All Along the Watchtower (1)
3.plot: Jason pleads to be sent to help Ray and Clay, who are abroad on a mission to protect a U.S. ambassador when their compound is attacked.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E06 - All Along the Watchtower (2)
3.plot: While on a mission abroad to protect U.S. ambassador Nicole Marsden, Bravo Team must fight off enemy attackers trying to infiltrate their compound.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E07 - The Ones You Can't See
3.plot: As Jason contemplates surgery for an injury, Bravo Team is on a mission abroad to help the secret service prevent a sniper attack on U.S. dignitaries.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E08 - Danger Crossing
3.plot: While Jason is sidelined with an injury, Ray takes over as Bravo 1 and leads the team on a mission to rescue a marine pilot who was shot down in enemy territory.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E09 - Kill or Cure
3.plot: Bravo team is on a mission to protect aid convoys in an Ebola hot zone after a warlord steals preserved samples of the virus that can be weaponized.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E10 - Unbecoming an Officer
3.plot: Jason leads Bravo Team on his first mission back following surgery, and Ensign Davis faces disciplinary action

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E11 - Siege Protocol
3.plot: Amid several life-altering moments on the home front, Bravo Team travels overseas to extract a CIA agent who is being held hostage. As the situation escalates, the Tactical Operations Center is compromised and Bravo’s support team comes face-to-face with the enemy.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E12 - Fog of War
3.plot: Following a mission failure, Bravo Team conducts a high-stakes After Action Review to identify who’s responsible for a possible career-ending mistake.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E13 - Objects in Mirror
3.plot: Bravo Team travels overseas for a foreign training exercise to disguise their true mission – to rescue a high-value target that is being held hostage. Also, NASCAR driver Austin Dillon gives the team a special driving lesson.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E14 - Rules of Engagement
3.plot: While Bravo Team is on a special reconnaissance mission abroad, they are diverted to protect a group of American engineers and the dam they are constructing from a terrorist attack. The rules of engagement raise the level of danger, as the team is not permitted to use their weapons unless the enemy fires first.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E15 - Last Known Location
3.plot: Tensions flare on the home front, as Sonny faces disciplinary action, Clay considers a new career path and Jason faces pressure from Capt. Lindell to consider the next phase of his career, all while Bravo Team prepares for a three-month deployment in Afghanistan.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E16 - Drawdown
3.plot: As Bravo Team begins their deployment in Afghanistan during peace negotiations, Sonny reports to an Air Force base in Texas to serve his disciplinary training action, where he gets reacquainted with Hannah, a childhood friend.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E17 - Edge of Nowhere
3.plot: Bravo Team searches for a new terrorist group leader who is orchestrating violent resistance to peace negotiations in Afghanistan. Also, Clay learns what it means to be a leader and Sonny works to repair his relationship with his father in Texas.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E18 - In the Blind
3.plot: Bravo Team gets ambushed by enemy forces during a mission to extract a potential link to a new terrorist leader. Also, Sonny considers planting roots in his hometown.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E19 - No Choice in Duty
3.plot: While Jason escorts Mandy on a condolence visit to the family of a fallen informant, Ray leads Bravo on an urgent mission when they are confronted with a time-sensitive lead on a terrorist leader’s location. Also, Davis reveals to the team that the terrorist leader they’ve been searching for is related to a target from Jason’s past, and Sonny rejoins Bravo team in Afghanistan.

3.title: FR - SEAL Team - S03E20 -

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E03 - The New Normal
4.plot: Bravo Team struggles to adjust to a new team dynamic after several members make life-altering career decisions.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E04 - Shockwave
4.plot: When Warrant Officer Ray Perry goes missing following an explosion in Tunisia, his former teammates wrestle with how to help their brother and his family while Bravo Team is sidelined.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E05 - The Carrot or The Stick
4.plot: With no leads on Ray’s whereabouts, Jason pushes Bravo team to extreme lengths and considers crossing a dangerous line to help locate their missing brother. Meanwhile, Ray tries to survive captivity.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E06 - Horror Has a Face
4.plot: As Ensign Davis tracks Ray’s location to a shipping container in the Mediterranean Ocean, Bravo team becomes increasingly desperate to rescue their brother before it’s too late.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E07 - All In
4.plot: As Bravo continues grappling with major changes, the team spins up on a mission in Ecuador. Also, Natalie presents a life-changing idea to Jason.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E08 - Cover for Action
4.plot: When Jason returns to Bravo, tensions rise as Ray outranks him on a mission to recover military drones in Syria. Sonny receives surprising news from Texas.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E09 - Reckoning
4.plot: As Ray continues to lead the mission in Syria, the stakes grow higher when members of Bravo team learn the truth about their target.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E10 - A Question of Honor
4.plot: Jason’s career and freedom hang in the balance when Command accuses him of committing a horrific crime during a mission. With Bravo under a no-contact order, Jason must fight this battle without his brothers.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E11 - Limits of Loyalty
4.plot: Jason is put on trial with a potential career-ending outcome, without knowing if his closest friend, Ray, has his back. Also, Stella moves in with Clay, and Sonny visits Hannah to help her prepare for the arrival of their baby.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E12 - Rearview Mirror
4.plot: Jason's visit with a former teammate causes him to reevaluate his role as team leader. Also, several Bravo members grapple with their personal relationships when Command sends them on an unexpected mission to the coast of Africa.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E13 - Do No Harm
4.plot: Bravo is tasked with bringing a defecting Boko Haram lieutenant into U.S. custody, but the mission goes sideways when the target gets attacked. Sonny drops the ball as Bravo’s rep on the USS Keating, and the entire team pays the price.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E14 - Hollow at the Core
4.plot: Bravo is tasked with a covert mission to infiltrate a Boko Haram camp, hack its data network and rescue an American hostage.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E15 - Nightmare of My Choice
4.plot: Bravo joins forces to protect a crucial Nigerian pipeline under attack by Boko Haram. But when a team member is injured, Jason and Clay fight to save his life, and Bravo discovers an even more dangerous enemy is attacking them.

4.title: FR - SEAL Team - S04E16 - One Life To Live
4.plot: Bravo takes a devastating hit that will change the team forever, and forces each of the members to make some big personal decisions. Fourth season finale.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E01 - Trust, But Verify (1)
5.plot: Everyone on Bravo is shocked when they learn a training exercise is really cover for a covert mission to get a weapons expert out of one of the most dangerous countries in the world.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E02 - Trust, But Verify (2)
5.plot: When Bravo’s operation is compromised, they must figure out how to escape undetected from one of the most dangerous countries in the world.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E03 - Nine Ten
5.plot: As members of Bravo team travel to New York City, they reflect on a day that shaped each of their lives forever.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E04 - Need to Know (1)
5.plot: As each member of Bravo confronts major family obstacles, the team gets spun up on a sudden mission in Africa. When the intel alters their plan, the team finds themselves in a rush to prevent a major terrorist attack.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E06 - Man on Fire (3)
5.plot: Bravo manages to escape their SUV engulfed in flames, but plans go awry when Jason's personal and professional lives become intertwined and he's forced to make decisions that put Bravo's jobs and lives at risk. The team works through disagreements, reveals exciting personal news and an unlikely hero emerges.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E07 - What's Past Is Prologue
5.plot: Bravo returns to Afghanistan to continue the fight against the Taliban, and the Team ruminates on America's longtime involvement in the War on Terror.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E08 - Conspicuous Gallantry
5.plot: After an op gone sideways lands the whole team in the hospital, Bravo must create a little chaos to stay calm, while Clay tries to piece together what went wrong.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E09 - Close to Home
5.plot: Jason seeks refuge at home while Ray leads Bravo Team on an op accompanying British forces.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E10 - Head On
5.plot: Bravo Team is presented with a mission in South America unlike any other, while tensions surrounding Jason’s leadership are at an all-time high.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E11 - Violence of Action
5.plot: Bravo Team is still on the ground in South America working against the Iranian nuclear project. Multiple high stakes missions only make the team’s interpersonal problems more obvious to all.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E12 - Keys To Heaven
5.plot: Jason must confront his deepest fears on the road to healing while Clay and Sonny are forced to take certain matters into their own hands.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E13 - Pillar Of Strength
5.plot: Bravo will need all hands on deck for a massive mission to shut down the Venezuelan nuclear program, but the biggest threat to their success could be one of their own.

5.title: FR - SEAL Team - S05E14 - All Bravo Stations
5.plot: Bravo must make a daring escape before they can put Venezuela in their rearview mirror, but they find themselves on even less stable ground when they return home to Virginia Beach.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E01 - Low-Impact
6.plot: BRAVO battles to survive a devastating ambush that will leave the team forever altered.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E02 - Crawl, Walk, Run
6.plot: BRAVO is deployed on a high-stakes mission in Russian controlled territory as Clay battles with his recovery.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E03 - Growing Pains
6.plot: BRAVO finds unlikely allies as they are deployed to Northern Syria to track down those responsible for the attack on the U.S.S. Crampton.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E04 - Phantom Pattern
6.plot: BRAVO works with the YPJ to suss out who is responsible for the bombing of the U.S.S. Crampton while struggling to accept their newest Team Member.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E05 - Thunderstruck
6.plot: A missed opportunity deepens the mistrust between Jason and Omar, and puts Bravo and their partner force in the crosshairs of a powerful enemy.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E06 - Watch Your 6
6.plot: Back home from Syria, Bravo unexpectedly finds themselves on a deeply personal mission.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E07 - Strange Bedfellows
6.plot: BRAVO is called back to Syria to handle some unfinished business.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E08 - Aces and Eights
6.plot: BRAVO heads to Amman, Jordan to find the Iranian General who has backed Yasiri’s militia.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E09 - Damage Assessment
6.plot: After a successful interrogation in Jordan, BRAVO is given devastating news that will impact the Team forever.

6.title: FR - SEAL Team - S06E10 - Fair Winds and Following Seas
6.plot: Reeling from a devastating loss, BRAVO must fight their way out of hostile territory.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E01 - Chaos in the Calm (1)
7.plot: After taking a stand against Command for better warfighter health, BRAVO is forced to the sidelines and eventually sent to Sweden on an underwhelming assignment. Lieutenant Davis is picked by Admiral Rivas to lead a new spec ops initiative.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E02 - Chaos in the Calm (2)
7.plot: BRAVO finds themselves at the scene of a terrorist attack in Sweden and Jason survives a close call. Lieutenant Davis gives her new unit an ultimatum, and a family member surprises Drew and issues a mysterious warning.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E03 - Ships in the Night
7.plot: Lieutenant Davis and Captain Walsh send BRAVO to Thailand to partner with the DEA on a joint-task force focused on the fentanyl trade. The goal is to intercept a cargo ship and acquire intel that details the Chinese government's involvement. Drew is assigned to BRAVO full-time despite his objections and a journalist later questions him about his family's history. During the mission, Drew goes rogue and makes a decision that jeopardizes everything.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E04 - Heroes and Criminals
7.plot: BRAVO targets a factory in Myanmar that the DEA has tied to China and fentanyl production. Lieutenant Davis wants the team to pull intel and destroy the plant. Jason vies for a safer plan, and some on the team begin to question his decisions.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E05 - A Perfect Storm
7.plot: Even the closest of brothers fight eventually. Tempers flare during a surveillance mission in Malaysia. As the team sets up camp in scorching hot temperatures, grievances are aired and Drew finally reveals why he's been so closed off.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E06 - Hundred-Year Marathon
7.plot: BRAVO's next mission is to capture Jun Yilin in Cambodia, but they'll be without their leaders. Ray is pulled into diplomatic negotiations and Jason travels home to help his son recover from surgery—a task that takes a dramatic turn for the worse.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E07 - Mission Creep
7.plot: BRAVO's back together and sent on a mission to verify concerning intel that links China's drug trafficking to a potential coup in Honduras. Before leaving, Jason, Ray and Drew all struggle with something personal, resulting in a volatile dynamic.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E08 - Appetite for Destruction
7.plot: BRAVO finally finds some fentanyl, officially linking Nazario to the smuggling operation. Despite instructions to keep a low-profile, Jason destroys the fentanyl and kills all the guards. Later, the team makes a shocking discovery at Nazario's camp.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E09 - The Sea and the Hills
7.plot: BRAVO returns from Nazario's camp stunned. Forced to regroup, the team hastily develops another plan to capture him, but they walk right into a trap. Later, Jason is pulled from the mission by Command and given a different objective.

7.title: FR - SEAL Team - S07E10 - The Last Word
7.plot: Does war always have the last word? Jason wrestles with guilt and searches for closure in Afghanistan. The Decker investigation comes to a close, Ray starts his new chapter and the new-look BRAVO jumps right into the next mission.

meta.plot: Le quotidien professionnel et personnel des membres de la plus haute unité d'élite des Navy SEALs, qui s’entraînent, planifient et exécutent les missions les plus dangereuses à la demande du gouvernement américain.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When a crisis at LAX prevents dozens of airplanes from landing, the government brings in a group of misfit geniuses to sort things out.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E02 - Single Point of Failure
1.plot: The governor calls on Team Scorpion when his daughter is mysteriously "bio-hacked" with a deadly virus and only has 24 hours to live. The case takes on a deeper significance for Walter after he receives a letter regarding his sister.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E03 - A Cyclone
1.plot: After failing a military training mission, the team members are determined to prove themselves when an Internet infrastructure is threatened by a bomber.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E04 - Shorthanded
1.plot: Against Cabe's advice, Team Scorpion heads to Las Vegas for a simple casino job, but a robbery leads to Walter's arrest and the rest of the team is left to clear his name.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E05 - Plutonium Is Forever
1.plot: To fix a Los Angeles nuclear reactor that's on the verge of a cataclysmic meltdown, Walter and the team must reluctantly enlist the help of a troubled former member.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E06 - True Colors
1.plot: The members of Team Scorpion must pass a mandated psych evaluation or face being disbanded after they're accused of destroying a priceless work of art in an attempt to protect an art exhibit. Paige enlists the help of the team when Ralph is reluctant to go to his school's Halloween party.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E07 - Father's Day
1.plot: A case gets personal for Team Scorpion when three convicts break out of prison and one of them is a brilliant hacker who was forced to help the others steal billions online. Meanwhile, Paige must manage Ralph's expectations when his father returns.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E08 - Risky Business
1.plot: Team Scorpion enlists the help of a musician who created a controversial algorithm that generates hit songs to help find the murderer of a music blogger.  Meanwhile, Drew asks Walter to help him connect with his son.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E09 - Rogue Element
1.plot: Team Scorpion try to protect Cabe's ex-wife, after she uncovers evidence that suggests foul play in the death of a prominent congressman.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E10 - Talismans
1.plot: When a military plane is shot down in Bosnia, Team Scorpion must help recover its stealth technology before it falls into enemy hands. Meanwhile, Walter's sister takes a break from her MS treatment and spends time at the garage with Sylvester

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E11 - Revenge
1.plot: When Sylvester accidentally triggers an explosive device during an investigation, Team Scorpion must focus on finding who's responsible even while their friend's life hangs in the balance.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E12 - Dominoes
1.plot: On Christmas Eve, Team Scorpion races to find a way to save a young boy's life after he is trapped in a beachside cave and the rising tide threatens to drown him.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E13 - Kill Screen
1.plot: Team Scorpion must help Ralph when the FBI questions him after his dark web game play inadvertently reveals the location of a CIA safe house and results in the murder of CIA operatives.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E14 - Charades
1.plot: Team Scorpion is tasked with uncovering a mole inside the CIA who is being coerced into stealing deadly chemicals. Paige gives Walter a flirting lesson in preparation for the case.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E15 - Forget Me Nots
1.plot: Team Scorpion must jog the memory of an injured former Secret Service agent to prevent nuclear weapons from being launched. Meanwhile, Paige is torn when Drew suggests that moving to Maine might be the best for Ralph.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E16 - Love Boat
1.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover on a cruise ship to locate and disable deadly stolen rockets. Meanwhile, as Valentine's Day approaches, Toby and Happy help Ralph, who is in the throes of his first crush.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E17 - Going South
1.plot: A tech billionaire hires Team Scorpion to rescue his kidnapped daughter. Meanwhile, some feelings get hurt when Walter gives an interview and fails to acknowledge the other members of the team.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E18 - Once Bitten, Twice Die
1.plot: When a conflict in Eastern Europe threatens to escalate, Team Scorpion is called on to help facilitate secret peace talks to prevent World War III.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E19 - Young Hearts Spark Fire
1.plot: While on a mission to save lost hikers, Team Scorpion’s helicopter crashes, igniting a massive wildfire that quickly closes in on them. Also, Sylvester must help their injured pilot who is unable to make it to safer ground.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E20 - Crossroads
1.plot: To protect a key witness who is en route to testifying against a deadly drug cartel, Team Scorpion takes her on the run, with the cartel hot on their heels.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E21 - Cliffhanger
1.plot: Walter finally learns Cabe’s long-kept secret regarding the Baghdad mission, and it threatens to tear Team Scorpion apart forever.  Also, Paige’s world is rocked when Ralph puts his life in danger to help the team.

1.title: FR - Scorpion - S01E22 - Postcards from the Edge
1.plot: Scorpion, torn apart and uncertain about their future as a team, must come together for their most important mission yet – to save Walter’s life as his car teeters on the side of a cliff.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E01 - Satellite of Love
2.plot: The new Director of Homeland Security, Adriana Molina, reunites the team when a nuclear powered Russian satellite is knocked out of orbit and must be diverted before it detonates over Southern California. Paige and Walter face their feelings for each other when hospital footage reveals that Paige kissed him.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E02 - Cuba Libre
2.plot: Team Scorpion heads to Cuba when a woman from Cabe’s past pleads for him to help catch a Serbian war criminal.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E03 - Fish Filet
2.plot: Sylvester goes undercover in a federal prison in order to save the lives of three judges, but the team must help him escape when his life is threatened.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E04 - Robots
2.plot: Walter, Cabe and Happy are trapped with the crew in a top secret submarine when an explosion sends it to the bottom of the ocean with limited oxygen and a self-destruct function that will soon activate.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E05 - Super Fun Guys
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover on the “Super Fun Guy” movie set in Kazakhstan in order to disable a soviet era nuclear missile being sold by terrorists.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E06 - Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll
2.plot: Walter’s attempt to “normalize” goes horribly wrong when a nefarious virus is uploaded to his computer, turning Team Scorpion’s new “smart” building project into a burning death trap with people locked inside.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E07 - Crazy Train
2.plot: Team Scorpion must stop a sabotaged runaway subway train with Paige and Ralph on board. Also, in his attempt to impress Happy, Toby has his first boxing match.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E08 - Area 51
2.plot: Team Scorpion helps the CIA locate a top-secret aircraft in Area 51 in order to raise money for Walter's research to save his sister's life.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E09 - US vs. UN vs. UK
2.plot: Team Scorpion is blackmailed to break into the United Nations to assist in the assassination of a menacing arms dealer. Also, Sylvester makes a bold move to protect Megan's wishes.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E10 - Arrivals and Departures
2.plot: When Team Scorpion and Walter's parents visit Megan in the hospital as her health deteriorates, they are quarantined after a deadly fungus outbreak threatens to infect everyone.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E11 - The Old College Try
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes undercover at a university to find a hacker who infiltrates the Federal Reserve and threatens to collapse the world economy.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E12 - Dam Breakthrough
2.plot: Team Scorpion must stop a catastrophe on Christmas Eve when heavy rain creates a large crack in a dam, putting an entire town in danger.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E13 - White Out
2.plot: The members of Team Scorpion brave subzero temperatures in Antarctica to save a United States Special Forces unit. Toby risks his life to save Happy.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E14 - Sun of a Gun
2.plot: Sylvester comes face to face with his estranged father, a retired general, who asks Team Scorpion for help when he believes that a dictator in Africa has uncovered a deadly World War II-era weapon of mass destruction and intends to use it.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E15 - Da Bomb
2.plot: Team Scorpion is tasked with helping NASA’s top secret rocket launch, but they must sabotage their own mission when Walter’s date from the previous night has a bomb strapped to her chest.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E16 - Fractured
2.plot: After a powerful earthquake rocks Los Angeles, Team Scorpion must fix a pinched gas line to prevent a massive explosion.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E17 - Adaptation
2.plot: While Team Scorpion works to stop an influx of drugs being smuggled into the country via drones, Walter gives Happy and Toby an ultimatum on their new relationship.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E18 - The Fast & the Nerdiest
2.plot: After Sylvester scores big on The Price Is Right, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a high-end car smuggling operation about to ship bioweapons to South America.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E19 - Ticker
2.plot: When Los Angeles’ blood supply is hacked and deemed unusable because of fear it’s been tainted, Team Scorpion must find the culprit in order to save a young girl in desperate need of a heart transplant.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E20 - Djibouti Call
2.plot: While on a secret mission in Djibouti, Africa, with his new Homeland protégé, Tim Armstrong, Cabe is captured and Team Scorpion must save him.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E21 - Twist and Shout
2.plot: Team Scorpion’s mission to recover the remains of fallen Marines in Vietnam is threatened along with their lives when a deadly tornado heads directly towards them.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E22 - Hard Knox
2.plot: Team Scorpion is hired by the Department of Defense to break into Fort Knox and “steal” a precious artifact in order to test their security, but they must break in a second time when they find something dangerous hidden inside the object.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E23 - Chernobyl Intentions
2.plot: Team Scorpion goes to Chernobyl to repair the decaying nuclear reactor before a catastrophic meltdown, but must also save Sylvester and Paige when they become trapped inside.

2.title: FR - Scorpion - S02E24 - Toby or Not Toby
2.plot: Team Scorpion must outthink their unstable ex-Scorpion member, Mark Collins, after he kidnaps Toby and threatens to kill him unless his cunning demands are met.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E03 - It Isn’t the Fall That Kills You
3.plot: When Walter is accidentally launched into space in a rocket, he hallucinates about Paige as his oxygen runs low, and Team Scorpion works feverishly to find a way to bring him home before he suffocates.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E04 - Little Boy Lost
3.plot: Team Scorpion must find a boy from Ralph’s class who goes missing on a field trip after he accidentally has a run-in with a deadly criminal. Also, Toby gets closer to finding out the identity of Happy’s husband.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E05 - Plight at the Museum
3.plot: Team Scorpion’s simple job at the Los Angeles Natural History Museum turns deadly when they discover thieves robbing a rare gem exhibit in order to get materials needed to enrich a nuclear bomb.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E06 - Bat Poop Crazy
3.plot: Before Halloween, Team Scorpion must infiltrate a deep, vast cave system in order to prevent a bat population from destroying the North America ecosystem. Also, the team dons costumes to stage photos from Halloween’s past for Walter’s upcoming immigration inspection.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E07 - We’re Gonna Need a Bigger Vote
3.plot: On Election Day, as democracy hangs in the balance, Team Scorpion is called on when someone tries to throw the U.S. presidential election into chaos.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E08 - Sly and the Family Stone
3.plot: When Team Scorpion travels to Ireland for Megan’s one-year memorial, Walter discovers that a nearby lake’s natural disaster has created a poisonous cloud that could kill everyone in the village. Also, Cabe and Toby try to alleviate the tension between Tim and Walter.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E09 - Mother Load
3.plot: Paige’s estranged mother calls on Team Scorpion when she accidentally uncovers a forgotten nuclear reactor on the verge of exploding.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E10 - This is the Pits
3.plot: Walter must swim through the deadly La Brea Tar Pits when Team Scorpion helps a woman trapped in the tar before she runs out of oxygen.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E11 - Wreck the Halls
3.plot: It’s Christmas Eve and Team Scorpion’s electronics-free mountain getaway turns deadly when they come across gun-runners, and Ralph is kidnapped when they try to escape.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E12 - Ice Ca-Cabes
3.plot: When a mission in the desert results in exploding shrapnel that seriously wounds Cabe, Team Scorpion must freeze his body in order to save his life.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E13 - Faux Money Maux Problems
3.plot: When Team Scorpion is duped into producing counterfeit money for a foreign entity intent on ruining the U.S. economy, Paige must rely on her mother Veronica’s skills as a grifter to save them.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E14 - The Hole Truth
3.plot: Team Scorpion must save a man teetering on the edge of a massive sink hole that threatens to destroy the Los Angeles water supply forever.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E15 - Sharknerdo
3.plot: Team Scorpion’s job to find sunken treasure goes awry when Walter and Paige’s boat explodes, leaving them lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean surrounded by sharks.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E16 - Keep it in Check, Mate
3.plot: Walter and Sylvester enter an international chess competition under cover on foreign soil for Team Scorpion in order to extricate a U.S. spy before her identity is exposed.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E17 - Dirty Seeds, Done Dirt Cheap
3.plot: When a simple mission to protect a vital seed bank goes awry, Team Scorpion must save Happy, Sylvester and Cabe, who begin suffering from life-threatening, fear-based hallucinations.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E18 - Don't Burst My Bubble
3.plot: Following a severe storm, Happy’s friend Ada, who lives in a sterile bubble to protect her compromised immune system, is left with dangerous debris on the verge of puncturing the structure. Now, Team Scorpion works to safely move Ada to a more secure location without risking her life.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E19 - Monkey See, Monkey Poo
3.plot: To stop a dangerous virus from spreading, Team Scorpion must locate a rare endangered monkey in the Amazon that has the antibody for the cure. Also, Toby and Happy see a counselor to prepare for matrimony.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E20 - Broken Wind
3.plot: While on a mission to repair a turbine at a wind farm, Team Scorpion must race to save Paige and Happy before the cable holding the gondola they are in snaps and sends them plummeting to the ground.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E21 - Rock Block
3.plot: Team Scorpion must defy the orders of a foreign government after they retrieve an asteroid from space containing DNA strands that could have deadly consequences once exposed.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E22 - Strife on Mars
3.plot: Team Scorpion gets trapped inside a failing and dangerous biodome designed for Mars while trying to extract a pair of scientists inside.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E23 - Something Burrowed, Something Blew
3.plot: Team Scorpion help Toby and Happy race to the altar to say “I Do” after a simple job extinguishing a tunnel fire becomes catastrophic.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E24 - Maroon 8
3.plot: While en route to Toby and Happy’s honeymoon, Team Scorpion’s plane crash lands on a remote deserted island, leaving them all with little hope for rescue.

3.title: FR - Scorpion - S03E25 - Scorp Family Robinson
3.plot: Three weeks after they crash land on a deserted island, tensions run high for Team Scorpion when they must battle to overcome their relationship obstacles with each other in order to be rescued.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E01 - Extinction
4.plot: Team Scorpion must work with their old nemesis Mark Collins in order to prevent the extinction of mankind. Also, Walter and Paige awkwardly navigate their new relationship.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E02 - More Extinction
4.plot: Team Scorpion continues to work with their nemesis, Mark Collins, in order to prevent an extinction event that could end humanity. Also, Cabe’s last-minute decision while on the case leads to the possible end of his career.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E03 - Grow a Deer, A Female Deer
4.plot: When poachers almost kill a pregnant endangered deer, Team Scorpion recreates the animal’s womb to try to save it and its baby’s life. Also, Happy and Toby discuss the future of their family.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E04 - Nuke Kids on the Block
4.plot: While decommissioning an old nuclear missile, a simple accident causes Team Scorpion to endure exposure to toxic vapor while trying to prevent the nuke from detonating. Also, Paige confronts Happy about constantly tagging along with her and Walter.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E05 - Sci Hard
4.plot: While attending a tech convention, Team Scorpion is taken hostage by a group attempting a virtual heist.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E06 - Queen Scary
4.plot: At Halloween, Team Scorpion takes on a case to prove the existence of ghosts on the Queen Mary but find an all-too-real disaster when they locate a “ghost ship” on a deadly collision course. Also, Walter considers taking note of Paige’s interests to benefit their relationship.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E07 - Go with the Flo(rence)
4.plot: While tracking a device that can prevent a nuclear meltdown through the Los Angeles sewers, Walter learns the nuances of listening and not offering advice to Paige. Also, Team Scorpion meets Florence, their new neighbor at the garage, after she sends a mix of smelly chemicals through their shared ventilation as a warning to keep the noise down.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E08 - Faire Is Foul
4.plot: For Sylvester’s birthday, Team Scorpion visits a renaissance festival, but the revelry is cut short when a group tries to rob a nearby police evidence locker. Also, Paige grows weary of Walter’s play-by-play of all the historical inaccuracies at the festival

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E09 - It's Raining Men (Of War)
4.plot: On Thanksgiving, Team Scorpion's new neighbor, Florence, joins them at sea on a mission to destroy a floating island of trash, but her flawed contribution leaves her, Walter and Happy stranded on the quickly dissolving island. Also, Toby works with Cabe to uncover the details of his father's death that he has suppressed since he was a boy.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E10 - Crime Every Mountain
4.plot: As Cabe’s trial looms over Team Scorpion, a simple case goes sideways when they help a father and his daughter whose plane crashes nearby. Also, Paige helps Walter navigate his feelings about Cabe’s possible future in prison.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E11 - Who Let the Dog Out ('Cause Now It's Stuck in a Cistern)
4.plot: As Team Scorpion anxiously awaits the verdict of Cabe’s trial which could send him to prison, they focus their nervous energy on trying to save a dog stuck in a cistern.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E12 - A Christmas Car-Roll
4.plot: On Christmas Eve, when Walter chooses work over spending quality time with his friends, he falls down the stairs and hits his head, and as he lays unconscious, he enters a dream world where Team Scorpion never existed.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E13 - The Bunker Games
4.plot: Team Scorpion must work with Toby’s nemesis, Quincy Berkstead, and his wife, Amy, Toby’s ex-fiancée, when they are locked inside an artificially intelligent doomsday bunker that aims to kill them. Also, Walter is distracted by his recent dream where he is married to Florence, not Paige.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E14 - Lighthouse of the Rising Sun
4.plot: A solar storm knocks out power in Los Angeles, and Team Scorpion must help a teen pilot and his girlfriend who are lost over the Pacific without navigation or radio contact. Also, during the crisis, Walter must look after a group of Ralph’s classmates, and Cabe tries to tell Allie finally that he loves her.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E15 - Wave Goodbye
4.plot: Team Scorpion must prevent an incoming tsunami from hitting a vulnerable nuclear power facility, and Toby secretly helps his ex-fiancée retrieve her stolen identity.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E16 - Nerd, Wind and Fire
4.plot: On Valentine's Day, Team Scorpion must set aside their romantic plans to help a doctor and pilot trapped inside a helicopter that crashed atop a skyscraper. Also, Toby and Happy wait for news on their fertility results, and Sylvester realizes that he may have feelings for Florence.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E17 - Dumbster Fire
4.plot: The geniuses of Team Scorpion turn into knuckleheads and Paige must simplify the science for them, when their mental faculties are impaired during a job to prevent the creation of a black hole. Also, Florence and Sylvester grow closer when she helps him with a special project.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E18 - Dork Day Afternoon
4.plot: Team Scorpion inadvertently crashes a bank robbery in progress and is taken hostage. Also, Sylvester’s feelings for Florence grow.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E19 - Gator Done
4.plot: Team Scorpion heads to the bayou to track down a cagey alligator in order to stop a deadly mosquito-borne virus, and Paige teaches Walter the concept of the “white lie.” Also, Walter hits Cabe with a tranquilizer gun and Toby must save his life, and Sylvester and Ralph help Patty when the mean girls at her school force her to get a dreaded tardy slip.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E20 - Foul Balls
4.plot: Team Scorpion must use their high IQs to win a softball game when the homeland director challenges, with all of their future government contracts on the line. Also, Walter’s secret night out with Florence puts Toby and Happy on edge.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E21 - Kenny and the Jet
4.plot: Paige’s maternal side goes into high gear when Team Scorpion must save an unconscious, hypothermic boy stuck in the wheel well of their airborne airplane. Also, Walter’s white lie to Paige starts to take a toll on him, and Paige realizes something’s up.

4.title: FR - Scorpion - S04E22 - A Lie in the Sand
4.plot: Team Scorpion heads to Northeast Africa where they must carefully navigate a minefield in order to save the lives of local villagers. Also, Paige and Walter’s relationship takes a shocking turn, and Toby and Happy make an important decision.

meta.plot: Le ministère de l'Intérieur engage un génie et son équipe hétéroclite de prodiges pour protéger la nation d'une nouvelle génération sophistiquée de terroristes.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A British man crashes his car in Beijing and upon his return, he's accused of murder. After an incident on board, the officer escorting him begins to suspect foul play.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As Nolan fears for his life, tensions rise on board; Hana is instructed to investigate by the head of MI5 Delaney; Hana's sister starts digging into the events occurring on NCA 357.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Nolan recounts the events in Beijing; Hana continues to investigate the events on board; Jess's findings lead her to a mysterious international medical company.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Jess fears for her life when she becomes a target for both MI5 and a deadly assassin; Delaney uncovers a shocking truth that changes her understanding of events that night.

1.title: FR - Code Rouge [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The truth about events on board is revealed, forcing Hana to take drastic action; Tennant is put in charge of Delaney's operation, forcing Delaney to break protocol.

meta.plot: Après avoir assisté à une conférence médicale à Pékin et avoir frôlé la mort dans un accident de voiture, le Dr Matthew Nolan rentre chez lui. Il est arrêté à l'aéroport londonien d'Heathrow. Épuisé et confus, Nolan est accusé du meurtre d'une femme qui se trouvait dans la voiture qu'il a accidentée.

Février 2022, alors que la guerre brutale commence, une personne sur deux a quitté Kiev. Pourtant, une personne sur deux est restée. Voici leurs histoires, tour à tour émouvantes, drôles, tristes, brutales, troublantes et édifiantes.

1.title: FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Ceux qui restent - S01E06 - Episode 6
FR - Dead Hot - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A first date with Will leaves Elliot floating—but also triggered. Jess receives a DNA match that changes everything. And when someone from Elliot's past shows up at work, there's no denying it—the horrors of 5 years ago are back to haunt them.

1.title: FR - Dead Hot - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hoping to get more info on her DNA match, Jess visits the app's headquarters and meets someone who could have all the answers. Elliot continues his search for Will and discovers how deep the connections to Peter really go.

meta.plot: Liverpool, Elliot et Jess, deux jeunes vingtenaires, sont les meilleurs amis du monde, unis par le chagrin d'avoir perdu leur ami, Peter. Bientôt Elliot rencontre Will et Jess est contactée par quelqu'un qui prétend être son frère, ces individus vont bousculer leurs vies.

FR - Spring of Youth [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Spring of Youth [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Spring of Youth [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Spring of Youth [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5

meta.plot: Seong-A mène une double vie d'étudiante et de chamane. Traitée avec mépris parce qu'elle voit des fantômes et s'occupe d'eux, elle garde le sourire. Elle sait qu'elle est différente. Le beau Gyeon-U est frappé de malchance et destiné à mourir, mais lorsqu'il entre dans son sanctuaire la tête en bas, Seong-A jure de le sauver. Une histoire de premier amour qui montre que l'amour triomphe de tout.
