meta.plot: Un ancien tireur d'élite reprend du service pour déjouer un complot imminent contre le Président des États-Unis, mais se retrouve accusé de tentative de meurtre.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E01 - Point of Impact
1.plot: Retired Marine sniper Bob Lee Swagger is recruited by his former commander to stop an assassination of the president; and FBI agent Nadine Memphis investigates potential assassins.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E02 - Exfil
1.plot: Bob Lee tries to protect his family while incarcerated; and Isaac aims to silence him. In other events, Nadine contacts Bob Lee's wife, Julie, who's dealing with the backlash against her family.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E03 - Musa Qala
1.plot: Bob Lee reaches out to Nadine while evading his pursuers; and Isaac juggles his double life while trying to find Bob Lee.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E04 - Overwatch
1.plot: Bob Lee plans his next moves; and Isaac ties up loose ends. In other events, Nadine investigates the Ukrainian connection.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E05 - Recon by Fire
1.plot: Bob Lee locates the bullet from the assassination, which leads him to a radical militia group and Isaac; and Nadine is locked in a deadly game of cat and mouse with Payne.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E06 - Killing Zone
1.plot: Bob Lee tracks down his former instructor, who he hopes will help him find the shooter; Nadine interrogates Payne; Isaac realizes that he's in over his head; and a reporter makes Julie an offer.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E07 - Danger Close
1.plot: Bob Lee travels across the country in order to find the shooter; Julie deals with a family betrayal; Nadine contacts a Ukrainian reporter who can explain the conspiracy; and Isaac questions his allegiance.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E08 - Red on Red
1.plot: Bob Lee and Nadine plot to secure evidence that could expose the conspiracy. Isaac searches for an exit strategy. Payne tries to flee. Julie and Mary are in danger.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E09 - Ballistic Advantage
1.plot: Bob Lee negotiates an exchange in order to save his family; Nadine juggles her allegiances to Bob Lee and the FBI; and Isaac strikes a deal for his freedom.

1.title: FR - Shooter - S01E10 - Primer Contact
1.plot: Bob Lee, Julie, Nadine and Isaac work together to breach the Russian embassy, save Mary, shut down the conspiracy and prove Bob Lee innocent.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E01 - The Hunting Party
2.plot: Bob Lee Swagger and wife Julie join his former Marine unit in Germany and narrowly escape a deadly terrorist attack. FBI Agent Nadine Memphis, meanwhile, takes a job in Washington with Patricia Gregson.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E02 - Remember The Alamo
2.plot: Bob Lee investigates the terrorist attack that may have targeted his Marine unit. Memphis helps on the ground in Germany. Flashbacks to Afghanistan help shed light on who might be after them.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E03 - Don't Mess With Texas
2.plot: Bob Lee finds Isaac Johnson in Texas after an attempt on his life. Nadine discovers just how much influence Patricia Gregson wields, and a traumatized Julie fights to stay strong for her family.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E04 - The Dark End of the Street
2.plot: Bob Lee and Isaac learn the world's greatest assassin is in the U.S. Flashbacks to a mission in Afghanistan reveal his identity: Solotov. Nadine comes to Texas with suspicions of a conspiracy.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E05 - The Man Called Noon
2.plot: Bob Lee works to piece together Solotov's motive for targeting their unit. Nadine uncovers a surprise witness to the event that set everything off. Solotov's hunt has him hiding in plain sight.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E06 - Across the Rio Grande
2.plot: Bob Lee tracks Solotov's money, pitting himself against a Mexican cartel. Nadine helps a journalist investigate a cover-up involving Bob Lee's unit. Julie makes her frustration heard with a gun.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E07 - Someplace Like Bolivia
2.plot: Bob Lee and Isaac must team up to escape a Mexican prison before Solotov finds them. As Nadine digs deeper into Atlas, the cover-up points back to Bob Lee's unit. Julie has problems with the law.

2.title: FR - Shooter - S02E08 - That'll Be the Day
2.plot: Bob Lee tries to draw out Solotov, but realizes he holds the upper hand; flashbacks reveal the origin of Solotov; Isaac is courted by his creator. Season Finale.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E01 - Backroads
3.plot: Julie and Isaac team up to save Bob Lee after he is kidnapped by Solotov; Nadine confronts Hayes about Atlas; new information about Bob Lee's father, Earl Swagger, sets off a new mission.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E02 - Red Meat
3.plot: Bob Lee visits a local prison for answers about his father's murder; Julie takes a job helping the family lawyer; Nadine and Isaac grab Harris Downey, who knows more about Atlas than he realizes.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E03 - Sins of the Father
3.plot: Harris gets on Bob Lee's nerves out on the road as they chase more leads. Nadine and Isaac locate a person of interest who may or may not be friendly.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E04 - The Importance of Service
3.plot: Bob Lee pays a visit to the Pooles after hearing a new rumor, and Julie follows a lead of her own. Isaac and Nadine pursue an Atlas target.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E05 - A Call To Arms
3.plot: A visit to an old friend of his father's leads Bob Lee back to D.C., where he connects with Isaac, Nadine and Harris for a mission at a formal event.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E06 - Lines Crossed
3.plot: Bob Lee and Isaac are put through the wringer by a member of Earl's Vietnam unit. Julie stands up to the Bama family. Nadine sneaks into a high tech security facility.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E07 - Swing Vote
3.plot: Bob Lee and Isaac meet with a former high level operative as they close in on solving Earl's death. Nadine is sent on a dangerous mission by a DOJ operative.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E08 - The Red Badge
3.plot: An attempt on Sam's life leads the Swaggers to shocking information left behind by Earl, which may have led to his death; Nadine and Isaac's team take a run at one of the heads of Atlas.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E09 - Alpha Dog
3.plot: Bob Lee's search for Bama Jr. leads him to a fringe group, but causes a rift in his marriage; Isaac and Nadine use information left behind by Earl to meet with the President's Chief of Staff.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E10 - Orientation Day
3.plot: Bob Lee and Isaac ambush the Atlas training facility; Nadine and Harris scheme their way into a face-to-face with a critical player in Atlas' plot to retain power; Julie's paranoia grows.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E11 - Family Fire
3.plot: Harris helps Bob Lee get payback for Earl's death; Nadine and Isaac try to convert Atlas recruits to their cause; Julie experiments with putting life with Bob Lee in the rearview.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E12 - Patron Saint
3.plot: As Bob Lee finds himself torn between justice and family, Atlas pivots to a new game plan. Isaac and Nadine investigate an overlooked Jack Long thread. Harris meets with a powerful ally.

3.title: FR - Shooter - S03E13 - Red Light
3.plot: Bob Lee attempts to put an end to Atlas, all while trying to save his marriage and tie up the remaining threads from his past. Isaac, Nadine, and Harris find new roles for themselves in D.C. Series Finale.

meta.plot: When a young boy arrives in a small Mexican village, a profound friendship blossoms with a local kid — and a dark secret seals their bond forever.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E01 - The Secret
1.plot: Manuel arrives in his grandmother's town to a mixed reception. A sight at the market soon captivates him, while Erik hesitates to open up.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E02 - Don't Tell Anybody
1.plot: The boys are haunted by eerie visions. Manuel starts school, facing new challenges — and finding solace with the Muxes. A discovery is made at the river.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E03 - There is such a thing as good lies
1.plot: After lying their way out of a situation with Pau's help, Manuel and Erik skip school in search of the truth, growing closer than ever in the journey.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E04 - Together Forever
1.plot: The case takes an unexpected turn. After a looming loss, Rafaela steps in to protect Manuel, but before long, Manuel must face what he most fears.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E05 - Sicarú
1.plot: Years pass, and a mysterious woman arrives in the town, shocking those who see her and finding herself baffled by the enigma surrounding her old home.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E06 - The Crossroad
1.plot: Sicarú confronts her past, while Erik confronts his own feelings. Alejandro welcomes someone new to the town. Pau gets her results.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E07 - Back Together
1.plot: Pau wonders what's really going between Erik and Sicarú. The Muxes act quickly to shield Emi, who discloses a much darker truth than imagined.

1.title: FR - The Secret of the River - S01E08 - One Thousand Loves
1.plot: The Muxes spring into action to drive Felipe away. Ana finally hears what really happened to Pedro, but the turmoil in the town is far from over.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Jane gets a rough start in her new New York homicide squad when she questions her new colleagues' work on a mysterious murder case. After complaining to her lieutenant about not getting cases, Jane manages to find a unique angle to help solve a crime. Meanwhile, Jane goes to her father for advice.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E02 - Carnivorous Sheep
1.plot: Jane is called into Duffy's homicide and kidnapping case after Sweeney calls for all hands on deck. Duffy gets irritated with Jane after she suggests talking with the deceased woman's employees.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E03 - Bitch
1.plot: While helping out at her father's bar, Jane finds herself without her gun when she confronted with a robber. Calderon and Jane get assigned to solving the murder of a woman found in a dumpster. Meanwhile, Carolina Rivera tries to befriend Jane while working on her father's robbery case but gets the cold shoulder.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E04 - Great Guy, Yet: Dead
1.plot: When a good-looking stockbroker is killed mysteriously, Jane automatically suspects his wife. Meanwhile, Jane enlists the help of a hypnotist to fight her addiction to smoking. Elsewhere, Matt is furious when his ex-wife suggests Jane shouldn't attend their son's birthday party.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E05 - Regrets, I've Had a Few
1.plot: Jane's latest case involves a woman found dead in the park, which leaves Duffy and Velerio to find the victim's stepfather. Jane and Desmond observe an anniversary.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E06 - Shame
1.plot: A middle-aged man is found mugged, naked and dead in a hotel - and the prime suspect may be a prostitute with a penchant for poison!

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E07 - Wednesday's Child
1.plot: When a five-year-old kid is found dead at school, the investigation gets personal for Jane.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E08 - Underwater
1.plot: Jane and Reg take an uncomfortable road trip upstate to investigate the grisly murder of a young girl's parents.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E09 - Gone to Pieces
1.plot: When a hit-and-run case looks unsolvable, Duffy tries to hand it off to Jane. Clues point to a porn king as the suspect in a case that Jane and Evrard are working. Sweeney receives some advice from Duffy.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E10 - A Gorgeous Mosaic
1.plot: A Jewish diamond dealer's death is investigated by Jane and Augie. Matt gets a new job and celebrates with Jane.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E11 - The Great Wall of Silence
1.plot: Jane and Evrard go to Chinatown to investigate a murder during a game of mahjong. Jane and Evrard can't seem to get a break on the case when a big shot lawyer seems to make all the witnesses disappear. Meanwhile, Reg lets Matt in on a little secret about Jane.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E12 - Ain't No Sunshine
1.plot: Duffy and Calderon have the unpleasant task of telling a grandmother that her young granddaughter was raped and murdered. Jane and Augie are on the ritzy Upper East Side when a woman is found mysteriously shot during the night. Meanwhile, Jane has a heart to heart with Matt.

1.title: FR - Suspect n°1 New York - S01E13 - Stuck in the Middle With You
1.plot: The team discovers an incarcerated man could be responsible for a recent crime; Sweeney orders round-the-clock security when a hit is ordered; Jane ends up accompanying two people on an uncomfortable date.

meta.plot: Si Jane Timoney n'a pas les problèmes d'alcool de son aînée, Jane Tennison, elle tente d'arrêter de fumer avec plus ou moins de réussite. Mutée dans un nouveau poste de police new-yorkais, la quadragénaire doit faire face au machisme de ses collègues masculins, qui la soupçonnent d'avoir couché pour avoir le job. Mais celle qui a grandi à la dure derrière le zinc du bar de son père et a été obligée de mûrir trop vite suite à la mort de sa mère quand elle était adolescente n'est pas du genre à se laisser marcher sur les pieds.

Srikant Tiwari tente de concilier sa vie de famille avec son travail d'espion relevant d'une cellule spéciale hautement secrète de la National Intelligence Agency. Il essaye de prévenir les attaques terroristes à l'encontre de son pays tout en protégeant ses proches.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E01 - The Family Man
1.plot: Srikant Tiwari, a member of TASC, a discreet intelligence agency, is assigned to interrogate suspected ISIS recruits. Balancing his personal life with work becomes a challenge for this family man, and things get out of hand on both fronts.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E02 - Sleepers
1.plot: A scooter bomb goes off at Kala Ghoda. Srikant learns about a mission called Zulfiqar. Suspects in the blast case tell him about a drop box near Victoria College. He arranges for round-the-clock surveillance at the drop box location.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E03 - Anti-National
1.plot: When he finds out that one of the hospitalised prisoners is part of Mission Zulfiqar, Srikant interrogates the prisoner’s friend, Moosa, about it. Someone called Kareem has used the dropbox. TASC monitors Kareem’s hostel room, but Kareem gives them the slip.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E04 - Patriots
1.plot: TASC is in a quandary. They fear Kareem and his men have a devious plan. They get to Kareem’s car, only to realise that things are not what they seem.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E05 - Pariah
1.plot: ISI agent Sameer sends the Kala Ghoda bomber to Kashmir to execute Mission Zulfiqar. Srikant is ‘punished’ and sent to Kashmir, but when his boss, Kulkarni, tells him it was planned, Srikant starts digging into Zulfiqar.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E06 - Dance of Death
1.plot: Srikant discovers that he’s been after the wrong suspect all this time.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E07 - Paradise
1.plot: Srikant searches for Sajid at a wedding in Baramulla. Pakistan’s PM finds out about Zulfiqar and tries to stop it.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E08 - Act of War
1.plot: Srikant helps CIA locate Faizan, a wanted man hiding in Balochistan. Srikant slips into Pakistan to interrogate Faizan.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E09 - Fighting Dirty
1.plot: Srikant tries to thwart a plan to smuggle nerve gas canisters from Kashmir into Delhi.

1.title: FR - The Family Man - S01E10 - The Bomb
1.plot: TASC realises that Mission Zulfiqar is not over. There is a Plan B. And it has already been put to action.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: British and French detectives are brought together when a body is discovered inside the Channel Tunnel.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: While the killer's second 'truth' unfolds, Stephen Beaumont crosses the paths of Karl and Elise once more.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The police face a race against time to identify and capture the killer as he steps up his campaign, targeting a further elderly victim in his 'moral' crusade.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Karl and Elise battle to locate an elderly soldier before he freezes to death at the hands of the killer. Meanwhile, runaway teen Sophie puts her trust in Benji.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The Truth Terrorist's third truth begins as Benji carries out his Samurai mission. The police hope to use teenage runaway Sophie to help trap the killer.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the killer's incendiary fourth truth begins, Karl and Elise's suspicions fall on Stephen Beaumont. A manhunt begins, but is he the correct suspect?

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Police think they may finally have a lead as the serial killer's actions escalate in his fifth and final 'truth', inciting mob violence in England and France.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: French police capture but then lose the prime suspect before Elise mysteriously disappears. As Karl searches Danny's flat, things start to fall into place.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: In the cross-Channel crime thriller's penultimate instalment, events take a nasty turn for Karl as police get within a hair's breadth of catching the killer.

1.title: FR - Tunnel - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: The tense crime drama comes to an unmissable climax as Karl falls apart when the Truth Terrorist's change of direction becomes too much to bear.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Elise Wasserman and Karl Roebuck investigate when a couple are abducted from the Channel Tunnel in front of their young daughter. Events take a dramatic turn when a plane crashes into the Channel.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: The hunt for Madeleine becomes a matter of international urgency but Elise's investigation slows as she is forced to keep new evidence from Karl. Further links between the abduction and plane clash are discovered.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: As the investigation continues and terrorists plan a further attack in France, a man comes forward with links to Robert. Elise uncovers disturbing facts about Eryka's past and Karl follows a hunch.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Karl and Elise receive a tip-off from a woman they believe knows Robert Fournier's whereabouts. But can she be trusted?

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: An unexpected revelation threatens to turn Karl's life upside-down. Meanwhile, Eryka reaches out to Elise and Rosa offers the team a cryptic clue.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: An anonymous package gives Karl his biggest breakthrough in the case yet. Plus, the investigating team receive a clear and violent warning.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: The team are forced to strike a deal with Vanessa. Meanwhile, someone tries to warn Karl off the case and Elise crosses a line she may quickly come to regret.

2.title: FR - Tunnel - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: A lethal attack is launched and Elise and Karl's lives are thrown into jeopardy as the second series of the gripping crime drama ends in a nail-biting showdown.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: A burning fishing boat found on the Channel turns into a new case for Karl and Elise in the third and final chapter of the series.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: A shocking discovery is made at an immigration removal centre alongside a sinister animation containing a hidden message.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: The investigation steps up when Winnie is sent a live rat in a box, with a set of co-ordinates leading to the Pied Piper’s latest victim. Meanwhile, Karl’s disapproval turns to concern when he learns the extent of Elise’s distress over the Moreau case. In English and French

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: As a young mother-to-be helps Karl and Elise with their enquiries a new development threatens to tear the pair's partnership apart.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Karl makes a foreboding discovery at Elise’s apartment, and the pattern of missing people continues.

3.title: FR - Tunnel - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: In the final episode, Karl and Elise face a tense and gripping showdown with the Pied Piper, while the truth about the Moreau abduction is revealed at last.

meta.plot: Après la découverte d'un cadavre au milieu du tunnel sous la Manche, les polices française et britannique doivent mener une enquête conjointe.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Fresh off another unsuccessful date, Joanne sashays into a friend's party and meets Noah, an adorable rabbi who recently broke up with his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E02 - A Shiksa Walks Into a Temple
1.plot: Joanne and Noah get to know each other, but reality hits when she learns about his romantic history and he deals with an interrogation from his family.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E03 - Either Aura
1.plot: A podcast pile-on about her aura and an unanswered text make Joanne question if she's a good match for Noah, who faces a guilt trip after an accident.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E04 - Obliterated
1.plot: Joanne's last-minute dash to pick up a sex toy for a podcast episode makes for a memorable first date with Noah. Sasha helps Miriam with a boy problem.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E05 - My Friend Joanne
1.plot: Work obligations interfere with Noah and Joanne's plans to take their relationship to the next level, while Sasha and Morgan bond over family dynamics.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E06 - The Ick
1.plot: During an impromptu get-together with Joanne's family, Noah is determined to make a good impression — so determined that it's a major turnoff.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E07 - WAGS
1.plot: Meeting Joanne's friends? Easy enough for Noah. But winning over his pals means making nice with their wives and girlfriends, who are close to his ex.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E08 - Rebecca's Box
1.plot: Joanne's discovery of a small box in Noah's bedroom turns into something much bigger as she fights the urge to snoop, and he receives big news at work.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E09 - My Girl Bina
1.plot: Power games and a custom-made charcuterie board complicate Joanne's official introduction to Noah's parents. Morgan asks Sasha for a favor.

1.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S01E10 - Bat Mitzvah Crashers
1.plot: Miriam's Big Apple-themed bat mitzvah sets the scene for even greater life changes when Noah and Joanne confront questions about their future.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E01 - Dinner Party
2.plot: Riding high on romance, Joanne and Noah merge their friend groups at a dinner party. But an offhand comment reveals they're not quite on the same page.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E02 - Leave It At The Tree
2.plot: When Joanne nudges Noah to express his feelings, he surprises even himself. Morgan's request for constructive feedback quickly devolves into blowback.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E03 - The Unethical Therapist
2.plot: An unlikely guest stirs things up on the podcast. Morgan's polarizing plus-one raises eyebrows at a party. Bina gets pushy with Sasha and Esther.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E04 - Valentine's Day
2.plot: When Noah cooks up a swoon-worthy Valentine's plan, Joanne worries about his true intentions — and the price of setting aside her own traditions.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E05 - Abby Loves Smoothies
2.plot: Intending to support Noah at a baby-naming ceremony, Joanne can't resist teaming up with Morgan for some payback against a former rival.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E06 - Anything Can Happen
2.plot: Still reeling from Noah's request for a "night off" from her, Joanne tries to keep it together as her parents meet his for the first time.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E07 - When You Know, You Know
2.plot: A blunder on an important shopping trip sets off fireworks on the podcast. Noah's modern new workplace delivers some old-fashioned culture shock.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E08 - A Better Rabbi
2.plot: Noah guides a surprisingly experienced new student. Joanne faces mounting pressure. Morgan recruits Sasha to dig up some digital dirt.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E09 - Crossroads
2.plot: An afternoon couples' hang goes off the rails when a provocative party game reveals everyone's most uncomfortable truths.

2.title: FR - Nobody Wants This - S02E10 - When Noah Met Joanne
2.plot: The complexities of love get all too real at a lavish celebration, as Joanne and Noah question what's worth holding onto — and what's slipping away.

meta.plot: Pol Rubio commence à étudier la philosophie à l'Université de Barcelone tandis que la relation entre Bruno et lui commence à se renforcer. Pol va rencontrer de nouveaux amis, de nouveaux collègues et nouveaux enseignants, en plus d'avoir à faire face aux conflits dans sa nouvelle carrière comme étudiant, sa famille complexe et sa nouvelle relation avec Bruno jusqu'à devenir un maître de la philosophie.
Surviving power struggles, betrayals and plots, Hitler's inner circle of Nazi leaders seizes control of Germany and designs its disastrous future.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - Heroes & Misfits
1.plot: War heroes, disaffected workers, a wealthy playwright and an enigmatic veteran named Adolf Hitler create a movement fueled by mythology and racism.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - Regrouping
1.plot: Imprisoned and his followers scattered, Hitler in 1923 seems to be finished, until he and Rudolf Hess devise a new strategy and a new path to power.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - Fall of Röhm
1.plot: The stock market crash in the U.S. makes the Nazis seem prescient, but newfound respect means the party must be purged of rivalrous elements.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - The Rise of Antisemitism
1.plot: Himmler, Goebbels and Goering jockey for position while the Nazis rise to control Germany and plot to launch their vicious antisemitic programs.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - The Berghof Set
1.plot: As the country's economy falters, the Nazis plan invasions and a racial purge while the leaders of the inner circle fight to win Hitler's favor.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Madness of Rudolf Hess
1.plot: As Germany invades Poland and sparks World War II, loyal Deputy Fuhrer Rudolf Hess tries to reclaim his once lofty status among Hitler's senior staff.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - The Fall and Rise of Reinhard
1.plot: SS head Heinrich Himmler orders his deputy Reinhard Heydrich to enact a plan of ethnic cleansing that becomes a blueprint for the Holocaust.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - Rise of the Sychophants
1.plot: At a critical juncture of the war in 1942, Germany's manufacturing capacity is strained and Hitler turns not to a general but architect Albert Speer.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - Beginning of the End
1.plot: As the war fails, the inner circle responds with strategies to save itself, from plotting the Führer's assassination to negotiating with the allies.

1.title: EN - Hitler's Circle of Evil [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - Meltdown
1.plot: Exit strategies are put into action by the members of the inner circle when the Allies surround the capitol and Hitler perishes by his own hand.

meta.plot: Hip-Hop today is a global culture that has changed music, dance, fashion, language —and even politics. But where did this worldwide cultural movement begin? We trace hip-hop back to its humble beginnings, when the kids of the Bronx crammed into house parties, rec rooms, and public parks to hear music like they’d never heard it before.

1.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Foundation
1.plot: Bronx-based DJs set Hip-Hop's sonic foundations. MCs, inspired by African American oral traditions, create the modern template for rap music, culminating with the emergence of Hip-Hop's first crew, Grandmaster Flash and the Furious Five.

1.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - From The Underground to The Mainstream
1.plot: Hip-Hop crews in the Bronx and Harlem begin to form around the DJs, but these pioneering groups never record any music. It would take R&B veterans to see the genre’s commercial potential and create Hip-Hop's first hit, "Rapper's Delight."

1.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The New Guard
1.plot: Run-DMC ushers in a new era of Hip-Hop. Russell Simmons and Rick Rubin build Hip-Hop's first empire, Def Jam. An unknown producer finds a new way to make beats and launches Hip-Hop's Golden Age, culminating in the epic fury of Public Enemy.

1.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Birth of Gangsta Rap
1.plot: Ice-T uses Hip-Hop to reflect the violence of Los Angeles and inspires a new form of Hip-Hop: Gangsta Rap. N.W.A’s first album, Straight Outta Compton, shocks America. After the LA Rebellion, Dr. Dre makes The Chronic, and creates Hip-Hop’s first hardcore pop record

2.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The Southern Way
2.plot: 2 Live Crew popularizes the Miami bass sound and scores a victory for free speech. The Geto Boys put Houston on the map, paving the way for UGK.

2.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Out the Trunk: The Bay
2.plot: In the Bay Area, Too $hort channels pimp culture, MC Hammer becomes rap's first pop star, and Digital Underground introduces the world to Tupac Shakur.

2.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Do the Knowledge
2.plot: KRS-One makes his mark at New York's legendary Latin Quarter club. A Tribe Called Quest and De La Soul cultivate an Afrocentric, jazzy style.

2.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - New York State of Mind
2.plot: In the early 1990s, a new wave of hardcore East Coast artists emerges, led by Nas, Wu-Tang Clan and the Notorious B.I.G.

3.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - A Tale of Two Coasts
3.plot: With the rise of N.W.A., gangsta rap and Suge Knight, the East Coast-West Coast rivalry climaxes with a lethal beef ensnaring the great Tupac Shakur.

3.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Life After Death
3.plot: In NYC, the Notorious B.I.G. fosters an empowering protégée, Lil' Kim. When the East-West feud claims Biggie, Puff Daddy and Jay-Z vie for the throne.

3.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Pass the Mic
3.plot: Alternative hip-hop bubbles up from the streets: Mos Def spits in NYC, the Freestyle Fellowship chops it up in LA, and Eminem battle on the circuit.

3.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - The Dirty South
3.plot: A hot, sticky music scene is born in Atlanta as the infectious hooks of TLC and Kris Kross yield to the gritty originality of OutKast and Goodie Mob.

4.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S04E01 - Bounce to This
4.plot: Rooted in New Orleans's rich music culture, No Limit mogul Master P and bounce breakouts DJ Jimi and Juvenile shake rap and put twerking on the map.

4.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - The Southern Lab
4.plot: Innovators explode out of the South: Houston's DJ Screw slows hip-hop down, Memphis's Three 6 Mafia goes dark, and Atlanta's Lil Jon brings the crunk.

4.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S04E03 - The Super Producers
4.plot: Auteurs like the Neptunes' Pharrell and Chad expand the sonic palette. Timbaland and Missy Elliott lean forward. Kanye West and J Dilla reimagine rap.

4.title: EN - Hip Hop Evolution [MULTI-SUB] - S04E04 - Street Dreams
4.plot: Mixtapes spread the hottest sounds, infringe copyright and break artists. Among them, 50 Cent polarizes, T.I. takes off with trap, and Lil Wayne clicks.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E01 - Raised by Wolves
1.plot: After Earth is rendered uninhabitable, Androids Mother and Father start a new settlement and family with human embryos on the planet Kepler-22b. Twelve years later, only one child, Campion, remains, and the arrival of an Ark of surviving humans called the Mithraic presents a threat that Mother has no choice but to confront.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E02 - Pentagram
1.plot: After a confrontation with Marcus, Mother discovers and takes five Mithraic children (Hunter, Tempest, Paul, Holly and Vita) back to her settlement. While Mother, Father and Campion, adjust to living with a new group of Earth-born children, Marcus struggles to survive alone on Kepler-22b.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E03 - Virtual Faith
1.plot: After the Mithraic kids fall sick, Campion believes Mother is poisoning them and plans an escape. As Mother and Father attempt to prove otherwise, Marcus and Sue work to convince the other surviving Mithraic to mount a rescue of the children, desperate to get their son Paul back.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E04 - Nature's Course
1.plot: Father tries to teach the children how to hunt some of Kepler-22b’s mysterious creatures for food. Meanwhile, the Mithraic make a stunning discovery that potentially fulfills a Mithraic prophecy, and a debate about how to proceed ignites a conflict between Marcus and the Mithraic leader, Ambrose.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E05 - Infected Memory
1.plot: Marcus moves forward with a plan to rescue the Mithraic children, but first he has to find them. Back at the settlement, Campion and Paul bond while on a hunting expedition with Father, and Mother attempts to learn more about her origins.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E06 - Lost Paradise
1.plot: After rekindling her connection to her creator, Mother finds herself distracted by intense feelings she didn’t know she was capable of having, unaware that Marcus, Sue and the Mithraic are closing in on the settlement.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E07 - Faces
1.plot: Marcus’s decisions stress his relationship to his family as he struggles to maintain his clout as leader of the Mithraic. Mother is able to see Marcus for who he truly is, which threatens his power and puts Mother in a precarious situation she might not recover from. Meanwhile, Campion is faced with a choice that could result in dire consequences.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E08 - Mass
1.plot: As Marcus continues to embrace his Mithraic devotion, Sue worries he may no longer have her and Paul’s best interests at heart. Meanwhile, Mother experiences what she believes to be malfunctions, and Hunter works on a secret project with Father.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E09 - Umbilical
1.plot: Sue is determined to keep the children safe, and in doing so, struggles with whether or not she can trust Mother. Meanwhile, a new threat arises and an increasingly erratic Marcus causes the Mithraic to question their leader.

1.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S01E10 - The Beginning
1.plot: Paul begins displaying troubling behavior not unlike that of Marcus, leading to a shocking discovery. Father struggles with human-like emotions. Mother and Father discover a startling secret about the planet they’re on, just as a new threat arrives on Kepler-22b.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E01 - The Collective
2.plot: While Mother, Father, and the children face hostility from their new atheist collective, Marcus sets out to fill the walls of an ancient church with Sol’s worshippers.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E02 - Seven
2.plot: While the collective is tasked with hunting down the serpent, Mother is left to reconcile complicated emotions. Convinced that it will aid his cause, Marcus sets out to find the creature before the atheists do.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E03 - Good Creatures
2.plot: Using his mysterious new powers, Marcus rescues a group of Mithraic prisoners, while Mother discovers the serpent is not a maneater but an herbivore. Father works through his frustration over Mother’s decision to spare the serpent’s life by engrossing himself in his work project, the regeneration of an ancient android.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E04 - Control
2.plot: After the Trust uses Paul to strike back against Marcus, Mother confronts the Trust and threatens a coup. Meanwhile, on the run from Mother, Marcus has to keep his followers from losing faith as his powers suddenly disappear.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E05 - King
2.plot: Mother struggles to keep the collective from falling apart as she struggles to lead while Sue resorts to prayer in her desperation to cure Paul. Meanwhile, Marcus and his followers are given new hope as they discover an ancient temple. But as Marcus investigates the temple’s secrets, Decima and the rest of his followers are made to answer for their sins.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E06 - The Tree
2.plot: As they try and fail to open the seed box, Sue and Paul realize they need Marcus’s help. Sue makes a plan to break Marcus out of the brig while Mother is distracted with the imminent birth of Tempest’s baby. But when Sue, Paul and Marcus finally open the seed box, they make a horrifying discovery.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E07 - Feeding
2.plot: A reeling Marcus and Paul join forces with Mother to disarm the newly weaponized serpent before it wreaks unimaginable havoc.

2.title: FR - Raised by Wolves - S02E08 - Happiness
2.plot: Grandmother reveals her own agenda, Marcus seeks revenge, and Mother sets out to neutralize the serpent – but is leveled by the fallout.

meta.plot: Alors que les êtres humains se déchirent, sur fond de guerres de religion, les robots apprennent qu'il est compliqué et dangereux de vouloir contrôler les croyances des humains. Pendant ce temps, deux androïdes tentent d'élever un enfant humain sur une planète vierge.
A compelling family drama and a timeless story told through the eyes of complicated and compromised chief of police Del Harris of a Pennsylvania Rust Belt town full of good people making bad choices.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E01 - The Mill
1.plot: In a small rust belt town in southwest Pennsylvania, Chief of Police Del Harris investigates after a dead body turns up in an abandoned steel mill. Series premiere.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E02 - Happy Returns
1.plot: Harris’ investigation continues. Isaac leaves town. Billy and Lee reunite as Buell celebrates a shotgun wedding.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E03 - Forgive Us Our Trespasses
1.plot: Grace enlists help in her effort to unionize the dressmakers. The sheriff gets an anonymous tip about the murder in the steel mill.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E04 - My Name Is Billy
1.plot: Isaac befriends someone who teaches him the rules of the road. The sheriff searches for evidence in Billy and Grace’s trailer. Billy tells Lee what happened in the steel mill.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E05 - Jojo Ameri-GO
1.plot: Harris races the clock in his search for the anonymous eyewitness. Lee seeks professional advice about whom to protect. Harris’ old Pittsburgh PD partner pays him a visit.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E06 - Debt Collection
1.plot: Alejandro learns of Lee’s history with Billy. Isaac turns his first trick solo. Harris travels back to Pittsburgh with his old partner to repay a debt.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E07 - Blue Mountains
1.plot: Billy gets in with a questionable crowd. Isaac travels alone. Harris’ investigation into the anonymous eyewitness continues as a high school football player ODs.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E08 - St. Sebastian
1.plot: Isaac is taken in by a kind stranger. Grace’s union drive is put to the test. Billy fires his public defender. Harris realizes what he has to do.

1.title: FR - American Rust - S01E09 - Denmark
1.plot: Harris finally finds the anonymous eyewitness. Lee decides not to return to New York. Billy is returned to the general prison population to face the consequences of his actions. The D.A. may be forced to drop the case. Season finale.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E01 - Homecoming
2.plot: Four months after the shoot-out in West Virginia, Del has returned to the Pittsburgh P.D. while the folks in Buell try to get their lives back on track.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E02 - The Golden Goose
2.plot: A new murder in Buell lights a fire in Steve as he doubles down on his suspicions of Grace and Del. Del continues to investigate the bombing in Pittsburgh while also becoming more enmeshed in the Brotherhood.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E03 - Iron Sky
2.plot: Del invites Vic out to his cabin for a male bonding weekend. Grace goes toe-to-toe with Sue at the District Attorney debate. The town of Buell is rocked by another murder of one of their own, while Steve’s suspicion of Grace grows.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E04 - The Hand You're Dealt
2.plot: Del and Vic grow closer during their weekend in Buell. Lee grows more suspicious of her law firm as her investigation leads her to surprising evidence. A job prospect presents itself to Grace, and Isaac and Russell bond after a harrowing experience. Steve’s suspicion of Grace and Del grows into an obsession.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E05 - Light Me Up
2.plot: Del feels pressure surrounding the Brotherhood as he looks into Vic's disappearance. Lee and Isaac argue about her feelings regarding her job. Isaac’s feelings are hurt when he crosses paths with someone from Russell’s life, while Billy's behavior grows more erratic and causes him to act out.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E06 - Daddy Issues
2.plot: Angela is brought into Del's secret plan. Grace receives a promising job offer, but remains worried about Billy’s behavior. Lee and Isaac have a memorial service for their father.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E07 - Tree
2.plot: Lee’s involvement in the Landwill case deepens. Isaac receives a surprise visit and Billy’s behavior ruins a dinner party. Del fears for Angela’s safety while Grace misses Del.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E08 - Ponderosa
2.plot: Billy has a new lease on life after finally confronting his past and makes strides to secure his future. Lee is in trouble as Rinna investigates the missing documents. Russell returns to Buell to find Isaac moving on. Angela and Del are wary of mysterious circumstances surrounding a death.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E09 - Fast Horses, Younger Women and More Money
2.plot: Cynthia becomes suspicious of everyone as she tries to figure out what happened to Vic. Angela and Del are surprised when they arrive at an urgent police call and things are not as they seem. Lee reconnects with Alejandro when she goes to New York to sign their divorce papers.

2.title: FR - American Rust - S02E10 - Confessions
2.plot: Fighting crippling pain, Del is determined to continue his investigation and turns to Steve for help. Billy leaves for basic training and finds comfort when he befriends a fellow traveler. The Landwill conflict comes to a head.

Unfortunately, Julita, Pati's mother, runs away from responsibility in alcohol and drugs, spending time in bars and on the dance floor. Unlike her, Pati has ambitions. She applied to the culinary school in Sopot and is nervously waiting for a decision on whether she will be accepted. Sony, the local drug dealer, starts harassing Pati. He wants her to pay off her mother's debts. Pati discovers that Julita was trying to earn money by dealing drugs. She repays her mother's debt to the dealer with the help of Krystian, who has a crush on Pati. Julita goes to Sony again for drugs.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E01 - Nice Face
1.plot: MI5 security officer Eve Polastri is bored in her job and yearns for a more exciting life. When a Russian politician is murdered, Eve is tasked with protecting the only witness and soon finds herself on a collision course with a violent and extraordinary assassin, Villanelle.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E02 - I'll Deal With Him Later
1.plot: In the aftermath of her recent assignment, Villanelle is ordered to take a break. Never one to do as she's told, she goes ahead with her next mission regardless. Meanwhile, Eve is given a dream opportunity to join a secret MI6 unit tracking Villanelle and the shady organization she works for.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E03 - Don't I Know You?
1.plot: When Villanelle kills a Chinese colonel at a kink clinic in Berlin, Eve and Bill travel out to investigate. While Eve and Bill chase up a number of promising leads, Villanelle enjoys the cat-and-mouse of their proximity. But as they draw closer, Eve comes to realize that this is much more than a game.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E04 - Sorry Baby
1.plot: Intel from Berlin points to the existence of a mole, prompting Eve to undertake her first surveillance operation. Meanwhile, Villanelle is sent to England to eliminate a member of British Intelligence. Villanelle wonders, could it be Eve?

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E05 - I Have a Thing About Bathrooms
1.plot: Having survived a terrifying close call with Villanelle, Eve now has the mole ensconced in a safe house and is buzzing. They have an exciting opportunity to glean information and crack this thing open.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E06 - Take Me to the Hole!
1.plot: A female assassin is taken into custody in Russia, and Eve and Carolyn head out to Moscow to negotiate access. She could hold the key to the organization that runs Villanelle. Meanwhile, Villanelle is smuggled into the same Russian jail. It's a grim and brutal place, where not even Villanelle is safe.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E07 - I Don't Want To Be Free
1.plot: Tensions are running high as the situation in Moscow escalates, and Eve starts to question who she can trust. Despite the danger, with her sights firmly set on Villanelle, Eve goes rogue. With both women under pressure, the stakes are higher than ever.

1.title: FR - Killing Eve - S01E08 - God, I'm Tired

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E05 - Smell Ya Later

2.plot: The point of no return: Villanelle uses her unrivaled infiltration skills to immerse herself in the world of a new target. Their relationship on the rocks, Eve and Niko confront each other about their future.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E07 - Wide Awake
2.plot: Villanelle dives deep into the dangerous world of her target under the guise of her newfound persona, Billie. Eve may have worrying competition for Villanelle's affections.

2.title: FR - Killing Eve - S02E08 - You're Mine
2.plot: Eve's mission is disastrously compromised. Carolyn briefs Eve on her current status as an employee of the British government and leaves Eve's future in her own hands. Villanelle does everything she can in order to get to her ultimate target.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E03 - Meetings Have Biscuits
3.plot: Villanelle agrees to a job that will take her back to London. Carolyn’s Moscow contacts come in useful when Eve and the team uncover a potential lead.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E04 - Still Got It
3.plot: Eve tries to patch things up with Niko, and Villanelle receives good news about her upcoming promotion.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E05 - Are You from Pinner?

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E06 - End of Game
3.plot: Carolyn finds out that information is being withheld by those close to her, and Eve finds a lead which might bring her closer to Villanelle.

3.plot: Eve finds a clue to Villanelle's whereabouts in the most unlikely of places, Villanelle and Dasha work together on a kill, and the pressure is getting to Konstantin.

3.title: FR - Killing Eve - S03E08 - Are You Leading or Am I?
3.plot: Konstantin makes a break for it, while Eve and Villanelle try to work out what the future may hold for them - together or apart.

4.plot: Eve seeks out any information about The Twelve's origin, but uncovers more than she bargained for.

4.plot: Eve nurses Villanelle back to health, then heads to Berlin to try to take her revenge on Lars.
